# IL-verified combat mechanics for the launch encounters (issue #55)

Everything below was read out of `sts2.dll` build v0.108.0 with
`versions/v0.111.0/solver/tools/dump_il.py` (2026-07-09). Ascension values are written as
`A9+: x / else y`. The sample run is A10.

## Damage pipeline (Hook::ModifyDamageInternal + CreatureCmd::Damage)

```
final = (base + Σ ModifyDamageAdditive) × Π ModifyDamageMultiplicative   [decimal]
blocked = min(target.block, final);  target.block = (int)(block − blocked)   [truncate]
hpLost = max(0, final − blocked) → Hook::ModifyHpLost (HardenedShell caps here)
target.hp -= (int)hpLost                                                  [truncate]
```

- `ValueProp` flags: Unblockable=2, Unpowered=4, Move=8, SkipHurtAnim=16.
  `IsPoweredAttack = Move && !Unpowered`. Strength/Vigor/Weak/Vulnerable only
  modify powered attacks.
- Card self-HP-loss (Bloodletting etc.) uses props **14** = Unblockable +
  Unpowered + Move: ignores block, ignores all modifiers.
- Powers: Strength +amount/hit (additive); Vigor +amount/hit on the OWNER's
  next powered attack, the captured amount is removed when that attack ends
  (VigorPower.Before/AfterAttack); Weak ×0.75; Vulnerable ×1.5. Weak and
  Vulnerable tick down at end of the **enemy side's turn** (`side == 2`).

## Shuffles (the replay-critical detail)

- Combat start: draw pile = deck in save-array order, then **UnstableShuffle**
  = backward Fisher-Yates, `for i = n−1..1: j = NextInt(i+1); swap(i, j)` —
  n−1 Shuffle-stream draws. Draw from the front (index 0).
- Reshuffle when the draw pile empties (`CardPileCmd.Shuffle`):
  **StableShuffle** = the discard is **sorted first** (CardModel.CompareTo:
  ModelId category then entry, Ordinal, then upgrade level), then
  UnstableShuffle (size−1 draws), then appended to the empty draw pile in
  that order. ⇒ reshuffle permutations are independent of discard order —
  a solver line only changes reshuffles through *timing* (pile sizes).
  - Equal-key order (SOLVED 2026-07-10, second pass): CardModel.CompareTo
    returns **0 on full (id, upgrade) ties** — enchantment is NOT in the
    key (chain verified: ref-eq → ModelId Category then Entry, both
    `String.Compare(..., Ordinal=4)`, then
    `CurrentUpgradeLevel`, then 0). Ties resolve by `List<T>.Sort()`'s
    introsort over the **live discard order**, and the sim now emulates
    it exactly (`dotnet_sort.py`): the build is Godot **.NET 9.0.7
    self-contained** (`sts2.runtimeconfig.json`; System.Private.CoreLib
    9.0.0.0), and CardModel : IComparable\<AbstractModel> selects the
    span-based `GenericArraySortHelper` via contravariance — IL-dumped
    and ported swap-for-swap. Behavior: depth limit `2*(Log2(n)+1)` over
    the list COUNT (the old referencesource capacity quirk does NOT
    apply), partitions 4–16 insertion-sorted (**stable**), size 2 a
    compare-swap, size 3 an **unstable swap network** ([B₁,B₂,A] →
    [A,B₂,B₁]), >16 median-of-3 quicksort (equal keys reorder as a pure
    function of the whole input arrangement), heapsort fallback
    unreachable at deck sizes.
    (`ListExtensions.StableShuffle` = `source.ToList()` → copy `.Sort()`
    (null comparer) → write back by index → UnstableShuffle;
    `CardPileCmd.Shuffle` feeds it `discardPile.Cards.ToList()`.)
    Payload-uniform (id, upgrade) groups are value-interchangeable, so
    only decks with mixed-payload groups (incl. a Glam copy among
    group-mates — its payload flips to used on first play) need the true
    pile orders; `combat_sim` flags those fights `exact_piles` and
    tracks hand/discard order as the game does.
- Discard-pile order (IL-verified; load-bearing for `exact_piles`):
  `CardPile._cards` index 0 = top, list END = bottom
  (`AddInternal(index<0)` = Add-at-end; `MoveToBottomInternal` = Remove +
  Add; `CardPileCmd.Add` position switch: Bottom=1 → −1/append, Top=2 →
  Insert(0), Random=3 → one Shuffle draw `NextInt(Count+1)`). Every
  modeled discard entry APPENDS: played cards
  (`GetResultPileTypeAndPositionForCardPlay` → (Discard, Bottom); powers
  → pile None, Exhaust → exhaust pile), the end-of-turn flush
  (`CombatManager.FlushPlayerHand`: hand list order, one bulk Add at
  Bottom), turn-end-in-hand cards (each moves to the discard as its
  effect resolves, BEFORE the flush — `OnTurnEndInHandWrapper`), monster
  afflictions (Phrog INFECT / Wriggler WRIGGLE / slime Slimed:
  `AddToCombatAndPreview` at Bottom), and Gambler's Brew
  (`CardCmd.DiscardAndDraw`, selection order — player-chosen, so
  `start_combat` refuses the potion in exact_piles fights). Hand order =
  draw-append order (Draw takes `drawPile.Cards[0]`, adds to hand at
  Bottom) minus played copies — which copy of an identical pair is
  played changes the remaining order, so exact_piles fights enumerate
  removal positions as player choices.
- End of turn: whole hand is flushed to the discard's bottom
  (CardPilePosition Bottom=1); no Shuffle-stream consumption.

## TERROR_EEL (fight index 4 of the sample run, floor 9)

- HP **150** (A8+; else 140), fixed — Min == Max, no Niche roll variance.
- Combat start: applies **ShriekPower 75** (A8+; else 70) to itself.
- Move machine (deterministic, no MonsterAi draws): initial **CRASH**;
  CRASH ⇄ THRASH loop.
  - CRASH: single attack **18** (A9+; else 16).
  - THRASH: multi attack **4×3** (A9+; else 3×3), then applies **Vigor 6**
    to itself (⇒ its next Crash hits 24).
- ShriekPower.AfterDamageReceived: if the eel takes an unblocked hit and its
  HP afterwards is **≤ 75** (power amount): the eel is **stunned** —
  `CreatureCmd.Stun` replaces its *current* pending move with STUNNED
  (it does nothing that monster turn), follow-up = TERROR; Shriek is removed
  (one-shot).
  - TERROR: applies **Vulnerable 99** to the player (×1.5 on all monster
    attacks, effectively permanent). Follow-up: CRASH (loop resumes).
- Optimal play consequence: the turn you drop the eel to ≤75 you "buy" a free
  monster turn (stun), but the turn after that you eat Terror and are
  permanently Vulnerable.

## SKULKING_COLONY (fight index 7, floor 14)

- HP **80** (A8+; else 75), fixed.
- Combat start: applies **HardenedShellPower 20** to itself:
  `ModifyHpLost = min(hpLost, 20 − damageReceivedThisTurn)`, where
  `damageReceivedThisTurn` accumulates unblocked damage and resets at every
  **side-turn start** ⇒ the colony can lose at most 20 HP during the player's
  turn (and 20 more during the monster turn, which only matters for thorns).
  Minimum 4 player turns to kill.
- Move machine (deterministic): ZOOM → ZOOM_2 → INERTIA → PIERCING_STABS → ZOOM…
  - ZOOM: attack **16** (A9+; else 14).
  - INERTIA: attack **11** (A9+; else 9), then gains **Strength 4**
    (A9+; else 2) — attack first, buff after.
  - PIERCING_STABS: multi attack **8×2** (A9+; else 7×2).

## PHANTASMAL_GARDENERS (fight index 5, floor 12) — added 2026-07-10

- **4 gardeners** in slots first…fourth. **HP is rolled**:
  `Creature::SetUniqueMonsterHpValue` — candidates = [27, 32] (A8+; 26–31
  below) minus other monsters' already-rolled max HP, iterated ascending;
  one `Niche` `NextItem` draw per monster (fixed-HP monsters consume one
  draw too, from the {single value} set). Niche counter entering a fight =
  creatures created in prior combats (sample run fight 5: 2+1+2+3+1 = 9).
- Move rotation (deterministic): BITE **5** → LASH **7** → FLAIL **1×3** →
  ENLARGE (**+3 Strength** self, A9+; else +2) → BITE …
  Starting move by slot (INIT_MOVE conditional): first→FLAIL, second→BITE,
  third→LASH, fourth→ENLARGE.
- Combat start: each applies **SkittishPower 7** (A8+; else 6) to itself:
  the first time each turn its owner takes **>0 unblocked damage from a
  card attack** (props has Move, ModelSource is a CardModel — thorns and
  Inferno don't qualify), the owner gains 7 block **after that attack
  command finishes** (multi-hit and multi-target attacks trigger it once,
  after all hits land). Flag resets at side turn end; monster block clears
  at their own side start, so in practice Skittish taxes your second attack
  against that gardener each turn.

## The six remaining Act-1/Act-2 elites — added 2026-07-10 (#58)

Act correction (Sean, 2026-07-10): DERISK_MEASUREMENTS labeled all nine as
"Act-1", but the run-history floor distributions are unambiguous —
**Act 1**: TerrorEel, SkulkingColony, Gardeners, BygoneEffigy, Byrdonis,
PhrogParasite (floors 6-15); **Act 2**: Decimillipede, Entomancer,
InfestedPrisms (floors 24-33); **Act 3** (unmodeled): Knights, MechaKnight,
SoulNexus (floors 39-48). With this batch, every Act-1 AND Act-2 elite is
modeled.

All values A9+/A8+ where marked (sample runs are A10). Every fight below is
**intent-deterministic given fight state** — the census's "random AI" flag
on PhrogParasite was a false positive (see the census corrections).

### The per-fight Encounter stream (new RNG layer)

`EncounterModel::GenerateMonstersWithSlots` lazily creates
`_rng = Rng(runSeed + TotalFloor + GetDeterministicHashCode(Id.Entry))`
— a **per-fight stream needing no cross-fight counter accounting**
(`Rng::.ctor(ulong)` seeds MegaRandom directly, so it always starts at
counter 0). TotalFloor = the 1-indexed global floor (= node_index + 1, the
same numbering as `floor_added_to_deck`). Validated against the in-game rat
observation from #63: the formula reproduces k=0 for
TWO_TAILED_RATS_NORMAL on ZPJHU3WSH2 floor 8 — the starter offset that
previously had to be fitted by hand. Consumers: TwoTailedRats starter roll,
DecimillipedeSegment starter roll (both one `NextInt(3)`), plus the
slime/bowlbug roster rolls and the ScrollsOfBiting offset added later.

**The three addends are BUILD-DEPENDENT (#637).** Under v0.108 the sum
wraps at int32 and `GetDeterministicHashCode` is the two-lane djb2; under
v0.109 (v0.109.1 RVA 0x22bc0c IL_002d-0054) `RunRngSet::get_Seed` is a
`UInt64`, `TotalFloor` is widened by `conv.i8`, both adds are the unchecked
64-bit `add`, `GetDeterministicHashCode` is `XxHash64.HashToUInt64` and
`newobj Rng::.ctor` is the `Rng(UInt64)` overload (RVA 0x61b81) — no
truncation anywhere. Modeled as
`Rng.for_encounter(set_seed, total_floor, entry, build=)` and reached only
via `_EncounterCtx.encounter_rng()`; **never re-derive the seed inline in a
roster builder** — that is exactly how these six sites stayed on v0.108
semantics for ten days after the seeding change. Engine-verified for 42
(seed, encounter, TotalFloor) cases (`test_encounter_stream_seeding.py`);
this stream is NOT persisted in the save, so it cannot be checked with
`live_coach.verify_stream_seeding` the way the 12 run streams can.

### BYGONE_EFFIGY

- HP **132** (A8+; else 127), fixed.
- Combat start: **SlowPower** on itself. `AfterCardPlayed`: +1 per card the
  player plays (fires after the card's own effects, once per play — a
  Duplicated card counts twice); resets at the **monster side start**;
  damage the effigy takes from powered attacks is **×(1 + 0.1·n)**.
  ⚠ 0.1 is exact in the game's Decimal but NOT in binary floats — the sim
  computes this multiplier in `Fraction` (I7). A card's own damage uses the
  count of cards played *before* it (OnPlay resolves before
  AfterCardPlayed).
- Move chain (not a cycle): **SLEEP** (does nothing) → **WAKE**
  (+10 Strength, flat) → **SLASH 15** (A9+; else 13) forever. No wake-on-hit
  trigger (`SLEEP_MOVE_2` exists in the machine but is unreachable — no
  ForceCurrentState path leads to it).

### BYRDONIS

- HP **90 fixed at A8+** (below A8 it is ranged 81–84 → Niche roll).
- Combat start: **TerritorialPower 1** — at the **end of every monster side
  turn** it gains +1 Strength (AfterSideTurnEnd, owner ∈ participants).
- Moves: **SWOOP 19** (A9+; else 17) ⇄ **PECK 4×3** (A9+; else 3×3),
  starting SWOOP. (`_angryTrigger` field is dead — cosmetic only.)

### DECIMILLIPEDE (3 segments — census said 6; see corrections)

- Segments Front/Middle/Back, slots segment1-3. HP: three Niche rolls in
  **[46, 52]** (A8+; 40–46 below), then `AfterAddedToRoom` (front→back):
  odd max HP rounds **up to even**, then +2 while it collides with another
  segment's *current* max HP, wrapping to 46 when > 52 ⇒ all segment HP is
  even.
- Starters: Encounter-stream `k = NextInt(3)`; segments get
  (k, k+1, k+2) % 3 of [WRITHE, BULK, CONSTRICT].
- Rotation: **WRITHE 6×2** (A9+; else 5×2) → **CONSTRICT 9 + Weak 1 on the
  player** (A9+; else 8) → **BULK 7 then +2 Strength** (A9+; else 6) →
  WRITHE… Note: with starters at (k, k+1, k+2), some segment CONSTRICTS
  every turn while all three act.
- **ReattachPower 25** (combat start, all segments): a dying segment stays
  in combat (untargetable, powers wiped — Strength/Weak/etc. don't survive
  death). Timeline: dies turn N → **REATTACH on the first enemy phase
  strictly after N** (revives at 25 HP) → next turn's intent roll walks
  REATTACH → RAND (**one MonsterAi draw**, equal weights WRITHE/BULK/
  CONSTRICT) → attacks resume that enemy phase. A death while **all other
  segments are dead** is fatal (`ShouldOwnerDeathTriggerFatal`) — that is
  the only way to win.
- `MustPerformOnceBeforeTransitioning` on REATTACH (`CanTransitionAway` =
  performed-once) guarantees the heal happens even when the DEAD state is
  skipped (death during the segment's own attack, e.g. thorns).

### ENTOMANCER

- HP **155** (A8+; else 145), fixed.
- Combat start: **PersonalHivePower 1**. `AfterDamageReceived`: every
  **powered-attack damage instance the entomancer survives** — per hit of
  multi-hit attacks, even fully blocked (the power has no unblocked>0
  check, unlike Shriek), but NOT the killing blow (the pipeline skips
  AfterDamageReceived when the target died) — adds **`hive` Dazed cards to
  the attacker's DRAW pile at random positions**: one Shuffle draw
  `NextInt(drawSize+1)` per card. ⚠ This is a **mid-fight Shuffle
  consumer** the encounter census missed (it only scanned monster classes,
  not powers) — it forks the Shuffle counter for every later fight.
  Current v0.111.0 `PersonalHivePower/<AfterDamageReceived>d__6::MoveNext`
  (RVA **0x340220**, DLL SHA256
  `9cb4f1ad8c9f284aa8fec3122ffd6d780bbf543d875c817abdd12ff63fbf12b4`)
  checks `IsPoweredAttack` at IL_004d, with no unblocked
  test; each loop iteration calls `CreateCard<Dazed>` at IL_00af and
  `AddGeneratedCardToCombat` at IL_00d1. `PreviewCardPileAdd` at IL_0177 is
  post-loop presentation and has no solver state effect. Native sizes its
  status-card preview list once (IL_0083-008d) but re-reads `Amount` at the
  loop test (IL_015a-0166). Both ports snapshot the amount: this is equivalent
  throughout the native well-defined domain, because mid-loop growth would
  exceed that fixed native list and throw rather than define another result.
- Rotation: **BEES 3×8** (A9+; else 3×7) → **SPEAR 20** (A9+; else 18) →
  **PHEROMONE_SPIT** (hive < 3 ? hive+1 AND +1 Strength : +2 Strength) →
  BEES… starting BEES.
- Dazed: unplayable, Ethereal status.

### INFESTED_PRISMS (a single prism — the plural is flavor)

- HP **171** (A8+; else 161), fixed.
- Combat start: **VitalSparkPower** = VitalSparkAmount **3** (A9+; else 2).
  `BeforeCombatStart` afflicts every player card of **type Skill** with
  **Tainted** (amount synced to the power); cards entering combat later are
  afflicted too (`AfterCardEnteredCombat`, non-skill types excluded by
  `Tainted::CanAfflictCardType`). Playing a Tainted card applies
  **TaintedPower(amount) to the player**: **+amount damage taken from
  powered attacks** (additive, ModifyDamageAdditive with owner==target);
  stacks add; **removes itself at the enemy side end** (PowerCmd::Remove,
  not a duration tick). Prism death removes VitalSpark and clears all
  Tainted afflictions.
- Rotation: **JAB 17** (A9+; else 15) → **RADIATE 13 + 13 block**
  (A9+; else 11/11) → **WHIRLWIND 6×3** (A9+; else 5×3) → **PULSATE 10 +
  22 block + VitalSpark +3** (blocks at A8+ 22/20; damage A9+ 10/8) → JAB…
  Monster block clears at its own side start, so RADIATE/PULSATE block
  taxes the player's next turn.

### PHROG_PARASITE (+ 4 Wrigglers on death)

- Phrog HP: Niche roll in **[66, 68]** (A8+; 61–64 below). Alternates
  **INFECT** (3 **Infection** statuses → the player's **discard, Bottom** —
  no Shuffle draw) ⇄ **LASH 5×4** (A9+; else 4×4), starting INFECT.
  ⚠ The RAND node in its move machine is **unreachable** (follow-ups
  bypass it) — the fight is deterministic; census random-AI flag corrected.
- Combat start: **InfestedPower 4** (`ShouldStopCombatFromEnding` = true).
  On the phrog's death: **4 Wrigglers spawn** in slots wriggler1-4, all
  **StartStunned** — one **Niche draw each** for unique max HP in
  **[18, 22]** (A8+; 17–21 below).
- Wriggler: first move **SPAWNED** (does nothing), then by slot —
  wriggler1/3 → **NASTY_BITE 7** (A9+; else 6), wriggler2/4 → **WRIGGLE**
  (+2 Strength, 1 Infection → discard Bottom); BITE ⇄ WRIGGLE after.
- Infection: unplayable status (NOT ethereal — it cycles);
  `OnTurnEndInHand`: **3 blockable, unpowered damage** to the player at the
  end of each player turn it sits in hand; unblocked portions trigger
  Inferno (player-side damage).

### Player-side debuff tick correction (PowerCmd::Apply)

Duration powers (Type 2: Weak/Vulnerable/Slow/Tainted) applied to a
**player-side** creature set `SkipNextDurationTick`, so their first
side-2-end tick is skipped — a Weak 1 from CONSTRICT (applied during the
enemy phase) survives that phase's end and taxes the player's next turn.
Powers applied to **monsters** (Bash Vulnerable, Weak Potion) have no skip
— the existing eel/colony/gardener model is unaffected.

## Act-1 normals & Soul Fysh — added 2026-07-14 (#120 E1)

The five Act-1 normal encounters on 8DVXPWUWRY's path plus the first
boss. All values A9+/A8+ where marked (fixtures are A10). New engine
facts established for this batch:

- **`Enemies` is SLOT order** (CombatState 0x2dff6d) — the acting order,
  the CombatTargets pool order, and where mid-fight spawns land.
  **Dead creatures never leave `Enemies`** (`RemoveCreature` fires only
  on escape/exit/reset), so occupied slots never free up: GasBombs cap
  at 5 per fight, rat backup at 2 (slots fourth+fifth).
- **`EncounterModel::GetNextSlot`** (0x22a598) = FIRST slot no enemy
  occupies. The rat's CALL_FOR_BACKUP instead takes the LAST free slot
  (its own `Slots.LastOrDefault`, d__41).
- **Mid-phase spawns act on the NEXT enemy phase** (the acting loop
  snapshots — the Wriggler precedent holds for GasBombs and summoned
  rats).
- **`RandomBranchState` decoded in full** (GetNextState 0x224110 /
  GetStateWeight 0x2241cc): one `NextFloat(sum of weights)` per
  traversal, branches scanned in AddBranch order, `roll <= 0` selects.
  `MoveRepeatType`: 0 none, 1 MaxTimes-in-a-row, 2 CannotRepeat,
  3 UseOnlyOnce; a branch's `cooldown k` zeroes it while the state
  appears in the last k logged MOVES. The StateLog holds only moves
  (RandomBranchState.ShouldAppearInLogs = false), logged when ROLLED,
  starter included (the #63 in-game validation).
- **`ModifyDamageCap`** is applied inside `Hook::ModifyDamageInternal` —
  a cap constrains the final pre-block damage.

### SEAPUNK_WEAK (1 Seapunk)

- HP ranged **47–49** (A8+; 44–46 below) → one Niche uniqueness roll.
- Deterministic cycle starting SEA_KICK (machine 0x267508):
  **SEA_KICK 13** (A9+; else 11) → **SPINNING_KICK 2×4** (both tiers) →
  **BUBBLE_BURP** (block **8** A8+/7 via GainBlock + **Strength +2**
  A9+/1 self, d__26 0x3aee6c) → SEA_KICK…
- SEAPUNK_NORMAL adds a CalcifiedCultist — unmodeled, refuses.

### SLUDGE_SPINNER_WEAK (1 SludgeSpinner) — random AI

- HP ranged **41–42** (A8+; 37–39 below).
- Machine (0x268614): OIL_SPRAY / SLAM / RAGE all follow up into RAND;
  every branch `AddBranch(state, CannotRepeat)` with default weight 1.0.
  Initial state OIL_SPRAY (a MoveState — used as-is, no draw, logged).
  From turn 2: **one MonsterAi draw per turn**, uniform over the two
  moves it didn't just use.
- **OIL_SPRAY 9** (A9+; else 8) + **Weak 1** on the player (d__16
  0x3b0870); **SLAM 12** (A9+; else 11); **RAGE 7** (A9+; else 6) then
  **+3 Strength** self (d__18 0x3b09fc).

### TOADPOLES_WEAK (2 Toadpoles)

- HP each ranged **22–26** (A8+; 21–25 below), two uniqueness rolls in
  creation order — front toad first (GenerateMonsters 0x27fb10 sets
  IsFront on the first).
- Rotation **SPIKE_SPIT → WHIRL → SPIKEN → SPIKE_SPIT**; INIT_MOVE
  conditional: front → SPIKEN, back → WHIRL (in-game validated
  2026-07-09).
- **SPIKEN**: `Apply<ThornsPower>(+2)` self (d__27 0x3b7ef0).
  **SPIKE_SPIT** (d__25 0x3b7d48): `Apply<ThornsPower>(−2)` FIRST, then
  multi-attack **4×3** (A9+; else 3×3) — the rotation pairs every spit
  with a preceding SPIKEN, so the amount never goes negative.
  **WHIRL 8** (A9+; else 7).
- **ThornsPower** (BeforeDamageReceived d__4 0x38ffb0; v0.110.1 outer
  0xad744, MoveNext 0x3473d0): fires per **powered-attack** damage
  instance the owner receives — including fully blocked hits and the
  killing blow (the hook precedes the block math) — dealing Amount to
  the dealer with **props 20** (blockable, unpowered, no Move flag: it
  can't re-trigger thorns). Unpowered sources (relic pings, Festive
  Popper, potions, poison) don't trigger it. The retaliation is normal
  player-side damage: Centennial Puzzle and Inferno fire on unblocked
  portions.
- **Lethal retaliation vs the in-flight hit (#799)**: the enclosing
  Damage command (CreatureCmd/<Damage>d__12, v0.110.1 0x3e6f44) gates
  dealer.IsDead only at command ENTRY (IL_0078-008b — a command issued
  by an already-dead dealer synthesizes empty DamageResults via
  <Damage>b__0). After the awaited BeforeDamageReceived there is NO
  dealer re-check: DamageBlockInternal (IL_02f3) and LoseHpInternal
  (IL_04bc) run unconditionally, so a retaliation that kills the
  attacker never drops the hit it interrupted. The per-hit loop of
  AttackCommand/<Execute>d__90 (0x3ef17c) re-checks Attacker.IsDead at
  every iteration head (IL_0156-0161): a mid-multi-hit thorns kill
  cancels only the REMAINING hits. The hit's damage is fixed by
  Hook::ModifyDamage (IL_01b2) before the retaliation fires.
  Live-proven: TQM88QFMHSQR SKULKING_COLONY_ELITE (2026-07-31) — the
  1-HP colony's ZOOM landed 38→23 through Block 5, then it died to
  Liquid Bronze thorns; next-fight snapshot 29 = 23 + Burning Blood 6.
  A simultaneous player-lethal hit still reaches the enclosing Damage
  command's later `Kill` at IL_0eb4. In
  `KillWithoutCheckingWinCondition` (0x3e964c), the
  combat-not-in-progress branch at IL_0098-00d2 diverts only a
  multiplayer player death; the solo count <= 1 path still reaches
  `Hook::ShouldDie` at IL_0301. Fairy/Lizard therefore prevent that
  player death even though the nested Thorns kill has already begun the
  final-enemy win transition; without a preventer HP clamps to zero and
  the solver's hp-first terminal score is a loss.

### LIVING_FOG_NORMAL (1 LivingFog + up to 5 GasBombs)

- Fog HP **82 fixed** (A8+; else 80). Slots: bomb1..bomb5 then
  livingFog — bombs sit BEFORE the fog in Enemies/acting/pool order.
- Chain (0x262d10): **ADVANCED_GAS** (once, turn 1) → **BLOAT** ⇄
  **SUPER_GAS_BLAST** forever.
- **ADVANCED_GAS 9** (A9+; else 8) + **SmoggyPower 1** on the player
  (d__25 0x3a8254). **BLOAT** (d__26 0x3a83e8): spawn `BloatAmount`
  GasBombs (ctor field initializer = **1**, never mutated) at
  GetNextSlot — one Niche draw each — then attack **6** (A9+; else 5).
  **SUPER_GAS_BLAST 9** (A9+; else 8).
- **GasBomb**: HP **8** (A8+; else 7); `MinionPower` at AfterAddedToRoom
  (OwnerIsSecondaryEnemy, death never fatal); single move **EXPLODE 9**
  (A9+; else 8) then `CreatureCmd::Kill(self)` (d__20 0x3a34dc).
- **Kill cascade** (KillWithoutCheckingWinCondition d__15 IL_05f7,
  after the dying creature's own AfterDeath hooks at IL_03c7): when all
  remaining living teammates are secondary, they are killed too — fog
  death ends the fight through the bombs, Gremlin Horn firing per death.
- **.run accounting** (2026-07-14, 8DVXPWUWRY): the finished .run's
  `monster_ids` for a fog fight UNDER-COUNTS the bombs — fight 6 lists
  one `GAS_BOMB` while the live save entering the next fight records
  Niche 13 = 11 prior + fog + TWO bombs (5 turns → two BLOATs; the
  first bomb EXPLODEd mid-fight and left the roster). Same for phrog
  rosters (0–1 `WRIGGLER` listed for the 4 that always spawn). So a
  .run-side Niche counter after any mid-fight spawner fight is a
  baseline, not exact — `solve_fight.NICHE_MIDFIGHT_SPAWNERS` caveats
  it (the Niche analog of the I10 Shuffle baselines).
- **SmoggyPower** (player, duration w/ skip): `AfterCardPlayed` (d__4
  0x38ea5c, outer 0x253f00) — a Skill play afflicts every unafflicted Skill
  in AllCards
  with **Smog** (`ShouldPlay` false = unplayable);
  `AfterCardEnteredCombat` (d__5) Smogs Skills generated after a
  same-turn Skill play; `AfterSideTurnEnd` (owner side) clears every
  Smog. Net: **one Skill per player turn** while it lasts (one turn for
  the fog's single application).

### TWO_TAILED_RATS_NORMAL (3 TwoTailedRats + up to 2 summons)

The #63 intent model (monster_ai.py), now in the sim, with these
sharpened facts:

- HP each ranged **18–22** (A8+; 17–21 below), uniqueness rolls in slot
  order; summons roll on arrival.
- Starters: per-fight Encounter stream `k = NextInt(3)`; rat i opens
  with move (k+i) % 3 of [SCRATCH, DISEASE_BITE, SCREECH].
- **DISEASE_BITE is an attack and nothing else** (d__39 0x3ba23c — the
  census's "disease" was the intent icon): **7** (A9+; else 6).
  **SCRATCH 9** (A9+; else 8). **SCREECH** = **Frail 1** on the player
  (d__40 0x3ba5d8). Each of the three decrements TurnsUntilSummonable
  (ctor 2) when it EXECUTES.
- Branch constraints: Scratch/Bite CannotRepeat; Screech CannotRepeat +
  cooldown 3; CALL_FOR_BACKUP UseOnlyOnce. Weights (lambdas
  0x26e84b–0x26e88a): CanSummon ? (1/12, 1/12, 1/12, 0.75) :
  (1, 1, 1, 0) — 1/12 exactly as compiled (float32 0.0833333358168602).
- CanSummon (0x26e640): TurnsUntilSummonable ≤ 0 AND CallForBackupCount
  < 3 AND a free slot AND no teammate already intending backup.
- **CALL_FOR_BACKUP** (d__41): new rat in the LAST free slot (fifth,
  then fourth — 2 summons max, dead rats keep their slots), one Niche
  HP roll, StarterMoveIndex −1 → its first intent rolls through RAND
  **at spawn** (one MonsterAi draw, and that roll IS its intent — no
  end-of-phase re-roll; in-game validated). Then every rat's
  CallForBackupCount ← max(existing)+1 (b__41_2/b__3 — the per-rat
  field is effectively encounter-wide).
- **FrailPower** (0x24d227): powered card/monster-move block ×0.75
  (`IsPoweredCardOrMonsterMoveBlock` — exactly the dexterity-additive
  surface; relic/power block untouched), multiplicative after the
  additives, one truncation. Duration, side-2-end tick with the
  player-side skip.

### Player pieces forced by the 8DVXPWUWRY boss capture

- **Havoc** (ctor 0x28c5c3: cost 1, type 2 SKILL; upgrade: cost 0):
  `AutoPlayFromDrawPile(owner, count=1, position=2 Top,
  forceExhaust=true)` (d__19 0x429184) — ShuffleIfNecessary (empty draw
  pile reshuffles first), take the top card, `set_ExhaustOnNextPlay`,
  current-build `CardCmd::AutoPlay(card, null)` (`0x3df9d4`): keyword-4 Unplayable
  or ShouldPlay-false → `MoveToResultPileWithoutPlaying`; an
  enemy-target (TargetType 2) flip rolls
  **CombatTargets.NextItem over HittableEnemies** (one draw; the boss
  capture's 3 Havocs = 2 enemy-target flips + 1 untargeted = the exit
  save's counter 0 → 2); the play costs **no energy**, fires the full
  AfterCardPlayed hook set, and the card **exhausts** (Feel No Pain
  triggers). Position 3 = Random would draw on CombatCardSelection —
  Havoc's position 2 does not. **Power flips** (added 2026-07-14,
  Tunneler session): `GetResultPileTypeAndPositionForCardPlay`
  (0x228ea0) returns pile 0 = RemoveFromCombat for Type==3 (or IsDupe)
  BEFORE consulting ExhaustOnNextPlay — a flipped power applies its
  OnPlay, leaves the cycle, and does **not** exhaust (no Feel No
  Pain). **Unplayable flips** (added 2026-07-14, Living Fog fight-6
  capture): current-build `CardModel::MoveToResultPileWithoutPlaying`
  (`0x31b6e4`) —
  gate: only acts when the card sits in a **pile-5 in-play zone**
  (d__19 `CardPileCmd::Add(card, 5, 1)`-ed it there before AutoPlay);
  then IsDupe → `RemoveFromCombat`; **ExhaustOnNextPlay →
  `CardCmd::Exhaust`** (the ordinary exhaust pipeline —
  AfterCardExhausted fires, Feel No Pain triggers); else keyword-1
  Exhaust → same; else `CardPileCmd::Add(card, 3, 1)` = discard. In
  AutoPlay the keyword-4 branch is the FIRST check after the
  IsOverOrEnding/owner-dead gates — before `Hook::ShouldPlay`, before
  the CombatTargets roll, before BeforeCardAutoPlayed/OnPlayWrapper —
  so a Havoc-flipped Ascender's Bane consumes only its draw-pile pop
  (+ reshuffle roll if the draw pile was empty) and exhausts: **no
  target draw, no play hooks (counter relics, Pen Nib), no energy.**
  ShouldPlay-false flips reach the same d__343 but whether
  SmoggyPower.ShouldPlay blocks a type-1 auto-play is unread
  (Hook::ShouldPlay receives the play type) — sim still refuses that
  combination.
- **Perfected Strike** (ctor 0x291ce6: cost 2, attack, Strike tag):
  CalculatedDamageVar = **CalculationBase 6 + ExtraDamage 2** (3 at L1)
  **× count of Strike-tagged cards in `PlayerCombatState.AllCards`** =
  hand+draw+discard+exhaust+in-play (get_AllPiles 0x2c1d3c) — constant
  per fight, the card counts itself.
- **Touch of Insanity** (potion, OnUse d__6 0x397010):
  `CardSelectCmd.FromHand` exactly 1, filter `CostsEnergyOrStars` →
  `CardModel::SetToFreeThisCombat` — the chosen INSTANCE costs 0 for
  the rest of the combat (the capture freed Bludgeon).

## DSRNCBLEBL deck batch (2026-07-15 live session)

Modeled mid-run on Sean's ask; certified by the Phrog elite win replay
(`DSRNCBLEBL_phrog_*` fixtures — all five streams exact, sel 48→76).

- **Aggression** (template power; L1 keyword **Innate**): current-build
  wrapper/state-machine RVAs `0x9f6e8`/`0x334bf4` snapshot live Discard
  Attack `CardModel` references in pile order → full `UnstableShuffle` on
  **CombatCardSelection** (n−1 draws even when Take needs fewer) →
  `Take(Amount)`. Each retained reference runs serially: singular
  `CardPileCmd::Add(card, Hand, Bottom)` (`0x130658`, core state machine
  `0x3e1ba4`) redirects Hand at cap to Discard immediately before the move,
  removes the exact card from its current pile, and appends it; only then
  `CardCmd::Upgrade` (`0x12f64f`/`0x12f660`) re-reads that live object and
  upgrades one rung when `IsUpgradable` (`0x7cee5`). Thus a nine-card retained
  Hand accepts the first selected attack and redirects later selections, while
  a full Hand reorders selected Discard attacks to its bottom in shuffled
  prefix order. Missing upgrade closure and malformed physical identity refuse
  transactionally before RNG, pile, or event publication.
- **Innate (keyword 3)**: CombatManager SetupPlayerTurn, TurnNumber==1
  (IL 0x029c–0x03c2): cards whose ENCHANTMENT has
  `ShouldStartAtBottomOfDrawPile` (only **Imbued** in the DLL —
  unmodeled, covered by the unknown-enchantment refusal) move to the
  pile BOTTOM; then Innate cards move one-by-one via
  `MoveToTopInternal` (top group = reversed pile order, NO RNG); the
  turn-1 draw count becomes `max(modified draw, innate count)`
  (Math.Max IL 0x03ac), hand-size-clamped as usual.
- **Expect A Fight** (ctor 0x2895b7: cost 2 skill, upgrade cost −1):
  `GainEnergy(attacks in HAND at cast)` (CalculatedVar b__3_0, pile 2)
  then `Apply<NoEnergyGainPower>` — `ModifyEnergyGain` (0x24f835)
  zeroes every further energy GAIN for the owner (Gremlin Horn refunds
  included — the horn pays via `PlayerCmd::GainEnergy`); removes
  itself at own `AfterSideTurnEnd`.
- **Crimson Mantle** (ctor 0x2869f2: cost 1 power; upgrade +3 on the
  power var 7→10): every play applies Amount and `IncrementSelfDamage`
  (+1; DamageVar starts 0, **props 6** = Unblockable|Unpowered).
  `AfterPlayerTurnStart` (d__9 0x37e9fc): self-Damage(SelfDamage) THEN
  `GainBlock(Amount)` (power gain — no dexterity, no Unmovable).
  Deck with both INFERNO and CRIMSON_MANTLE refused (same hook, tick
  order = application order, untracked).
- **Setup Strike** (template attack 7/9): `SetupStrikePower` (0x251cda)
  is a bare `TemporaryStrengthPower` subclass — the Flex Potion
  machinery (expires at own side end).
- **Potion slots**: `NetUsePotionAction.potion_index` is the belt
  SLOT (`slot_index` in the save), not the dense array position —

## Card accelerant — auto-translated OnPlay templates (2026-07-11, #58)

`tools/card_templates.py` symbolically executes every card's OnPlay
async state machine (`<OnPlay>d__N::MoveNext`, walked on the
completed-synchronously path: `<>1__state == -1` at entry, every
`TaskAwaiter::get_IsCompleted` resolved TRUE jumps to its `GetResult`
join) under a strict whitelist; results in `card_templates.json`.
IL-verified command shapes (each cited from at least one dump):

- attack: `DamageCmd::Attack(Damage.BaseValue)` →
  `AttackCommand::FromCard(this, cardPlay)` →
  `Targeting(cardPlay.Target)` | `TargetingAllOpponents(CombatState)` →
  [`WithHitCount(n)`] → cosmetic `With*` → `Execute(ctx)`
  (StrikeIronclad 0x297978, Breakthrough, Bash 0x282e7c).
- block: `CreatureCmd::GainBlock(owner.Creature, BlockVar, cardPlay, 0)`
  — takes the VAR object; hooks (Dexterity, Nimble) run inside
  (DefendIronclad 0x2ab658-region).
- self HP loss: `CreatureCmd::Damage(ctx, owner.Creature,
  HpLoss.BaseValue, props=14, this, cardPlay)` (Bloodletting) —
  props other than 14 refuse.
- power: `PowerCmd::Apply<P>(ctx, target|owner.Creature,
  var.BaseValue, owner.Creature, this, 0)` (Bash → VulnerablePower,
  Inferno 0x3ed0f4 → InfernoPower). A null-check ON the returned power
  (Inferno's SelfDamage bookkeeping) refuses translation.
- draw: `CardPileCmd::Draw(ctx, amount, owner, 0)` (PommelStrike).
- energy: `PlayerCmd::GainEnergy(...)`; heal: `CreatureCmd::Heal` on
  own creature (NotYet).
- vars: `get_CanonicalVars` builds named DynamicVars — name from the
  var class ctor's baked `ldstr` (BlockVar 0x2ab658: 'Block'),
  `PowerVar<T>` keys by `typeof(T).Name` (0x2ac704); `DynamicVarSet`
  getters are literal-string dictionary lookups (get_Vulnerable
  0x2ac22b: 'VulnerablePower'). `OnUpgrade` = linear
  `UpgradeValueBy(Decimal)` per level, `CardEnergyCost::UpgradeBy(int)`
  for cost (Alchemize 0x28201f), `Add/RemoveKeyword` for keyword
  changes (Aggression 0x281fbb; KNOW_THY_PLACE+ drops Exhaust).
- `DynamicVar::get_IntValue` (0x2abcd1) = `(int)BaseValue` — same value
  for the integer bases cards declare.
- cosmetic/inert whitelist: `VfxCmd/SfxCmd/N*Vfx` classes,
  `CreatureCmd::TriggerAnim` + `*AnimDelay` getters,
  `NCombatRoom.get_Instance` (null path = headless game path → guarded
  regions cannot hold semantics), `Eternal` keyword (sole consumer
  `CardModel.get_IsRemovable`).

Simulator mapping (combat_sim `_TEMPLATE_POWER_STEPS`): only power/step
pairs whose exact semantics already exist join `CARDS` — Vulnerable/
Weak (enemy), Strength/Dexterity/Vigor/Plating/RetainHand/Thorns
(self), each the same power class the cited relic/potion source
applies. Everything else stays refused. Frontier after this batch
(translated but unmapped, by blocking power): EnergyNextTurnPower 6
cards, PoisonPower 3, Intangible/Focus/DrawCardsNextTurn/
StrengthPower-on-enemy 2 each, then ~100 one-card powers; keywords:
Innate 6, Sly 5, Retain 4.

## Card selection commands — tier-2 vocabulary (2026-07-11, #58)

The second command tier: cards that exhaust/discard/upgrade/move OTHER
cards, usually through an in-play selection screen. All IL-read from
build v0.108.0.

**Selection plumbing**

- `CardSelectorPrefs` (struct): ctor `(prompt, n)` RVA 0x2e1d58
  delegates to `(prompt, min, max)` RVA 0x2e1d7c with Min=Max=n.
  `RequireManualConfirmation`/`Cancelable` default false (initobj).
  The prompt getters (`get_ExhaustSelectionPrompt` 0x2e1c85,
  Discard/Upgrade/Transform/Remove/Enchant variants) are LocStrings —
  cosmetic. `CardModel::get_SelectionScreenPrompt` = per-card LocString.
- `CardSelectCmd::FromHand` (`<FromHand>d__28` RVA 0x42cf20):
  candidates = `GetPile(2=Hand, player).Cards.Where(filter ?? (c =>
  true))` (default filter `<FromHand>b__28_0` = `ldc.i4.1`). **Rules:**
  count == 0 → empty result; `!RequireManualConfirmation && count <=
  MinSelect` → the WHOLE filtered list auto-taken, no player input;
  else the player picks MinSelect..MaxSelect (result order = pick
  order). `PileType` enum: 1 Draw, 2 Hand, 3 Discard, 4 Exhaust.
- `FromHandForDiscard` (`d__29` RVA 0x42d408): sets a gold-glow
  cosmetic (`ShouldGlowGold = b__29_0`) and delegates to FromHand —
  identical semantics.
- `FromHandForUpgrade` (`d__30` RVA 0x42d510): filter =
  `CardModel::get_IsUpgradable` (`b__30_0`); count <= 1 auto-takes
  `FirstOrDefault` (may be null), else selection with min=max=1;
  returns the single CardModel.
- `FromCombatPile` (`d__20` RVA 0x42b844, `d__19` = the filterless
  wrapper): `IsCombatPile` guard, then the same count==0 / auto-take /
  pick rules as FromHand. (The draw-pile GRID is displayed sorted by
  rarity then id — display only; auto-take returns pile order.)

**Consumer commands**

- `CardCmd::Exhaust(ctx, card, causedByEthereal, skipVisuals)`
  (`<Exhaust>d__6` RVA 0x425bf0): `CardPileCmd::Add(card, 4=Exhaust,
  1=Bottom)` → `CombatHistory::CardExhausted` →
  `Hook::AfterCardExhausted`. The current dispatch models Dark Embrace /
  Feel No Pain powers followed by Batch 46 Charon's Ashes / Forgotten Soul
  relics, W209 Burning Sticks, and Batch 181 Joss Paper; the exact known-hook
  allowlist is census-pinned.
- `CardCmd::Discard(ctx, card)` (`d__2` 0x425608) wraps the card into
  the plural overload (`d__3` 0x4256d4) which calls
  `DiscardAndDraw(cards, 0)` (`d__4` RVA 0x42579c): per card — collect
  `IsSlyThisTurn`, `Add(card, 3=Discard, 1=Bottom)` in selection order,
  `CombatHistory::CardDiscarded`, `Hook::AfterCardDiscarded`; after the
  paired draw, `AutoPlay`s the collected Sly cards in that order. Batch 46
  models Tingsha / Tough Bandages in the per-card hook; the same census
  allowlist keeps every other known consumer out.
- `CardCmd::Upgrade(card, 1)` (single 0x2d91bf → plural 0x2d91d0):
  `IsUpgradable` guard (`get_IsUpgradable` 0x227d29 =
  CurrentUpgradeLevel < MaxUpgradeLevel), deck-pile-only history log,
  `UpgradeInternal` (0x228f40: level += 1, OnUpgrade(), DynamicVars
  recalc) + `FinalizeUpgradeInternal`, VFX. **No hook fires.** In-sim:
  (id, up) → (id, up+1), enchant payload preserved; start_combat
  refuses decks whose reachable upgrade ladder has unmodeled rungs.
- `CardPileCmd::Add(card, pile, pos, ...)` (`<Add>d__10` RVA 0x426ff4):
  `CardPilePosition` enum 1 Bottom / 2 Top / 3 Random. **Full-hand
  rule:** a Hand-targeted add with `hand.Count >= MaxCardsInHand`
  sets `isFullHandAdd` and retargets `CardPile.Get(3=Discard)` — the
  card goes to the discard instead.
- `CardModel::get_IsUpgraded` (0x227d1e) = CurrentUpgradeLevel > 0 —
  the translator resolves it per upgrade level, so behavior-branching
  cards can parse at one level and refuse at the other.

**Cards** (template-translated unless noted): Acrobatics, Brand,
Burning Pact (validates the hand model), Dagger Throw, Graveblast,
Headbutt, Hologram, Prepared (plural discard, min=max=Cards var),
Scavenge, Survivor, Thinking Ahead, Wish; Armaments level 0 /
True Grit level 1 (IsUpgraded forks). Hand-modeled loops: Second Wind
(`GetCards` 0x294c74 = hand.Where(Type != 1); per card Exhaust +
GainBlock — Dexterity/Nimble apply per gain), Calculated Gamble
(`DiscardAndDraw(hand.Cards, hand.Count)` — hand order, NOT
player-chosen), Armaments+ (upgrade-all foreach).

**Refused on real semantics at this 2026-07-11 checkpoint**: True Grit level 0 and Cinder exhaust a
RANDOM hand card via `RunRngSet::get_CombatCardSelection` +
`NextItem<CardModel>` — a new RNG stream (same blocker as Stone
Cracker); Purity (subsequently modeled in Batch 138) multi-selects then
foreach-exhausts AND carries
Retain; Cleanse summons Osty; Fiend Fire counts+exhausts via
DisplayClass closures; Stoke/Charge/Compact/Drain Power/Primal Force/
Shadow Step/Storm of Steel/Hidden Daggers read piles or generate cards.

## Powers ladder (2026-07-11, #58)

Player-applied powers modeled beyond the original set, each unlocking
its template-translated card family:

- **BarricadePower** (added 2026-07-14, Tunneler session):
  `ShouldClearBlock` (0x24a533) false for the owner — block stops
  clearing at the owner's turn start; the only other hook,
  `AfterApplied` (0x24a4e0), sets a tooltip StringVar (inert). The
  card (Barricade, ctor 0x282da7: cost 3 power; OnUpgrade cost −1) is
  template-translated. Clear-prevention nuance: `Creature.ClearBlock`
  (d__141 0x420600) either clears or fires `AfterPreventingBlockClear`;
  `Hook::AfterBlockCleared` fires UNCONDITIONALLY per creature starting
  its turn (CombatManager StartTurn d__102, IL 0x0510) — so Horn
  Cleat-style AfterBlockCleared relics still fire under Barricade, and
  no modeled relic consumes AfterPreventingBlockClear. Sim:
  `State.barricade` gates the turn-start block clear.
- **EnergyNextTurnPower** (0x24c974, MoveNext 0x380324): single hook
  `AfterEnergyReset(player)` — owner's reset only →
  `PlayerCmd::GainEnergy(Amount)` → `PowerCmd::Remove` (one-shot).
  StackType Intensity. Sim: `energy_next_turn`, consumed right after
  the base energy reset (commutes with Tea Set on the same hook).
- **DrawCardsNextTurnPower** (0x24c77d / 0x24c7ac): `ModifyHandDraw`
  +Amount, gated on the power having existed at turn start
  (AmountOnTurnStart != 0); removes itself at the owner's next
  `AfterSideTurnStart` (after the draw). Net: one extra batch the turn
  after application; re-applying the same turn it fires affects the
  turn after. Sim: `draw_next_turn` consumed at the next draw.
- **PoisonPower** (tick 0x3874ec, TriggerCount 0x25067c): at the
  OWNER's side start, `iterations = Min(initial Amount, 1 + Σ alive
  opponents' GetPowerAmount<AccelerantPower>)` computed once; each
  iteration deals the CURRENT Amount with props 6
  (Unblockable|Unpowered — ignores block, no modifiers; ModifyHpLost
  and AfterDamageReceived hooks are props-independent and still fire),
  then `PowerCmd::Decrement` while the owner is alive. Monster block
  is cleared before the hook anyway (own side start). Sim:
  `Monster.poison` + `damage_monster(blockable=False)`.
- **AccelerantPower** (0x249f66): NO hooks — a pure marker read by
  PoisonPower's TriggerCount. Sim: `accelerant` counter.
- **StrengthPower on an enemy** (Blaze, Fight Me): same
  `PowerCmd::Apply` pipeline into the monster's own strength stat (all
  census amounts positive; negative amounts refuse — floor semantics
  unread).
- **FlameBarrierPower** (added 2026-07-15, 4AR4M0A4CQ live session):
  Type 1 / StackType 1 (0x24ce68/0x24ce6b — additive, same values as
  ThornsPower). `AfterDamageReceived` (d__4 0x380ae8): `target ==
  Owner && dealer != null && props.IsPoweredAttack` →
  `CreatureCmd::Damage(dealer, Amount, props 4)` — Unpowered only:
  blockable, no Strength/Weak modifiers, and NOT a Move so it cannot
  re-trigger powered-attack hooks (no Thorns/FlameBarrier loops). No
  UnblockedDamage guard — fully blocked hits retaliate, per damage
  instance. `AfterSideTurnEnd` (d__5 0x380c00): `Owner.Side !=
  ending side` → `PowerCmd::Remove` — survives the owner's own turn
  end, expires at the END of the enemy side's turn (the `bne.un`
  branches to the Remove path on MISMATCH; misreading this direction
  would make the card expire before monsters act). Sim:
  `State.flame_barrier` — retaliation in `monster_attack_player`
  after each hit applies (alongside the Centennial Puzzle hook, with
  which it commutes observationally), reset where Weak/Vulnerable
  tick at the enemy side's end. The card (cost-2 skill, Block 12 +
  power 4; upgraded 16/6) is template-translated.

Deferred with reasons: IntangiblePower (ModifyDamageCap +
ModifyHpLostAfterOsty clamp EVERY player hp-loss path to 1, ticks at
AfterSideTurnEnd — big blast radius for one unlocked card, Apparition),
FocusPower (orb system), StarNextTurnPower (star resource, blocks
Convergence).

(AfterRoomEntered/BeforeCombatStart in start_combat; Before/After

## CombatCardSelection stream — random-card pickers (2026-07-11, #58)

The `RunRngSet.CombatCardSelection` stream (run-lifetime counter, like
Shuffle) feeds every "a random card" effect. All 16 consumer sites of
STREAM_CONSUMERS.md IL-read this session; build v0.108.0.

**Primitives**

- `Rng::NextItem<T>` (RVA 0x61544): non-list sources `ToArray`; a
  Count of 0 returns `default` **without consuming a draw**; otherwise
  exactly one `NextInt(0, count)` and `ElementAt`. (Matches the
  existing `sts2_rng.next_item` port.)
- `ListExtensions.StableShuffle(rng)`: `List.Sort()` (the reshuffle
  introsort, `dotnet_sort.py`) then `UnstableShuffle` = one full
  Fisher-Yates — **n−1 draws** for n items, 0 for n ≤ 1.
- Play pipeline position (matters for hand pools): `PlayCardAction::
  ExecuteAction` (d__25) validates → `SpendResources` →
  `CardModel::OnPlayWrapper` (d__339), which moves the played card to
  the **in-play pile (5)** via `CardPileCmd::Add` BEFORE `OnPlay` runs
  — a card never picks itself from the hand.

**Modeled consumers**

- **Cinder** (`<OnPlay>d__5` RVA 0x3d8240, cost 2 attack, Damage 18/+6):
  attack, then `GetPile(2=Hand)` → `CombatCardSelection.NextItem` →
  `CardCmd::Exhaust` if non-null. One draw when the post-play hand is
  non-empty. Sim step `exhaust_random`.
- **True Grit L0** (`<OnPlay>d__7` RVA 0x40a7cc, cost 1 skill,
  Block 7/+2): GainBlock, then the same NextItem-exhaust. Its
  `get_IsUpgraded` branch switches L1 to a `FromHand` selection
  (min=max=1) — L1 stays template-modeled, only L0 touches the stream.
- **Stone Cracker** (`<AfterRoomEntered>d__4` RVA 0x3782d4, CardsVar 2):
  `room isinst CombatRoom` guard; fires inside `CombatRoom::StartCombat`
  (d__46) AFTER `CombatManager::SetUpCombat` (deck shuffle) and BEFORE
  the opening draw. `Draw pile → Where(get_IsUpgradable) → ToList →
  StableShuffle(CombatCardSelection) → Take(2) → CardCmd::Upgrade` +
  `Preview` (cosmetic). Draws = max(0, upgradable−1). Upgrades hit the
  COMBAT CLONES only (PopulateCombatState clones the deck) — the .run
  master deck is untouched, so a prior Stone Cracker fight's draw count
  is a pure function of its recorded deck: the cross-fight accounting
  stays exact (`solve_fight.card_sel_counter_entering`).

**Batch 64 modeled relic consumers (v0.109.0/c12f634d)**

- **Bookmark** (`AfterFlush` `0x23d328`, predicate `0x369712`): after the
  physical flush, filter the exact `flushedCards` snapshot to non-Energy-X
  cards whose local-only Energy cost is positive, consume one `NextItem` if
  nonempty, and append `AddUntilPlayed(-1,false)` to that exact Discard UID.
- **Jeweled Mask** (wrapper `0x2414e4`, body `0x3707e0`, predicate
  `0x3707d2`): on the owner's first `BeforeHandDraw`, choose one live Draw
  Power if present, `SetToFreeThisTurn`, then move the same UID to
  Hand/Bottom. It runs after player powers and before the ordinary hand draw.
- **Mummified Hand** (`AfterCardPlayed` `0x2433a8`, predicates
  `0x37428a/0x3742a6/0x3742af`): each owned Power play while combat is in
  progress chooses from the first nonempty of four live-Hand pools: current
  unmodified Energy base or base Star positive and still costs live; any live
  Energy/Star cost; current unmodified/base-Star positive even if free; any
  Hand card. Empty Hand consumes zero; every nonempty Hand consumes exactly
  one draw (empty intermediate `NextItem` calls consume nothing).
- **Power Cell** (`CardsVar` `0x245d4a`, wrapper/body
  `0x245d58/0x377d90`, predicate `0x377d6e`): first
  `BeforeSideTurnStart`, filter live Draw to non-Energy-X cards whose
  local-only Energy cost is zero, exact .NET sort + Fisher-Yates the complete
  pool, `Take(2)`, and move those UIDs in shuffled order to Hand/Bottom.
  Draws are `max(0,n-1)` even though only two cards move.

`SetToFreeThisTurn` appends a temporary Star row `(0,true,true)` and appends
the Energy Set(0)/turn-or-play row only when the current unmodified Energy
base is nonnegative. A negative-base Mummified fallback-4 card therefore gets
the Star row only. Energy-X with nonnegative base stores the inert Energy row;
Star-X ignores fixed temporary rows. Pools 1/3 read the current unmodified
Energy `_base` after upgrade/enchantment rewrites (including Tezcatara), not
constructor canonical cost, and exclude temporary/local/global modifiers.
Turn/play cleanup removes the matching Star and Energy rows after native
phase boundaries. Exact UIDs, ordered rows, opaque tails, clones, upgrades,
Forge, and enchantments survive.

Cross-fight accounting preserves Stone Cracker's exact contribution. These
four relics are exact inside a current simulated fight with a known entering
counter, but their prior-fight trigger counts are absent from `.run`; prior
presence returns None+caveats unless an explicit CLI/save/live/MCR counter is
supplied. Acquisition-order guards reject Mummified+Game Piece,
Mummified+Lost Wisp, Mummified+Permafrost+Juggernaut, and Jeweled+Radiant
Pearl. #485/#496/#499 remain unchanged.

**Read, refused (recorded reasons)**

- **Thrash** (`<OnPlay>d__9`): attack (WithHitCount 2), then NextItem
  over `hand.Where(Type==1)` (attacks only) → Exhaust → adds the
  exhausted attack's damage to its own via `set_ExtraDamage` /
  `DynamicVar::set_BaseValue` — PER-COPY persistent damage growth the
  sim's (id, upgrade) card encoding cannot carry.
- **Anointed**: draw pile `Where(Rarity==4)` → `TakeRandom`
  (= ToList → UnstableShuffle, filtered−1 draws) → add to hand.
- **Drain Power**: attack → discard pile `Where(IsUpgradable)` →
  `TakeRandom` → Take(CardsVar) → Upgrade each.
- **Hidden Gem**: draw pile Where-cascade → NextItem → grants Replay
  (`set_BaseReplayCount`) — Replay is an unmodeled keyword.
- **Seeker Strike**: attack → draw pile ToList → StableShuffle
  (pile−1 draws) → Take(CardsVar) → `FromCombatPile` player pick →
  add to hand.
- **Powers**: `AggressionPower.BeforeSideTurnStart` (discard-pile
  UnstableShuffle → Take(Amount) → to hand), `EntropyPower.
  AfterPlayerTurnStart` (FromHand pick → `CardCmd::TransformToRandom`
  per card — transforms consume the stream), `ImprovementPower.
  AfterCombatEnd` (deck pile 6: Amount× NextItem → Remove → Upgrade —
  POST-combat, shifts the NEXT fight's counter; granted by the Tinker
  Time event's "Improvement" rider on a **MadScience** card, which the
  .run does not record).
- **`CardPileCmd.AutoPlayFromDrawPile`** (`<AutoPlayFromDrawPile>d__19`
  RVA 0x429184): `ShuffleIfNecessary` (Shuffle stream), then a
  CardPilePosition switch — 1 Bottom → `LastOrDefault`, 2 Top →
  `FirstOrDefault`, 3 Random → `CombatCardSelection.NextItem`. **Every
  current caller passes 2 = Top** (Havoc `(1, Top, 1)`, Cascade,
  IAmInvincible `(1, Top, 0)`, MayhemPower `(Amount, Top, 0)`,
  DistilledChaos `(Cards, Top, 0)` — token-resolved + args read
  2026-07-11, live-validated on Sean's HQPAXCBS6P run: a Havoc'd
  Cinder consumed exactly the ONE draw of Cinder's own exhaust), so
  the NextItem branch is dead code today and auto-plays consume the
  stream only through the auto-played card's own OnPlay. The picked
  card is moved to the in-play pile and (flag-gated) marked
  `ExhaustOnNextPlay` before `CardCmd::AutoPlay`. A game patch that
  adds a position-3 caller re-activates the random branch — re-run the
  caller scan on patches.
- **Cross-fight accounting corollary** (an I5 catch, 2026-07-11): a
  prior fight can also consume through a card that did not START in
  the deck — any CombatCardGeneration source (Discovery, Infernal
  Blade, attack/skill/colorless/power potions, generation relics …)
  can create-and-play a direct consumer like Cinder. Generation-source
  presence/use therefore voids cardsel exactness too
  (`solve_fight.CARDSEL_GENERATION_*`).

Post-combat note: a consumer OnPlay that resolves after the killing
blow still draws (no `IsOverOrEnding` gate inside the bodies), so a
consumer fight's OUTGOING counter is line-dependent — one more reason
prior-fight consumer presence voids exactness rather than shifting a
baseline.

## CombatTargets stream — random-enemy picks (2026-07-13, #58)

The `RunRngSet.CombatTargets` stream (run-lifetime counter, like Shuffle)
feeds every "random enemy" pick. All 16 consumer sites of
STREAM_CONSUMERS.md IL-read this session; build v0.108.0.

**Primitives**

- The pool is always `ICombatState.HittableEnemies` (CombatState
  0x2dff6d): `Enemies` (slot order) filtered by `Creature.IsHittable`
  (0x2c706c: `!IsDead && CombatState.ShouldAllowHitting(creature)`).
  ShouldAllowHitting defaults true; the overrides are Adaptable /
  Illusion / DieForYou / Reattach powers — of these only ReattachPower
  appears in modeled encounters (Decimillipede), and its `isReviving`
  window (set in AfterDeath d__11 0x3884e4, cleared in DoReattach right
  before the heal) is entirely `hp <= 0`, so **hittable == alive for
  every modeled encounter**.
- One `NextItem` = one `NextInt(0, n)` draw for n ≥ 1; an empty pool
  returns null without consuming (the 0x61544 read).

**Machinery**

- **`AttackCommand::Execute`** (d__90 0x43717c): per hit of
  `<attackCount>` — validTargets = `GetPossibleTargets().Where(IsAlive)`
  recomputed per hit; empty in live combat exits the loop. If
  `IsRandomlyTargeted` (set only by `TargetingRandomOpponents` 0x2ddea0):
  when duplicates disallowed, filter out already-damaged creatures
  (b__90_3 over `_results`; empty after filtering THROWS — design
  guarantees hits ≤ targets); then `CombatTargets.NextItem(validTargets)`
  — **one draw per hit**, from `Attacker.Player ?? Attacker.PetOwner`'s
  run RNG (monsters never random-target; no monster caller exists). The
  count==1 shortcut lives on the non-random path only, so single-enemy
  fights still consume. Callers (full-DLL TargetingRandomOpponents scan):
  cards FlakCannon, Ricochet, RipAndTear, Stardust, SweepingGaze,
  SwordBoomerang, Volley (+ MockAttackCard, test-only).
- **`CardCmd::AutoPlay`** (d__0, reads at IL_0275/IL_0366): when the
  passed target is NULL — which is what `AutoPlayFromDrawPile` passes
  for every caller (d__19 IL_023c: `AutoPlay(ctx, card, null, 1, 0, 0)`)
  — a TargetType-2 (enemy) card rolls `NextItem(HittableEnemies)` (no
  target found → moved to the result pile unplayed); a TargetType-6
  (ally) card rolls over OTHER players (empty single-player, no draw).
  **Corollary: Havoc / Cascade / IAmInvincible / MayhemPower /
  DistilledChaos consume CombatTargets** (one draw per enemy-targeted
  flip) even though they consume nothing on CombatCardSelection — the
  two session-9 facts compose, they don't conflict.

**Modeled consumers (both relics; sim `_roll_target`)**

- **Kusarigama** (rarity 3, Cards 3 / Damage 6; hook body
  `<AfterCardPlayed>d__19` 0x36e60c): owner + `IsInProgress` + attack
  (Type 1) gates → `_attacksPlayedThisTurn++` → on `% Cards == 0`,
  `NextItem(HittableEnemies)` → `CreatureCmd::Damage(DamageVar 6,
  owner)` — relic damage: blockable, unpowered (Festive Popper props).
  Counter resets at `BeforeCombatStart` (0x240598) and owner
  `AfterSideTurnEnd` (0x2405ad) — per-turn (the Kunai family brackets
  the same window from the other side, BeforeSideTurnStart), zero
  cross-combat seeding; stored mod 3 (trigger + DisplayAmount both rem).
  Ticks per Duplicator/Glam replay (AfterCardPlayed precedent).
- **Parrying Shield** (rarity 3, Block 10 / Damage 6; hook body
  `<AfterSideTurnEnd>d__4` 0x373c78): owner's side + `owner.Block >=
  BlockVar` gates (below-threshold leaves BEFORE the RNG read — no
  draw) → `NextItem(HittableEnemies)` → Damage 6 (same props). Fires
  after the hand flush; nothing modeled changes block between flush and
  hook (no template relic has a side-turn-end hook).

**Read consumers**

- **Forgotten Soul**: owner-card Exhaust → roll + one random enemy damage 1.
  Modeled on current v0.109 RVAs in W146.
- **Tingsha**: owner card + owner current side → roll + random enemy damage 3
  per discard. Modeled on current v0.109 RVAs in W146.
- **Whispering Earring** (boss relic: `ModifyMaxEnergy` +1 Energy;
  `AfterAutoPrePlayPhaseEnteredLate` d__8 0x37a790): from turn 2, auto-
  plays the first playable hand card repeatedly (≤13/turn) via
  `SpendResources` + `CardCmd::AutoPlay` with an explicit `GetTarget`
  target (0x248a18: enemy-targeted → FirstOrDefault, NOT random; the
  NextItem branch is other-player allies — empty single-player). Its
  own rolls are dead in single-player, but the auto-played cards consume
  every stream their OnPlay touches.
- **BeatDown** (`<OnPlay>d__3` 0x3d4e08): discard pile filtered to
  attacks without keyword 4 → **StableShuffle on the SHUFFLE stream**
  (the census's BeatDown-Shuffle site) → Take(CardsVar); per taken
  enemy-targeted card one CombatTargets draw, then AutoPlay with that
  target (non-enemy-targeted: AutoPlay(null)). Dual-stream consumer.
- **BouncingFlask** (`<OnPlay>d__6` 0x3d4928): Repeat× — each bounce
  rolls `NextItem(HittableEnemies)` → PoisonPower(Poison var).
- **TheBall** (`<OnPlay>d__10` 0x408584, MultiplayerConstraint): rolls
  over creatures→`.Player` and gives the card away — co-op only, empty
  pool single-player.
- **LightningOrb** (`ApplyLightningDamage` d__15 0x3980cc): null target
  → one roll per Passive (3, BeforeTurnEndOrbTrigger) / Evoke (8).
  Consumer census (LightningOrb typeref scan): cards Zap, BallLightning,
  Tempest, TeslaCoil, Voltaic, Rainbow; powers Thunder / Storm /
  LightningRod; relics CrackedCore, InfusedCore; Chaos-style random
  channels can produce one.
- **Powers** (granted by same-name cards): Cacophony (`AfterCardDrawn`
  d__10 0x37cd84 — per card DRAWN, roll + Amount damage), Countdown
  (`AfterSideTurnStart` d__6 0x37e20c), Haunt (`AfterCardPlayed` d__4
  0x3825e8, filtered pool), Juggernaut (`AfterBlockGained` d__4
  0x384218), SerpentForm (`AfterCardPlayed` d__7 0x38a6a8, null-safe
  empty pool).

**Cross-fight accounting** (`solve_fight.combat_targets_counter_
entering`): entering counter exactly 0 iff no prior fight held any
consumer (card in deck, relic owned, Distilled Chaos used, or a
CombatCardGeneration source that could create-and-play a consumer —
the generation sets are stream-agnostic). Everything else → None +
caveats; a consumer fight then refuses in start_combat
(`--targets-counter` for hypothesis enumeration). Prior-fight
Kusarigama/Parrying Shield ownership forks every later fight even
though the sim models them in-fight: their trigger counts are functions
of unrecorded play patterns (Parrying Shield's is at least bounded by
that fight's recorded turns_taken — a future hypothesis-range lead).

## Thrumming Hatchet — the Ironclad starter that breaks plain-deck
## Shuffle accounting (2026-07-14, #118)

IL read (v0.108.0): `ThrummingHatchet` ctor (RVA 0x299190; cost-1
attack), `OnPlay` nested `<OnPlay>d__3::MoveNext` (0x4097b4; plain
`AttackCommand` at the card's target — no stream reads), and the
load-bearing hook `BeforeHandDraw` nested `<BeforeHandDraw>d__4::
MoveNext` (0x409694): if the owner is drawing and
`CombatHistory.CardPlaysFinished.Any(<its own plays>)` — i.e. the
hatchet has been played at least once THIS combat — and its current
pile is not already type 2, it calls `CardPileCmd::Add(this, pile 2,
position 1, null, false)`: a fixed-position self-move to the hand,
**no RNG consumed**. Net effect: after its first play, the hatchet is
in the player's hand at every subsequent draw phase, so it never sits
in the discard when a reshuffle fires — every post-first-play reshuffle
is one Fisher-Yates draw smaller than a plain-deck model predicts.

Because it is a STARTER, every Ironclad run's Shuffle counters are
play-timing-dependent. Proven live on HYHM8WP1E5 (see
`test_mcr_validate.py`): recorded boss entering counter 113 vs
plain-model 118, with the hatchet-only hypothesis set {115..118} still
missing it — INFLAME (power) and TREMBLE (Exhaust) plays were also
unrecorded. `replay_fight.cycle_leavers` (census-driven: power /
Exhaust / Ethereal / Retain / draws / adds_cards / shuffles /

### Active-relic templates (IL-read 2026-07-11, top of the coverage ladder)

Turn-start hook order, pinned from `CombatManager.StartTurn` (RVA 0x43b7c0)
and `SetupPlayerTurn` (RVA 0x43ae4c): `Hook::BeforeSideTurnStart` →
`Creature.PrepareForNextTurn` → `Creature.AfterTurnStart` (block clear —
**skipped when side == player and TurnNumber == 1**, Creature IL 0x4204f8;
gated by `Hook::ShouldClearBlock`) → `Hook::AfterBlockCleared` →
`SetupPlayerTurn` (energy reset → `AfterEnergyReset` → `ModifyHandDraw` →
hand draw → `AfterPlayerTurnStart` → `AfterPlayerTurnStartLate`, the Late
cascade fired inside the AfterPlayerTurnStart dispatcher d__56) →
`Hook::AfterSideTurnStart`. `PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber` increments in
`CombatManager.SwitchSides` (RVA 0x2df690) on every enemy→player switch AND
on every extra turn (Pael's Eye, the only real ShouldTakeExtraTurn
implementer), so the .run per-room `turns_taken` (written by
`EndCombatInternal`) equals the count of player-side turn starts — the fact
that lets relay_parser seed cross-combat turn counters exactly.

`DamageProps` bits (static fields): 8 = card, 4 = unpowered, 2 = HP-loss
(bypasses block). `card=8, cardUnpowered=12, cardHpLoss=14, monsterMove=8,
nonCardUnpowered=4, nonCardHpLoss=6`.

- ANCHOR (0x364f94, BeforeCombatStart): GainBlock 10 (BlockVar) at combat
  start; survives turn 1 via the TurnNumber==1 clear skip above.
  Harness-certified (HC1, build v0.109.0/c12f634d, seed HC1SEED, line []):
  initial player block **10** at the opening turn-1 hand (BlockGainedEntry
  +10) — the TurnNumber==1 clear-skip preserves it into the play phase.
- LANTERN (0x36e894, AfterSideTurnStart): owner's side, TurnNumber ≤ 1 →
  GainEnergy 1 (after the energy reset, so it sticks).
  Harness-certified (HC1, build v0.109.0/c12f634d, seed HC1SEED, line []):
  initial turn-1 energy **4** (base 3 + 1) — gained after the reset, sticks.
- VENERABLE_TEA_SET (0x2484dc/0x248529/0x37a388): AfterRoomEntered
  (RestSiteRoom) sets `_gainEnergyInNextCombat` — the relic must already be
  owned when the room is entered (strict-< floor convention); the FIRST

### Counter relics (IL-read 2026-07-12)

- KUNAI (AfterCardPlayed 0x2403f0, body <AfterCardPlayed>d__20::MoveNext
  0x36e3ac): guards in order — card owner == relic owner, CombatManager
  IsInProgress (the WHOLE body gates, unlike Nunchaku's post-increment
  gate), CardType == Attack(1). Then `_attacksPlayedThisTurn++`; when
  `count % CardsVar(3) == 0` → Apply DexterityPower(second CanonicalVar,
  Decimal.One) to the owner. The game stores the RAW count (3rd, 6th,
  9th attack in one turn each fire) but every observable — the trigger
  and get_DisplayAmount — applies rem, so the sim stores the counter
  mod 3 (memo-state merging, observationally exact; Nunchaku's mod-10
  precedent). BeforeSideTurnStart (0x2403c0):
  reset to 0, gated on the starting side containing the OWNER's creature
  (player turns only). AfterCombatEnd (0x240487) also resets — per-turn
  state, fresh each combat, no cross-combat seeding problem. Ticks per
  play (AfterCardPlayed fires inside the duplication loop — SlowPower
  precedent); the power lands AFTER the triggering play, so the 3rd
  attack itself never benefits.
- SHURIKEN (AfterCardPlayed 0x245efc, body 0x37763c): byte-for-byte the
  Kunai shape with StrengthPower(Decimal.One) instead of Dexterity.
  CanonicalVars CardsVar(3) + One.
- ORNAMENTAL_FAN (AfterCardPlayed 0x242944, body 0x3724b0): same shape;
  on trigger → CreatureCmd::GainBlock(BlockVar 4) to the owner — direct
  relic block, NOT dexterity-modified (the Anchor rule, DexterityPower
  IL 0x24c160 modifies powered CARD block only). CanonicalVars
  CardsVar(3) + BlockVar(4).
- GREMLIN_HORN (AfterDeath 0x23f608, body <AfterDeath>d__6::MoveNext
  0x36c7d8): if `target.Side == owner.Side` → no-op; otherwise
  PlayerCmd::GainEnergy(EnergyVar 1) then CardPileCmd::Draw(CardsVar 1).
  NO IsInProgress gate anywhere in the body — and none is needed for
  soundness because the death pipeline runs the hook BEFORE any win
  check: CreatureCmd::Kill (d__14 0x431314) loops
  KillWithoutCheckingWinCondition (d__15 0x43161c) per creature, whose
  cascade is BeforeDeath → ShouldDie → node removal → **Hook::AfterDeath
  (IL_03c7, unconditional — fires whether or not the creature is removed
  from combat, so Decimillipede segment re-deaths trigger it every
  time)** → CombatManager.RemoveCreature → RemoveAllPowersAfterDeath;
  CheckWinCondition's callers are all action/turn boundaries
  (ExecuteActions, EndEnemyTurn, EndPlayerTurnPhaseOneInternal,
  ExecuteEnemyTurn, StartTurn). Consequences: (a) the fight-ending kill
  still gains 1 energy and draws 1, and that draw can force a reshuffle
  — a **Shuffle stream consumption after the last hit**, load-bearing
  for cross-fight counter accounting (solve_fight
  shuffle_counter_caveats flags prior fights owning the horn: draw
  timing is unrecorded, the predicted counter is a hypothesis);
  (b) mid-monster-turn deaths (poison, thorns) draw into the
  between-turns hand; (c) the draw is clamped to free hand space BEFORE
  touching any pile (CardPileCmd Draw d__17, 0x4295bc) — a full hand
  consumes nothing. Order vs same-cascade death hooks (InfestedPower
  wriggler spawn) is hook-registration order, unrecorded, but the
  effects commute: Shuffle vs Niche streams, no shared state.
- Verified combat-inert: MEAL_TICKET (0x370c68: heal 15 on entering a
  MerchantRoom), PLANISPHERE (0x37493c: heal 5 on entering a MONSTER map
  point — PointType 1, first room only; inert for elite/boss fights,
  monster-node fights carrying it refuse).
- Deferred, still refused (new RNG streams): KUSARIGAMA (0x36e60c: every
  3rd attack per turn → 6 unpowered damage to a **CombatTargets**-random
  hittable enemy; per-turn counter, resets at side end/combat start),
  PARRYING_SHIELD (0x373c78: player side-turn end with block ≥ 10 → 6
  unpowered damage to a CombatTargets-random enemy), STONE_CRACKER
  (0x3782d4: at combat-room entry, StableShuffle the draw pile's
  upgradable cards with **CombatCardSelection**, Take(2), upgrade for
  the combat). Both streams have unrecorded prior-fight consumption —
  modeling them needs stream-counter plumbing + hypothesis handling
  (STREAM_CONSUMERS.md lists their full consumer sets).
- **Event-node combats** (updated after the follow-up session): **508**
  'unknown' map nodes in the local history host real encounters — 457 as a
  single monster-typed room, **51 as two-room [event, monster] nodes**
  whose combat hides at rooms[1] (the original rooms[0] scan missed
  those). Combat rooms are identified by their OWN `room_type`, at any
  slot. They are now emitted as `node_type="event"` FightState entries:
  62 distinct encounter ids, all normal-tier, ZERO overlap with the
  modeled census. Their monsters/turns feed the shared Niche/Shuffle/
  relic-counter accounting (the Shuffle stream is run-global — skipping
  them silently corrupted counter propagation for any run with one, e.g.
  SMURHX1NMA node 5). Entry state: the .run does NOT order the event's
  own effects (hp loss/heal, granted cards/relics) against the combat, so
  each event fight carries `entry_ambiguous` and `start_combat` refuses
  it (I5). Unlock path: a per-event effect census — `event_choices` logs
  the event id + option picked (e.g.
  `BATTLEWORN_DUMMY.pages.INITIAL.options.SETTING_2`), so each option's

## P2 wave (2026-07-15) — normal-pool encounters (#138 S2)

IL-read against `sts2.dll` build in the census scripts. Six normal-pool
encounters assigned; **one modeled (CULTISTS_NORMAL), five refused** under
I5 (each needs a monster mechanic beyond the engine's verified vocabulary;
cites below so a follow-up wave can implement them as focused, minimal
engine additions). Census cross-check (I1): `encounters_census.json` /
`monsters` agrees with every read below (move_states, random_branches,
hp consts).

### CULTISTS_NORMAL — MODELED

`CultistsNormal::GenerateMonsters` (0x27d8d1) creates **CalcifiedCultist
(slot 0)** then **DampCultist (slot 1)** — creation order = slot order =
Niche HP-roll order. Both deterministic (0 RandomBranchState).

- **CalcifiedCultist** (`GenerateMoveStateMachine` 0x25ae08):
  INCANTATION_MOVE (BuffIntent) → DARK_STRIKE_MOVE (SingleAttackIntent);
  DARK_STRIKE's `set_FollowUpState` is **itself** (self-loop), initial
  state = INCANTATION. `IncantationMove` (d__24) `Apply<RitualPower>(

  `IncantationAmount` = GetValueIfAscension(9, **6**, 5) (0x25cbe1) — a

## W3 wave (2026-07-15) — family-reuse normals + constructs (#138 S3)

Six encounters assigned (NIBBITS / SEAPUNK / TUNNELER normals; CUBEX /
PUNCH / MENAGERIE constructs). **Two modeled — NIBBITS_NORMAL and
SEAPUNK_NORMAL** — by reusing the weak-pool families' already-verified
move machines + HP ranges unchanged (only the composition and INIT entry
differ, each re-read from IL). **Four refused (I5)** on innate
`ArtifactPower`. No new engine mechanic; no new combat_sim constant (all
kinds pre-existed).

- **ENCOUNTER.NIBBITS_NORMAL** — `NibbitsNormal::GenerateMonsters`
  (0x27e7cc) = TWO `Nibbit`: a FRONT (`set_IsFront` true, slot 'front',
  created first) and a BACK (slot 'back', created second); creation order
  = slot order = Niche HP-roll order. Neither is `IsAlone` (only
  `NibbitsWeak` sets it), so both take the `!IsAlone` arm of the `INIT`
  `ConditionalBranchState` in `Nibbit::GenerateMoveStateMachine`
  (0x264794): the arm adds HISS (cond `b__25_1` = `!IsFront`, 0x264a53)
  then SLICE (cond `b__25_2` = `IsFront`, 0x264a6d), first-true-wins — so
  the front (`IsFront`) enters at SLICE (loop_pos 1) and the back
  (`!IsFront`) at HISS (loop_pos 2). The `FollowUpState` cycle is then the
  same BUTT → SLICE → HISS → BUTT the lone `NIBBITS_WEAK` runs (identical
  `NIBBIT_LOOP`, reused). `b__25_0` = `IsAlone` (the weak entry) is the
  branch neither normal Nibbit takes. Damage/block/buff getters unchanged
  (ButtDamage 13 A9+/12, SliceDamage 7/6, SliceBlock 6 A8+/5, Hiss +3/2).
  Same HP range (44-48 A8+) for both → one shared `SetUniqueMonsterHp`
  set. Deterministic (`random_branches=0`).

- **ENCOUNTER.SEAPUNK_NORMAL** — `SeapunkNormal::GenerateMonsters`
  (0x27f001) = a `CalcifiedCultist` (array index 0 → slot 0, created
  first) then a `Seapunk` (index 1 → slot 1); both slot names `ldnull`,
  so array order is slot/creation/Niche-roll order. Both deterministic
  and enter at loop_pos 0: the cultist at INCANTATION (its machine's first
  MoveState — reuses the `CULTISTS_NORMAL` `CALCIFIED_LOOP`, RitualPower 2
  then DARK_STRIKE self-loop) and the Seapunk at SEA_KICK (`Seapunk::
  GenerateMoveStateMachine` is a linear SEA_KICK → SPINNING_KICK →
  BUBBLE_BURP `FollowUpState` cycle, no INIT conditional — identical to
  `SEAPUNK_WEAK`, `SEAPUNK_LOOP` reused). HP ranges disjoint (Calcified
  39-42, Seapunk 47-49 A8+) → two independent `SetUniqueMonsterHp` sets,
  rolled in creation order (cultist then seapunk). Note: the P1/P2
  "SEAPUNK_NORMAL adds an unmodeled CalcifiedCultist" caveat is now
  resolved — the cultist was modeled by the P2 wave (#141).

- **ENCOUNTER.TUNNELER_NORMAL** — REFUSED. `TunnelerNormal` = `Tunneler`

  (nested `<>n__0`, RVA 0x25ba0f) calls `Apply<ArtifactPower>` — the
  Chomper enters with innate `ArtifactPower` (negate-next-N-debuffs), a
  monster power the engine does not model. Its SCREECH is additionally a
  `StatusIntent` (`Chomper::GenerateMoveStateMachine` 0x25b8e4, status-card

- **ENCOUNTER.CUBEX_CONSTRUCT_NORMAL** — REFUSED. `CubexConstruct::
  AfterAddedToRoom` (nested `<AfterAddedToRoom>d__27`, IL_010a)
  `Apply<ArtifactPower>` (+ `Apply<StrengthPower>`) — innate Artifact,
  unmodeled. Beyond that its machine (0x25c7b4) is a bespoke charge/repeater
  with `IsCharging`/`IsBurrowed` state (CHARGE_UP BuffIntent → two

- **ENCOUNTER.PUNCH_CONSTRUCT_NORMAL** — REFUSED. `PunchConstruct::
  AfterAddedToRoom` (nested `<>n__0`, RVA 0x2665e3, IL_0097)

- **ENCOUNTER.CONSTRUCT_MENAGERIE_NORMAL** — REFUSED (transitively).
  `ConstructMenagerieNormal` = `PunchConstruct` + `CubexConstruct`; both

**ArtifactPower is the single blocker for all four refusals** — a monster
power that intercepts incoming debuffs. Adding it is an engine

next engine primitive to unlock the entire construct family + Chomper.

## Stars combat resource (#170, 2026-07-17; v0.109.0 c12f634d)

`PlayerCombatState::.ctor` (0x2c3ee8) never writes `_stars`, so CLR default
zero is the exact combat-entry value. No run/history entry carries a Star
pool; every combat starts at `State.stars = 0`. The field is mutable and
therefore automatically participates in `State.key()` (I2).

`GainStars` (0x2c4224) and `LoseStars` (0x2c41d4) reject negative Decimal
arguments, write `max(old ± amount, 0)`, and have no upper cap. The setter
(0x2c3e74) records the exact delta. `PlayerCmd.GainStars` (d__6 0x437f5c)
first checks combat ending and `Hook.ShouldGainStars`, then mutates the pool
and serially awaits `AfterStarsGained` with the requested amount. No current
class overrides `ShouldGainStars`. `PlayerCmd.LoseStars` has only the
combat-ending gate; card payment uses `CardModel.SpendStars` so it can set
`LastStarsSpent` and emit `AfterStarsSpent` for positive payments.

`SpendResources` (d__336 0x365ffc) snapshots the energy and Star amounts,
awaits energy spend first, then Star spend. `HasEnoughResourcesFor`
(0x2c4144) independently requires both resources. The optional conversion of
one missing Energy into two Stars is unreachable in v0.109: no class overrides
`ShouldPayExcessEnergyCostWithStars` (default false). The sim therefore
enumerates a card iff `energy_cost <= energy` **and** `star_cost <= stars`, and
pays in that same order (I4). Touch of Insanity calls both
`EnergyCost.SetThisCombat(0)` and `SetStarCostThisCombat(0)` (0x22984f).

The complete Star-cost override census is pinned in `STAR_COST_CENSUS` and a
test: Alignment 3, AstralPulse 3, CloakOfStars 1, Comet 5, Constellation 2,
CrescentSpear 1, DecisionsDecisions 6, Devastate 4, DyingStar 3, FallingStar
2, GammaBlast 3, GuidingStar 2, MeteorShower 2, NeutronAegis 5, ParticleWall
2, Quasar 2, Reflect 3, Resonance 2, RoyalGamble 5, SevenStars 7, Stardust X,
TheSealedThrone 3, TheSmith 4. No class calls `UpgradeStarCostBy`; every fixed
cost is upgrade-invariant. Nine fixed-cost cards currently have complete
effects and are admitted; the other fourteen (including Star-X Stardust) stay
refused for their own non-Star mechanics.

Manual payment happens once per play series. Every replay shares the same
`ResourceInfo.StarsSpent`, but BlackHole checks `IsLastInSeries`, so its paid
branch fires once after the final replay. `SpendStars` writes the card
instance's `LastStarsSpent` before its positive guard. AutoPlay never calls
`SpendResources`: fixed cards capture their fixed `LastStarsSpent`, Star-X
captures the current pool, and `Resources.StarsSpent` remains zero; no Stars
are removed and BlackHole's paid branch does not fire. Star-X Stardust remains
refused because `ResolveStarXValue` also walks `ModifyXValue`; Chemical X is
the sole live override (+2) and is unsupported content.

Bounded consumers now modeled:

- `BlackHolePower` 3→4: positive owner `AfterStarsGained`, plus positive
  paid-Star owner play on the final series member, deals Amount unpowered
  blockable damage to all hittable enemies (props 4).
- `ChildOfTheStarsPower` 2→3: positive owner `AfterStarsSpent(amount)` grants
  flat block `Amount × amount`, then enters `AfterBlockGained`.
- `GenesisPower` 2→3 and `StarNextTurnPower`: owner `AfterEnergyReset`
  `GainStars(Amount)`; StarNextTurn then removes itself. Their mutual
  application order is stored because each gain is a separate awaited event.
- `TheSealedThronePower` Amount 1: gains before every owned CardPlay
  iteration. The first cast sees the old amount; a replayed second cast would
  see the newly applied power, but power-card replay remains the existing
  explicit refusal. A subsequent duplicated non-power gains once per replay.

The owner-only translator admits exact direct sources GatherLight (1), Glow
(1→2), HiddenCache (1 now plus 3→4 next turn), RoyalGamble (pay 5, gain 9),
SolarStrike (1→2), and Venerate (2→3). BigBang remains refused on Forge,
KnockoutBlow on result-dependent kill detection, and ShiningStrike on its
result-location hook. StarPotion gains 3 on its chosen AnyAlly target; solo is
the player, while a summoned-pet target remains under the shared AnyAlly
refusal.

No Stars API consumes RNG or creates a selection. Selection/replay state
continues to carry the paid amount in the existing play latch. Nested damage
can, however, end combat. Exact narrow refusals cover unrecorded same-player-
power ordering at paid `AfterCardPlayed`, Sealed-Throne `BeforeCardPlayed`, and
reset-time Star gains versus other reset powers. If a Sealed pre-play gain is
lethal, OnPlayWrapper still calls the card's OnPlay (IL_059b→0640); because
the remaining commands have individual combat-ending gates, that lethal
cross-card corner refuses instead of guessing. A non-final card-local
GainStars step that kills through BlackHole likewise refuses; a final gain
continues through CardPlayFinished/AfterCardPlayed while combat is still
`IsInProgress` (distinct from `IsEnding`).

Still narrow-refused/follow-up-worthy interactions are BrilliantScarf's fifth-
card fixed-cost zero, VoidFormPower's temporary fixed-cost zero, Chemical X's
Star-X +2, and Stars relics DivineDestiny, DivineRight, LunarPastry,
GalacticDust, and MiniRegent. Their live IL is classified in invariant walk
85; none is silently treated as inert.

applied-power hook incl. nested `<Hook>d__N::MoveNext`). **All 12

engine (`combat_sim._run_steps` + `_TEMPLATE_POWER_STEPS`) does not have.

(`test_w6_refused_rare_cards_are_absent_from_cards`) pins each out of

same as the P3 Void/Poor Sleep/Enthralled refusals).

hook** the engine does not fire (the OnPlay `Apply<…Power>` itself is

GREMLIN_MERC / HAUNTED_SHIP / HUNTER_KILLER); **zero modeled, six
refused** (I5). This batch runs alongside the engine agent (E1), so

constants were permitted here. Every one of these encounters needs more
than a name constant (a new power hook, a summon, an AI graph, or a new

`monsters` agrees with every read (move_states, random_branches, hp

HAUNTED_SHIP's Dazed add reading `card_effects=[]` is consistent with the
Phrog INFECT precedent (no disagreement). *(Historical — fixed by #200:
`card_effects` now surfaces generic MethodSpec insertions; HAUNTED_SHIP
reads `CardPileCmd::AddToCombatAndPreview<Dazed>`.)*

This is the historical W2 result, not the live frontier. FOSSIL_STALKER is
resolved by Batch 198; the fresh v0.109.1 RVAs and corrected result-group
semantics in the current-build section below supersede this old read.

Grouped blockers (each is a follow-up engine primitive, several shared):
