## W1 wave (2026-07-15) — slime family + weak pool (#138 S3)

Slice: the SLIME family (`SLIMES_WEAK`, `SLIMES_NORMAL`, `FLYCONID_NORMAL`)
plus five independent weak-pool encounters. Modeled ONE
(`FUZZY_WURM_CRAWLER_WEAK`); refused six, each with a single dominant
blocker. One additive `combat_sim.py` change: the `FUZZY` monster-kind name
constant (no engine dispatch/pipeline change).

### Modeled

- **ENCOUNTER.FUZZY_WURM_CRAWLER_WEAK** — one `FuzzyWurmCrawler`
  (`FuzzyWurmCrawlerWeak::GenerateMonsters`: a single `Monster<Fuzzy…>`,
  no Encounter-stream draw → one Niche HP roll). HP `get_MinInitialHp`
  0x25fb8e / `get_MaxInitialHp` 0x25fb9a = `[8,58,55]`/`[8,59,57]` → A8+
  58-59. Machine `GenerateMoveStateMachine` 0x25fbc8: three MoveStates,
  deterministic FollowUps, no `RandomBranchState` (census random 0). Cycle
  `FIRST_ACID_GOOP → INHALE → ACID_GOOP → FIRST_ACID_GOOP` (initial state
  `FIRST_ACID_GOOP`). `FIRST_ACID_GOOP` and `ACID_GOOP` both call `AcidGoop`
  (d__13 0x3a30a8): `SingleAttackIntent(get_AcidGoopDamage` 0x25fba6 =
  `[9,6,4]` → A9+ 6). `INHALE` (`Inhale` d__14): `set_IsPuffed(true)` then
  `Apply<StrengthPower>(7)` on self (`BuffIntent`); `AcidGoop` calls
  `set_IsPuffed(false)` before the attack. `_isPuffed` is read only by the
  animator predicates (`<GenerateAnimator>b__15_1/2/3`) — cosmetic, no
  damage/HP effect. Modeled with existing `attack` + `buff_strength` move
  kinds; accumulated Strength scales every later attack via the generic
  StrengthPower path. Guard:
  `test_fuzzy_wurm_crawler_inhale_scales_acid_goop`.

### Refusals (I5 — cited, not guessed)

- **ENCOUNTER.SLIMES_WEAK / SLIMES_NORMAL / FLYCONID_NORMAL** — all three
  blocked on the **Slimed status-card primitive**, a deeper blocker than
  #149 anticipated. Every slime except `TwigSlimeS` adds `Slimed` cards to

  `StickyShotMove` d__11 `(…, 3, 2, …)`; `TwigSlimeM` `StickyShotMove` d__13

  batch); (2) `CARD.SLIMED` is unmodeled and template-UNtranslatable
  (`card_templates.json` refused: "data-dependent branch on task at
  IL_002f") — cost 1, `OnPlay` (d__7 0x4021ec) = `CardPileCmd::Draw(0)`
  (draw 1), Exhaust. Both are card-wave / engine-primitive follow-ups. The
  roster RNG is NOT the blocker and was read: `SlimesWeak::GenerateMonsters`

  `_mediumSlimes`) and `SlimesNormal::GenerateMonsters` 0x27f194 (one

- **ENCOUNTER.SHRINKER_BEETLE_WEAK** — `ShrinkerBeetle::GenerateMoveState-
  Machine` 0x2679e8: `SHRINKER_MOVE` (`DebuffIntent(1)` → `ShrinkPower` on

  `STOMP_MOVE` (`get_StompDamage` 0x2679d8 = A9+ 14) → CHOMP ↔ STOMP

  modeled #174/#869 section below:** `ShrinkPower` was then a NEW
  player-debuff absent from the engine — `ModifyDamageMultiplicative`
  0x25205c reduces the owner's POWERED-attack damage by 30% ('DamageDecrease'
  canonical var 30). Duration: PERMANENT — the static-IL "AfterSideTurnEnd
  decrements" read was falsified live 2026-08-01 (#869): the game applies
  amount -1 (no-expiry sentinel) and the KGBFBD7L4T0T captures show -30%
  active on player turn 3+. A multiplicative damage-pipeline hook needing
  `combat_sim.py` engine-core work (E1); not guessed (I5/I7).

- **ENCOUNTER.THIEVING_HOPPER_WEAK** — `ThievingHopper::GenerateMoveState-
  Machine`: `THIEVERY_MOVE` (`SingleAttackIntent` + `CardDebuffIntent` =

  `FlutterPower`), `ESCAPE_MOVE` (`EscapeIntent`). REFUSED: three new

  `AfterSideTurnEnd` 0x24cb54 leaving combat, touching the fight-end
  condition), and `FlutterPower`. None read to completion; all
  correctness-critical.

- **ENCOUNTER.TURRET_OPERATOR_WEAK** — `LivingShield` + `TurretOperator`.
  `LivingShield::GenerateMoveStateMachine` 0x26305c: `SHIELD_SLAM_MOVE`
  (`get_ShieldSlamDamage` 6) → a RECURRING ally-count
  `ConditionalBranchState` (`SHIELD_SLAM_BRANCH`, b__15_0/1 over
  `GetAllyCount`: allies>0 → keep shielding, allies==0 → `SMASH_MOVE`
  `get_SmashDamage` A9+ 18 + `BuffIntent` `get_EnrageStr` 3, self-looping

  `Apply<RampartPower>(25)` at `AfterAddedToRoom` (d__14), `AfterSideTurn-

  A cross-monster block/redirect mechanic plus a per-turn ally-count branch,

## E1 wave (2026-07-15) — Frog Knight + Bowlbugs (#138 S3, #145/#151)

Engine-bundle batch: implemented the primitives the P1/P2 waves deferred, so
`ENCOUNTER.FROG_KNIGHT_NORMAL` (#145) and `ENCOUNTER.BOWLBUGS_WEAK` (#151) are
now modeled. Both are IL-derived and UNPINNED (no live capture yet). Census
cross-check (I1): `encounters_census.json`/`monsters` agrees with every read
below (`move_states`, `random_branches`, `hp_*_consts`, `powers_applied`).

### FROG_KNIGHT_NORMAL — modeled (#145)

`FrogKnightNormal::GenerateMonsters` (0x27e08e): one FrogKnight, fixed HP
`GetValueIfAscension(8, 199, 191)` (`get_MinInitialHp` 0x25f705; `MaxInitialHp`
0x25f717 returns MinInitialHp), one Niche draw. Deterministic (census
`random_branches` 0). `GenerateMoveStateMachine` (0x25f7b0) initial state
TONGUE_LASH; follow-ups TONGUE_LASH→STRIKE_DOWN_EVIL→FOR_THE_QUEEN→HALF_HEALTH,
BEETLE_CHARGE→TONGUE_LASH.

- **HALF_HEALTH** is a `ConditionalBranchState` (`ShouldAppearInLogs`/`IsMove`
  false → not one of the census `move_states` 4). `AddState` order
  [TONGUE_LASH(b__25_0), BEETLE_CHARGE(b__25_1)]. Lambdas 0x25fb3f/0x25fb68:
  BEETLE_CHARGE iff `(not HasBeetleCharged AND CurrentHp < MaxHp/2)` (integer
  `div`), else TONGUE_LASH. Modeled as the loop 4th-element follow spec
  `("hp_below_half_once", "beetle_charged", 3, 0)` that the engine's
  `_resolve_follow` evaluates at loop-advance. **Timing:** the game rolls a
  monster's next intent at the START of the player's turn
  (`CombatManager.StartTurn` iterates `Enemies` → `PrepareForNextTurn` →
  `MonsterModel.RollMove` → `MonsterMoveStateMachine.FindNextMoveState` →
  `ConditionalBranchState.GetNextState`, RVAs 0x43b7c0/0x2c7630/0x22d2fc/
  0x223ce0/0x223b5c), i.e. right after the monster's own action; the frog's HP
  does not change between its action and that roll (Plating gains block, not
  HP; no poison), so evaluating at loop-advance is exact.
- **TONGUE_LASH** (`TongueLashMove` d__28 0x3a2f1c): `SingleAttack(
  TongueLashDamage = GetValueIfAscension(9, 14, 13), 0x25f72c)` then
  `Apply<FrailPower>(2)` on the player → `attack_frail (14,1,2)`, enemy
  first-tick skip (`player_frail_fresh`).
- **STRIKE_DOWN_EVIL** (d__27): `SingleAttack(StrikeDownEvilDamage = 23/21,
  0x25f71f)` → `attack (23,1)`.
- **FOR_THE_QUEEN** (`ForTheQueenMove` d__26 0x3a2cb8): `Apply<StrengthPower>(
  5)` on self → `buff_strength (5,)`; its follow is the HALF_HEALTH branch.
- **BEETLE_CHARGE** (`BeetleChargeMove` d__29 0x3a2b38): `set_HasBeetleCharged(
  true)` THEN `Attack(BeetleChargeDamage = 40/35, 0x25f739)` → `attack_charge
  (40,1)`, follow → TONGUE_LASH (idx 0). Fires at most once (the flag routes
  HALF_HEALTH back to TONGUE_LASH thereafter).
- **PlatingPower** (spawn `AfterAddedToRoom` d__24 0x3a29ec: `Apply<Plating
  Power>(PlatingAmount = GetValueIfAscension(8, 19, 15), 0x25f746)`; then
  `set_HasBeetleCharged(false)`). Monster-side `PlatingPower.BeforeSideTurn
  Start` (0x2504b8): for a non-player owner, `GainBlock(Amount)` when
  `RoundNumber > 1`. `AfterSideTurnStart` (0x386e18): for a monster owner,
  `PowerCmd.Decrement` (Amount − 1) EVERY own side start (round 1 included).
  So the block granted is 0 (round 1), 18, 17, 16, … for a spawn amount of 19.
  Engine `Monster.mplating` in the monster-side-start block (block cleared
  first, then gain, then decrement — matching Before/After ordering).

### BOWLBUGS_WEAK — modeled (#151)

`BowlbugsWeak::GenerateMonsters` (0x27d4cc): slot 0 = BowlbugRock (created
first, position 'odd'), slot 1 = `EncounterModel.Rng.NextItem(get_Bugs)` where
`get_Bugs` (0x27d49c) = `[BowlbugEgg, BowlbugNectar]` — one Encounter-stream
`NextInt(0,2)` draw (the validated rats/Flyconid construction `Rng(seed +
total_floor + hash(entry))`, counter 0). Two Niche HP draws, creation order
(Rock then bug), disjoint ranges. **BOWLBUGS_NORMAL is REFUSED**: census lists
an extra `BowlbugSilk` (composition/count/moves unread), so this is the full
`_WEAK` id (SEAPUNK_WEAK precedent).

- **BowlbugRock** (0x25a01b): HP 46-49 (max 0x25a027). Machine (0x25a0cc):
  HEADBUTT (`SingleAttack(HeadbuttDamage = 16/15, 0x25a033)`), DIZZY_MOVE
  (`StunIntent`), POST_HEADBUTT `ConditionalBranchState(get_IsOffBalance)`.
  `ImbalancedPower` (`AfterDamageGiven` d__4 0x24e4f0): when the owner's own
  damage `WasFullyBlocked`, a BowlbugRock is set `IsOffBalance = true`.
  `HeadbuttMove` (d__24 0x39a37c) then, `if IsOffBalance`, calls `Stun` (d__25
  0x39a4f8) → `CreatureCmd.Stun(DizzyMove)` → `StunInternal` (0x2c75a0): ONE
  do-nothing STUNNED turn (`MustPerformOnceBeforeTransitioning`) resuming at
  the last-logged state = HEADBUTT; `DizzyMove` (0x39a2a4) resets
  `IsOffBalance = false`. This is the **exact** `CreatureCmd.Stun` one-turn
  semantics already in-game-validated for the tunneler, so it is modeled as
  the shared `DIZZY` override on a fully-blocked HEADBUTT (`headbutt` kind,
  self-loop). census `move_states` 2 = HEADBUTT + DIZZY.
- **BowlbugEgg** (0x259b48): HP 23-24. Machine (0x259c60): BITE_MOVE self-loop
  with `[SingleAttackIntent(BiteDamage), DefendIntent]`. `BiteMove` (d__17
  0x399d84): `Attack(BiteDamage = 8/7, 0x259b60)` then `GainBlock(get_
  ProtectBlock = 8/7, 0x259b6b)` on `this.get_Creature` — SELF, not an ally
  (the "Protect" name notwithstanding). A self-block attack → `attack_block
  (8,1,8)` (Nibbit SLICE precedent). No powers.
- **BowlbugNectar** (0x259db3): HP 36-39. Machine (0x259e04): initial THRASH →
  BUFF → THRASH2 (self-loop). THRASH/THRASH2 (`ThrashMove` d__17
  0x39a060): `SingleAttack(ThrashDamage = 3, both tiers, 0x259dcb)`. BUFF
  (`BuffMove` d__18 0x399f0c): `Apply<StrengthPower>(BuffStrengthGain = 16/15,
  0x259dce)` on self → `buff_strength (16,)`; the Strength scales every later
  THRASH2 via the generic path (3 → 19).


## E2 wave (2026-07-15) — Axebot respawn + Fogmog read (#138 S3, #147/#150)

Engine-bundle batch: modeled `ENCOUNTER.AXEBOTS_NORMAL` (#147) — the first
respawn-on-death monster in the sim — and fully IL-read `ENCOUNTER.FOGMOG_
NORMAL` (#150), which stays **refused** (a bigger mechanic than the wave
budget allows to model exactly; the refusal below is upgraded from "unread" to
every RVA resolved). Axebot is IL-derived and UNPINNED (no live capture).
Census cross-check (I1): `encounters_census.json`/`monsters` agrees
(`move_states` 3, `random_branches` 0, `hp_*_consts [8,86,78]/[8,76,70]`,
`powers_applied [FrailPower, StockPower, StrengthPower, WeakPower]`).

### AXEBOTS_NORMAL — modeled (#147)

`AxebotsNormal::GenerateMonsters` (0x27d1a9): one Axebot at slot `front`. HP is
a Niche `SetUniqueMonsterHpValue` roll over [`MinInitialHp` 76/70 (0x2591a9),
`MaxInitialHp` 86/78 (0x2591b5)] — A8+/else, multi-valued so one draw over the
range (`ctx.unique_hp`, NOT the single-value `ctx.fixed`).

**State machine** (`GenerateMoveStateMachine` 0x259244): three `MoveState`s —
`BOOT_UP_MOVE`, `ONE_TWO_MOVE`, `HAMMER_UPPERCUT_MOVE`. Follow-ups: BOOT_UP →
HAMMER, HAMMER → ONE_TWO, ONE_TWO → HAMMER. The **initial state** is chosen by
`_stockOverrideAmount.HasValue`: false (generation) → HAMMER; true (respawn) →
BOOT_UP. So a fresh Axebot cycles HAMMER ↔ ONE_TWO and only ever performs
BOOT_UP as a respawn opener. Deterministic (0 `RandomBranchState`). Encoded as
`AXEBOT_LOOP` idx 0 HAMMER / 1 ONE_TWO / 2 BOOT_UP with pinned successors
(1, 0, 0); `_respawn_axebot` sets `loop_pos` 2 to open on BOOT_UP.

**Moves** (A9+ / else):
- HAMMER_UPPERCUT (`HammerUppercutMove` d__32 0x39943c): `SingleAttack(
  HammerUppercutDamage = 14/12, 0x25919c)` then `Apply<WeakPower>(2)` AND
  `Apply<FrailPower>(2)` on the player → new kind `attack_weak_frail
  (14,1,2,2)`. Both are enemy-applied (`WasJustAppliedByEnemy`), so they skip
  the immediate end-of-turn tick (`player_weak_fresh`/`player_frail_fresh`),
  same as rat SCREECH / frog TONGUE_LASH. (This resolves the P2 refusal's open
  "DebuffIntent Frail vs Weak" — it is BOTH.)
- ONE_TWO (`OneTwoMove` d__31 0x399648): `Attack(OneTwoDamage = 10/9,
  0x259184).WithHitCount(2)` = MultiAttack ×2 → existing `attack (10,2)`.
- BOOT_UP (`BootUpMove` d__30 0x3991e4): `GainBlock(BootUpBlock = 15/10,
  0x259177)` then `Apply<StrengthPower>(BootUpStrGain 4/3 (0x259191) *
  (2 - StockAmount))` on self, no attack → new kind `axebot_bootup (15,4)`.
  StockAmount is the POST-decrement stock, so the first respawn (stock 1)
  gains 4·1 = 4 and the last (stock 0) gains 4·2 = 8.

**Respawn** (`StockPower`, applied at `AfterAddedToRoom` d__28 0x259200 with
`get_StockAmount` default **2**, 0x2591c4): `AfterDeath` (d__4 0x38ca20) — when
the owner dies and `StockPower.Amount > 0`: `set_ShouldPlaySpawnAnimation(true)`,
`set_StockAmount(Amount-1)` (writes `_stockOverrideAmount`, so the rebuilt
machine now opens on BOOT_UP), then `CreatureCmd::Add(this, state, side,
slotName)` re-adds the **single** `CombatState.Monster<Axebot>()` model at its
own slot. `CreateCreature` (0x2dfb88) runs `SetUniqueMonsterHpValue` for the
`side==2` enemy (0x2c71c0) — **one Niche draw** for the fresh full HP.
`ShouldStopCombatFromEnding` (0x252e73, const **true**, correctness-critical I3)
keeps combat alive across the killing blow. Modeled by `_respawn_axebot`:
inline in `damage_monster`'s `hp<=0` block (before the fatal `s.over` check, so
the revived Axebot counts as alive), one Niche `_roll_unique_hp` over [76,86]
excluding other monsters' max HP (empty for the lone Axebot), stock−−, powers
reset (fresh Creature), `loop_pos` 2, new creation-order uid. Starting stock 2
⇒ two respawns, then the stock-0 death is final (`s.over`). Gremlin Horn still
fires per death (unconditional kill-pipeline hook, existing behavior).

### FOGMOG_NORMAL — REFUSED (#150), every RVA now read

`FogmogNormal::GenerateMonsters` (0x27e02e) spawns **only** Fogmog (slot
`fogmog`, HP `MinInitialHp==MaxInitialHp` 78/74, 0x25f07b). The EyeWithTeeth
(slot `illusion`) is **summoned mid-fight**, not generated. Fully read this
wave, but NOT modeled — it is a substantially larger mechanic than the wave
budget models exactly, with no fight capture to validate against; per I5 it
stays refused rather than approximated. The read (so a future engine wave can
implement it directly):

- **Fogmog machine** (`GenerateMoveStateMachine` 0x25f0ac, census
  `move_states` 4 + 1 `RandomBranchState`): initial `ILLUSION_MOVE`
  (`SummonIntent`) → `SWIPE_MOVE` → `BRANCH`. SWIPE (`SwipeMove` d__16
  0x3a237c): `SingleAttack(SwipeDamage = 9/8, 0x25f08f)` + `Apply<Strength
  Power>(1)` self. HEADBUTT (`HeadbuttMove` d__17 0x3a211c): `SingleAttack(
  HeadbuttDamage = 16/14, 0x25f09b)`. `SWIPE_RANDOM_MOVE` shares `SwipeMove`.
  Follow-ups: ILLUSION→SWIPE, SWIPE→BRANCH, SWIPE_RANDOM→HEADBUTT,
  HEADBUTT→SWIPE. **BRANCH** (`RandomBranchState`): `AddBranch(SWIPE_RANDOM,
  cooldown/repeat 2, w=0.4)` (lambda b__14_0 0x3a210e) and `AddBranch(HEADBUTT,
  2, w=0.6)` (b__14_1 0x3a2115) — one MonsterAi `NextFloat(1.0)` draw, <0.4 →
  SWIPE_RANDOM else HEADBUTT (the `2` arg is a `MoveRepeatType`/cooldown, not
  yet disambiguated vs the constant weights).
- **ILLUSION_MOVE summon** (`IllusionMove` d__15 0x3a2220): gated on
  `IsLiveCombat`, `CombatState.Add<EyeWithTeeth>('illusion')` — a mid-fight
  creature add ⇒ one Niche `SetUniqueMonsterHpValue` over [6,6] (single-value,
  1 draw) at creation-order uid (the #131/#136 pin: never slot index).
- **EyeWithTeeth** (`GenerateMoveStateMachine` 0x25de28, `move_states` 1):
  `DISTRACT_MOVE` self-loop (`DistractMove` d__11 0x3a04dc) =
  `AddToCombatAndPreview<Dazed>(3, position 3 = Random)` → 3 Dazed into the
  draw pile at random positions = **3 Shuffle draws/turn** (the PersonalHive/
  Beckon path). `AfterAddedToRoom` (d__9 0x25dde4) `Apply<IllusionPower>` self.
- **IllusionPower** (0x24e362): `AfterApplied` (0x24e3af) applies `MinionPower`
  (secondary enemy — so when Fogmog dies the eye is cascade-killed, the GasBomb
  precedent). `ShouldAllowHitting` (0x24e42f) = false only while `IsReviving`.
  `AfterDeath` (d__18 0x3831e4): sets `isReviving`, builds a `REVIVE_MOVE`
  (`HealIntent`, `MustPerformOnceBeforeTransitioning`, follow = last logged
  state) and `SetMoveImmediate` — an **immortal illusion** that revives every
  death, like a per-eye ReattachPower.

**Exact blocker (why refused):** modeling Fogmog needs, at once, a new random-AI
weight machine (with the unresolved cooldown/repeat arg), a mid-fight summon,
a second monster generating 3 Dazed/turn (Shuffle draws), an IllusionPower
revive-with-heal (heal amount in `ReviveMove` not yet read), and a MinionPower
cascade — five interacting primitives with zero validation pin. That is beyond
a minimal additive engine edit; per I5 it stays refused until an engine wave
takes it on (the AfterDeath respawn family here generalizes GremlinMerc's
SurprisePower on-death spawn — see #162 W2 refusal — a natural follow-up
grouping).

## E3 wave (2026-07-15) — per-card-play hook + Retain (#138 S3, #153/#155)

Engine bundle E3. IL from `sts2.dll`. The "per-card-play hook layer" the
issue asked for already exists — `combat_sim._after_card_played` (SlowPower/
VitalSpark/Nunchaku-family live there). This wave adds one consumer
(GalvanicPower) and the card-level Retain keyword. Walk:
`invariant-walks/2026-07-15-16-e3-percardplay-retain.md`.

**IMPORTANT correction to the P1/W2 refusal notes.** The three powers #153
grouped as "one per-card-play class" are not the same class. Only Galvanic and
Tender fire on card plays; PaperCuts does not. The exact IL:

### Modeled

- **ENCOUNTER.GLOBE_HEAD_NORMAL** — one `GlobeHead`, fixed HP
  `GetValueIfAscension(8, 158, 148)` (Min==Max). Deterministic
  (`GenerateMoveStateMachine` 0x260124, census `random_branches 0`,
  `move_states 3`): SHOCKING_SLAP → THUNDER_STRIKE → GALVANIC_BURST cycle
  (`set_FollowUpState`). SHOCKING_SLAP (d__21) attack `get_ShockingSlapDamage`
  **14**/13 (0x2600c0) + `Apply<FrailPower>(2)` player → `attack_frail`.
  THUNDER_STRIKE (d__20) MultiAttack `get_ThunderStrikeDamage` **7**/6
  (0x2600b5) × **3** → `attack`. GALVANIC_BURST (d__22) attack
  `get_GalvanicBurstDamage` **17**/16 (0x2600cd) + `Apply<StrengthPower>(2)`
  self → `attack_strength`. All three move kinds pre-existed; no new kind.
  - **GalvanicPower** (`Apply<GalvanicPower>(6)` at `AfterAddedToRoom` d__18):
    `AfterCardPlayed` (0x24d6a0, body d__10 0x3819c0) guards on the played
    card carrying the **Galvanized** affliction, then deals Amount(=**6**) via
    `CreatureCmd::Damage(player, props **12**)`. Galvanized is afflicted onto
    the player's **CardType==3 (power)** cards only (`AfterCardEnteredCombat`
    d__9 0x3818c8: `Affliction==null && Type==3`; `BeforeCombatStart` d__8 for
    existing cards). No other affliction source in this fight ⇒ every power
    play retaliates for 6. **This corrects the W2 note's "6 per card": power
    plays only.** props 12 = 0b1100 (Unpowered + bit 8, no Unblockable bit 2)
    ⇒ **blockable**, unpowered; modeled in `_galvanic_damage` (block absorbs,
    then Centennial Puzzle / Inferno on the unblocked remainder, player side).
    Engine hook: `_after_card_played`, `m.kind == GLOBE_HEAD and spec.is_power`.
  - Census `powers_applied [FrailPower, GalvanicPower, StrengthPower]` agrees.
  - IL-only, unpinned (counter-relic precedent).

### Refused (I5) — corrected cites

- **ENCOUNTER.SCROLLS_OF_BITING_WEAK / _NORMAL** — this former refusal is
  superseded by W97/#180. The current full read models the two encounters and
  corrects the old RVAs, roster premise, PaperCuts amount, and Max-HP path.

- **ENCOUNTER.HUNTER_KILLER_NORMAL** — `TenderPower` IS per-card-play, but the
  W2 note ("StrengthPower(1) on the first card each turn; DexterityPower at
  side-turn-end") is wrong on sign, guard, and stat. IL: `AfterCardPlayed`
  (0x2544e8, body d__12 0x38f46c) fires on **every** player play —
  `CardsPlayedThisTurn++` then `Apply<StrengthPower>(Owner=player, **-1**)`
  (the player, weakened per card); `AfterSideTurnEnd` (0x25453c, body d__13
  0x38f610) `Apply<StrengthPower>(player, **+CardsPlayedThisTurn**)` restores
  it. So it is a within-turn player-Strength ramp-down reversed at the monster
  turn end, with an unresolved `CardsPlayedThisTurn` reset site — mid-turn
  negative player Strength that changes the player's own attack sequencing
  (I3/I4), plus a random-AI graph (TENDERIZING_GOOP / BITE 19/17 / PUNCTURE
  8/7×3 behind a RandomBranchState), on an unpinned encounter. Too much
  unverified surface; refused (fail loud over guess). Follow-up filed.

### Cards (#155) — card-level Retain keyword

`Card.retain` + `"Retain"` in `_TEMPLATE_SAFE_KEYWORDS`; `end_player_turn`'s
flush keeps a retained card in hand (analogous to RetainHandPower, but
per-card and every turn). `CardKeyword` Retain=5. Unblocks the cards whose
ONLY blocker was Retain (their OnPlay was already computed by the template
translator): **REAP** (attack 27/33), **SOW** (attack-all 8/11), **SNAKEBITE**
(PoisonPower 7/10), **POOR_SLEEP** (0x29254b, combat-inert unplayable curse),
plus **LUMINESCE**, **WISP+**, and Retain upgrade-levels of already-modeled
cards. Turn-end-in-hand effects (Burn etc.) and Ethereal still resolve first.

## Fable wave (2026-07-15) — ArtifactPower (#148)

Coordinator (Fable) implementation of the pilot/batch-1 waves' most-shared
blocker. All reads against sts2.dll via dump_il/dump_type.

### ArtifactPower — MODELED (engine gate)

- `ArtifactPower::TryModifyPowerAmountReceived` (0x24a254): pass-through
  unless (a) the application targets the power's Owner, (b)
  `GetTypeForAmount(...) == 2` (debuff), (c) the applied power
  `get_IsVisible`; then the incoming amount is zeroed (`default(Decimal)`)
  and the hook reports handled.
- `ArtifactPower/<AfterModifyingPowerAmountReceived>d__7::MoveNext`
  (0x37b6bc): `PowerCmd::Decrement` — ONE stack per blocked APPLICATION,
  regardless of amount.
- Debuff classification: `WeakPower::get_Type` (0x25562d),
  `VulnerablePower::get_Type` (0x2554de), `PoisonPower::get_Type`
  (0x25066f) all = 2; `PowerModel.GetTypeForAmount` defaults to `get_Type`.
  StrengthPower's sign-dependent classification is UNREAD — the
  `strength_enemy` card step now raises on negative amounts (I5 guard).
- Sim routing: all seven player→monster debuff sites (card steps
  vulnerable/weak/poison, Weak/Vulnerable potions, Red Mask, Bag of
  Marbles) route through `apply_monster_debuff`. Innate Artifact is applied
  at `AfterAddedToRoom`, which precedes the relics' first
  `BeforeSideTurnStart`, so Artifact eats those relic debuffs.

### PUNCH_CONSTRUCT_NORMAL — MODELED (first #148 unlock; payloads corrected by #802)

**#802 correction (2026-08-01, v0.110.1 re-read + live validation).** The
#148 read captured the right `GetValueIfAscension` triplets but inverted
the argument order, shipping the below-threshold tier (55 HP / 5×2 / 14).
`AscensionHelper::GetValueIfAscension` (0x10a734, all three overloads
identical) is `RunManager.HasAscension(arg0) ? arg1 : arg2`, and
`AscensionManager::HasLevel` (0x12346f) is `_level >= n` — so **arg1 is
the at-or-above-threshold value**. Live-validated against the session-7
.mcr captures (seed TQM88QFMHSQR, A10, `~/sts2-captures/2026-07-31/`
21:41–21:49, one full win + aborted attempts): combat-start snapshot
60/60 with Artifact 1, FAST_PUNCH broke 12 through block (6×2) and
applied FRAIL_POWER 1, STRONG_PUNCH hit 16 raw, and the construct's power
list never contains StrengthPower — the "ramp" in the live session was
the *player's* Strength 2. Other families' reads (Sewer Clam, Cubex,
Parafright, Stabbot Tackle) used the correct order; the inversion was
isolated to Punch. All RVAs below re-cited from v0.110.1

## Fable wave (2026-07-15) — Enthralled hand-lock (#156)

- `Enthralled::.ctor` (0x289038): cost 2, type 5 (curse), keyword 7 =
  **Eternal** — combat-inert (sole consumer `CardModel.get_IsRemovable`,
  already in `_TEMPLATE_SAFE_KEYWORDS`; census keyword name confirms). No
  OnPlay body, no Exhaust: playing it pays 2 and it discards normally.
- `Enthralled::ShouldPlay` (0x289057), consumed by `CardModel::CanPlay`
  (scan_calls) — a MANUAL-play gate, not just auto-play: returns true iff
  (different owner) OR (this Enthralled not in a pile / pile.Type != 2 =
  Hand, PileType enum pinned at "1 Draw, 2 Hand, 3 Discard, 4 Exhaust")
  OR (the card being played is itself an Enthralled) OR (the forced-play
  arg). Net: **while an Enthralled is in hand, no other card can be
  played** until it is cleared.
- Sim mapping: `legal_actions` filters plays to ENTHRALLED while one is in
  hand (the SmoggyPower skill-lock precedent); `apply_action` raises
  `NotImplementedError` if a play violates the lock (replay drift alarm).
  Potions/end-turn unaffected (PotionCmd does not route through CanPlay).

## Fable wave (2026-07-15) — HardToKillPower cap (#152)

- `HardToKillPower` (0x24dd3e–0x24dd72) has exactly TWO gameplay hooks:
  `ModifyDamageCap` (0x24dd44) — cap = `Amount` when the damaged creature
  is the Owner, Decimal.Max otherwise — and a cosmetic
  `AfterModifyingDamageAmount` (Flash). It is a per-instance pre-block
  damage cap, NOT a survive-lethal revive (the P1 refusal's
  characterization is corrected).
- Applied inside `Hook::ModifyDamageInternal` — the same stage as the
  validated IntangiblePower cap ("final pre-block damage").
- **Current-build correction (Batch 156 / #383):**
  `CreatureCmd.<Damage>d__12::MoveNext` 0x432a14 calls
  `Hook.ModifyDamage` with mask 14 for every `CreatureCmd.Damage`; DamageProps
  are listener context, not a gate. `HardToKillPower.ModifyDamageCap` ignores
  both props and powered status. It therefore caps every blockable or
  unblockable Damage command, including props-6 poison/Strangle-style damage.
  A bare `LoseHp` command remains a separate path and is not capped.
- Exoskeleton applies it innately: `<AfterAddedToRoom>` →
  `Apply<HardToKillPower>(9)`. The ENCOUNTER stays refused pending its
  remaining reads (ENRAGE amount, INIT ConditionalBranchState b__22_0..3,
  random-AI weights) — now Opus-workable content on top of this primitive.

## Fable wave (2026-07-15) — Void on-draw energy loss (#154)

- `Void::.ctor` (0x29a3be): cost −1, Unplayable, Ethereal (both already
  modeled), type 4 status.
- `Void/<AfterCardDrawn>d__7::MoveNext`: fires ONLY when the drawn card
  is this Void (`d__7::card == <>4__this` guard) →
  `PlayerCmd::LoseEnergy(DynamicVar 1)`;
  `PlayerCombatState::LoseEnergy` (0x2c2000) = `Clamp(energy − amount,
  0, …)` — floors at 0.
- **Combat-start ordering resolved** (the #154 open question):
  `SetupPlayerTurn` (d__104) = `ShouldPlayerResetEnergy` → `ResetEnergy`
  + `AddMaxEnergyToCurrent` (0x00f7/0x0109) → `AfterEnergyReset` →
  hand-draw hooks → `CardPileCmd::Draw` (0x03e4). Energy precedes the
  draw, so an opening-hand Void bites the fresh energy — matching the
  sim's existing turn-setup order exactly.
- Sim: single hook site in `draw_cards` (every draw path routes there,
  reshuffle re-draws re-fire). `Card.on_draw_energy_loss` carries it;
  only VOID sets it — other AfterCardDrawn carriers (Cacophony, W6)
  still refuse pending their own reads.

### SNAPPING_JAXFRUIT_NORMAL — REFUSED (Flyconid two-phase random-AI)

  + Flyconid (slot 1), deterministic.

  `Apply<StrengthPower>(2)` self = the `attack_strength` shape) — but it never

  `INITIAL` RandomBranchState is the machine's start state, and every move
  follows into a SEPARATE `RAND` RandomBranchState. Branches (all weight 1.0,
  all repeatType 2 = CannotRepeat; overload tokens resolved from the call sites):
  INITIAL → {FRAIL_SPORES (cooldown 2), SMASH}; RAND → {VULNERABLE_SPORES
  (cooldown 3), FRAIL_SPORES (cooldown 2), SMASH}. Move bodies: VULNERABLE_SPORES
  DebuffIntent (Vulnerable), FRAIL_SPORES SingleAttack SporeDamage + Frail,
  SMASH SingleAttack SmashDamage.
- Refusal: the existing random-AI framework (SLUDGE/RAT) starts from a plain
  MoveState (no turn-1 draw) with a SINGLE branch table. Flyconid needs a
  **distinct INITIAL branch table rolled at combat start** plus the steady RAND
  table — a new AI-machine topology and an extra MonsterAi draw at combat start,
  i.e. engine-core work (combat_sim.py random-AI dispatch), not a content edit.
  (W1's FLYCONID_NORMAL refusal is the sibling precedent.)

## 4AR4M0A4CQ live session (2026-07-15) — Flame Barrier, Unsettling Lamp, Cloak Clasp

Three live-modeled unlocks, each blocking the coached run's solves as it
was picked up. FlameBarrierPower's full read is in the "Powers ladder"
section above. Relic reads:

- **Unsettling Lamp** (hand-modeled, once-per-combat):
  `BeforePowerAmountChanged` 0x247f9c — a CARD-sourced (card arg
  non-null: potions/relics/monsters can't trigger), player-applied,
  visible, `GetTypeForAmount == 2` (debuff) application onto an
  enemy-side target without ArtifactPower latches the card as
  `TriggeringCard`; `ModifyPowerAmountGivenMultiplicative` 0x248048
  returns 2 for that card's type-2 applications (no Artifact re-check)
  until `AfterCardPlayed` 0x2480a6 finishes it — per PLAY, so a
  Duplicator replay is undoubled. `BeforeCombatStart` 0x247f73 /
  `AfterCombatEnd` 0x2480e3 reset everything. `GetTypeForAmount`
  0x22e774: positive amounts fall through to `get_Type` — Weak /
  Vulnerable / Poison are 2, positive enemy Strength is 1 (exempt).
  `HasDoubledTemporaryPowerSource` 0x24810c only skips ITemporaryPower
  wrappers — none in the modeled debuff vocabulary. Sim: `State.lamp`
  (armed) + `State.lamp_latched` (mid-play), doubling in `_lamp_amount`,

- **Cloak Clasp** (hand-modeled, per-turn):

## Fable wave: X-cost play primitive + Whirlwind (#203, 2026-07-16)

- **X-cost play path** (engine primitive): `CardEnergyCost::
  GetAmountToSpend` 0x2c7f36 — `CostsX` cards spend ALL current energy
  (`PlayerCombatState.Energy`; 0 allowed), everything else is
  `max(0, GetWithModifiers(-1))`. `CardModel::SpendEnergy` (d__337
  0x363430) stores the amount in `CardEnergyCost::set_CapturedXValue`
  0x2c7f0f BEFORE the `amount > 0` gate — X=0 plays still capture; the
  `History.EnergySpent` record and `LoseEnergy` only happen when
  amount > 0, `Hook::AfterEnergySpent` fires either way.
  `CardModel::ResolveEnergyXValue` 0x227824 =
  `Hook::ModifyXValue(CombatState, card, CapturedXValue)` — capture
  happens ONCE per play action, so Glam/Duplicator replays of the
  OnPlay body reuse the same X. Sole `ModifyXValue` implementor in the
  DLL: `ChemicalX` 0x23cce6 (+`Increase` 2 for the owner) — a REFUSED
  relic (`KNOWN_RELICS` gate), so for every playable state X == energy
  spent exactly. Sim: `Card.x_cost` flag, X captured in `apply_action`
  before energy zeroes, threaded to `_run_steps(x_value=...)`.
- **Whirlwind** (both levels): ctor 0x29a753, `get_HasEnergyCostX`
  0x29a760 true, census cost 0. OnPlay d__6 0x40ce34:
  `x = ResolveEnergyXValue`; `DamageCmd.Attack(Damage.BaseValue)
  .WithHitCount(x).FromCard.TargetingAllOpponents.Execute` — the
  command EXECUTES even at x<=0 (the `ble 190` branch skips only the
  VFX/SFX block), with hit count 0 = no damage instances.
  `CanonicalVars` Damage 5 (0x29a763); `OnUpgrade` 0x29a7cb
  `Damage.UpgradeValueBy(3)` -> 8. The issue's "upgrade +1 hit"
  question resolves as +3 damage, no hit change. Step:
  `("attack_all_x", 5|8)`.
- **Refusal corners kept loud (I5)**: X=0 with Vigor active (whether a
  0-hit AttackCommand fires VigorPower's BeforeAttack/AfterAttack
  latch is unread); enchanted/cost-overridden X-cost cards
  (GetAmountToSpend's CostsX branch ignores modifiers — Glam included,
  conservatively); Touch of Insanity picking an X-cost card
  (SetToFreeThisCombat vs CostsX unread); Havoc flipping an X-cost
  card (`CardCmd::AutoPlay` <AutoPlay>d__0 calls set_CapturedXValue
  with an unchased amount). `ResolveStarXValue` (star-cost twin) is
  #170's territory — untouched.
## C186 wave (2026-07-16) — Exoskeletons ×2 (#186, #138 S3)

Both Exoskeleton encounters fully IL-read and **both REFUSED** (I5). The
issue-#186 premise ("content-only on top of HardToKillPower, SludgeSpinner
pattern") does not survive the read: the Exoskeleton machine is a **hybrid**
random/deterministic shape the engine's random-AI machinery cannot express,
and wiring a new random-AI kind is an engine-core edit (`RANDOM_AI` /
`_RANDOM_MOVES` dispatch in `combat_sim.py`) outside a content-only wave's
boundary. Everything needed for the engine follow-up is now read; this
section is the complete work order.

### Monster read — Exoskeleton (all RVAs resolved)

- **HP** ranged **25–29** (A8+; 24–28 below): `get_MinInitialHp` 0x25d9c3 =
  `GetValueIfAscension(8, 25, 24)`, `get_MaxInitialHp` 0x25d9cf =
  `(8, 29, 28)`. Multi-valued → Niche uniqueness rolls, one per monster,
  creation order; all Exoskeletons share the range → ONE shared uniqueness
  set.
- **Spawn power**: `AfterAddedToRoom` (d__21 `MoveNext` 0x39feb8) →
  `Apply<HardToKillPower>(Decimal(9))` on itself — both tiers, constant 9
  (`ldc.i4.s 9`). The engine primitive is merged (#152/PR #185:
  `Monster.hard_to_kill`, pre-block cap for every
  `CreatureCmd.Damage`, regardless of props or powered status).
- **Move bodies** (nested `<...>d__N::MoveNext`, NestedClass table):
  - **SKITTER_MOVE** (d__23 0x3a025c): MultiAttack `get_SkitterDamage`
    0x25d9db = **1** (constant) × `get_SkitterRepeats` 0x25d9de =
    `GetValueIfAscension(9, 4, 3)` → **1×4** A9+; else 1×3. No rider.
  - **MANDIBLES_MOVE** (d__24 0x3a0158): SingleAttack `get_MandiblesDamage`
    0x25d9e9 = `(9, 9, 8)` → **9** A9+; else 8. No rider.
  - **ENRAGE_MOVE** (d__25 0x39fff8): `Apply<StrengthPower>(Decimal(2))` on
    itself — **+2 Strength**, constant both tiers (`ldc.i4.2`; the
    BuffIntent in the machine carries no amount). This resolves the P1
    wave's "ENRAGE amount unread".
- **Census cross-check (I1)** — agrees on every axis: `move_states` 3
  (SKITTER/MANDIBLES/ENRAGE), `random_branches` 1 (the single RAND),
  `powers_applied` [HardToKillPower, StrengthPower] (spawn + ENRAGE),
  `hp_min_consts` [8,25,24] / `hp_max_consts` [8,29,28], `card_effects` []
  and `summons` [] (no pile writes, no spawns). No disagreement.

### The machine (GenerateMoveStateMachine 0x25da4c) — why it refuses

States: SKITTER (loc1), MANDIBLES (loc2), ENRAGE (loc3), `RAND`
`RandomBranchState` (loc4), `INIT_MOVE` `ConditionalBranchState` (loc5,
the ctor's initial state).

- **RAND has only TWO branches**: `AddBranch(SKITTER, 2 = CannotRepeat,
  1.0)`, `AddBranch(MANDIBLES, 2, 1.0)`. ENRAGE is NOT a RAND branch.
- **FollowUps**: SKITTER → RAND; **MANDIBLES → ENRAGE** (deterministic, no
  draw); ENRAGE → RAND.
- **INIT** (slot-name lambdas b__22_0..3, 0x25dd74/0x25dd8b/0x25dda2/
  0x25ddb9): `'first'` → SKITTER, `'second'` → MANDIBLES, `'third'` →
  ENRAGE, `'fourth'` → RAND (an immediate draw over an EMPTY log — both
  weights 1.0, genuine 50/50 — at initial-intent evaluation).
- **StateLog semantics** (pins the RAND weights): `FindNextMoveState`
  0x223ce0 walks branch states until it reaches an `IsMove` state and logs
  the REACHED move (the last `ShouldAppearInLogs` state in the traversal)
  — so the deterministically-entered ENRAGE IS logged. Hence after ENRAGE
  the last log entry is ENRAGE → neither branch zeroed → genuine 50/50
  MonsterAi draw; after SKITTER → SKITTER zeroed → forced MANDIBLES but
  **still one `NextFloat(1.0)` draw** (`GetNextState` 0x224110 always
  draws once per traversal).
- Per-monster cycle: SKITTER → [draw: forced MANDIBLES] → ENRAGE →
  [draw: 50/50] → …; the +2 Strength self-buffs stack over the fight.

The engine's random-AI model (`RANDOM_AI` kinds) re-rolls EVERY living
random monster EVERY turn in PrepareForNextTurn — it assumes every move
follows back into RAND (SludgeSpinner/SoulNexus/Rat all do). The
Exoskeleton's MANDIBLES → ENRAGE deterministic follow-up means the turn
after MANDIBLES consumes **NO** MonsterAi draw; a naive `RANDOM_AI`
registration would both roll a wrong move and desync the MonsterAi stream
for every other consumer (I6). A deterministic `LOOPS` encoding can't
express the draws either. Needed: a new engine shape (random-AI with
deterministic follow-up interleave) — engine-core, Fable-tier per the
area:engine-core scheduling rule.

- **ENCOUNTER.EXOSKELETONS_WEAK** — `ExoskeletonsWeak::GenerateMonsters`

  creation order; no Encounter-stream draw (fixed composition). INIT
  starters: SKITTER / MANDIBLES / ENRAGE. **REFUSED**: the hybrid machine
  above (every monster reaches RAND within 2 moves).
- **ENCOUNTER.EXOSKELETONS_NORMAL** — `ExoskeletonsNormal::GenerateMonsters`
  0x27dbc8: **four** Exoskeletons, slots `first`..`fourth`, creation order,
  no Encounter-stream draw. `fourth` starts AT RAND: one MonsterAi draw at

  fight-start stream consumers is additionally unvalidated (the
  resume-ordering class of escalation; a live capture would pin it).
  **REFUSED**: same engine shape, plus the fight-start draw ordering.

Refusal pinned by `test_c186_exoskeletons_refused` (make_monsters raises,

## Demand wave (2026-07-16)

Three demand-driven unlocks for the live 4AR4M0A4CQ run (#202); the
fourth item found in the same scan, CARD.WHIRLWIND, is the X-cost engine
primitive (#203) and stays refused.

- **CARD.MOLTEN_FIST** (hand-modeled, both levels): ctor 0x2902c2 = cost
  1, type 1 attack, rarity 2 Common, keyword Exhaust (both levels —
  `OnUpgrade` 0x29036f only bumps Damage). `get_CanonicalVars` 0x2902e8:
  DamageVar(10); +4 upgraded. OnPlay (`<OnPlay>d__10::MoveNext`
  0x3f3868): powered single-target attack, then `Creature::get_IsAlive`
  (a kill skips the rider) && `GetPowerAmount<VulnerablePower> > 0` →
  `PowerCmd::Apply<VulnerablePower>(current amount)` — doubles the
  target's Vulnerable. The read is LIVE (a Duplicator replay reads the
  already-doubled value), the Apply is card-sourced: Artifact eats it
  (`apply_monster_debuff`) and Unsettling Lamp latches/doubles it
  (`_lamp_amount`) exactly like Bash; a zero-amount skip never latches
  the lamp (no application happens). Sim: `molten_vuln` step. The
  template translator had refused the card on the IsAlive branch — this
  hand model supersedes the refusal.
- **POTION.REGEN_POTION** (modeled): `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__12` 0x3962e8):
  `Apply<RegenPower>(target, DynamicVars["RegenPower"] base 5)` —
  census CanonicalVars agrees (RegenPower 5). `get_TargetType` 0x2578ed
  = 5 AnyAlly → the player in solo (the Blood/Strength Potion
  precedent). `RegenPower` 0x25128b: Type 1 (buff), StackType 1
  (Intensity — additive on double-drink, the RetainHandPower
  convention). `BeforeSideTurnEndEarly` (`<BeforeSideTurnEndEarly>d__6`
  0x388cd0): participants contain owner + owner alive →
  `CreatureCmd::Heal(Amount, 1)` then `PowerCmd::Decrement` — heals on
  the turn it is applied (no duration-tick skip), 5+4+3+2+1 = 15 HP
  total, in the Early cascade with PlatingPower (block/heal commute)
  and BEFORE DoTurnEnd, so the heal lands before Infection-family
  turn-end damage. Sim: `State.regen` + the Early-cascade heal in
  `end_player_turn`; matches issue #89's decomposition.
- **RELIC.RADIANT_PEARL** (hand-modeled) + **CARD.LUMINESCE** (token):
  the relic's single censused hook `BeforeHandDraw`
  (`<BeforeHandDraw>d__6::MoveNext` 0x375730) guards owner +
  `TurnNumber == 1`, then loops `CreateCard<Luminesce>` ×
  `get_CanonicalVars` 0x244a7e CardsVar(1) →
  `CardPileCmd::AddGeneratedCardsToCombat(list, pile 2 HAND, owner,
  position 1 append)`. The hook's only engine call site is
  `SetupPlayerTurn` d__104 — once per turn-start hand draw, never
  re-fired by card draws (Pommel Strike / Pendulum). Fires BEFORE the
  turn-1 draw: the token is hand[0], drawn cards append after; the
  turn-1 hand is empty at the hook, so the AddGeneratedCards overflow
  path is unreachable. A generated add is not a DRAW: AfterCardDrawn
  effects (Void) don't fire. Luminesce (ctor 0x28eb2f): cost 0, type 2
  skill, rarity 7 Token, keywords Exhaust + Retain; OnPlay
  (`<OnPlay>d__7` 0x3efe94) = `PlayerCmd::GainEnergy(EnergyVar 2)`
  (NoEnergyGainPower-gated like every GainEnergy); L1 (+1 energy,
  `OnUpgrade` 0x28ebaf) exists but nothing modeled can create an
  upgraded copy mid-fight, so only L0 registers. Sim:
  `State.radiant_pearl` (presence constant) + the turn-1 add in
  `begin_player_turn`; the token's Retain rides the #153/#155 keyword
  path, its exhaust-on-play rides `_finish_card_play`.

### CEREMONIAL_BEAST_BOSS — REFUSED (HP-threshold phase flip + Ringing card-affliction)

- `CeremonialBeastBoss::GenerateMonsters` (0x27d5e6): one
  CeremonialBeast, HP fixed 262/252 (0x25b00d).
- Machine (0x25b0f0), 6 MoveStates, initial STAMP:
  STAMP → PLOW → PLOW (self-loop, phase 1); STUN → BEAST_CRY → STOMP →
  CRUSH → BEAST_CRY (phase 2). STUN has
  `MustPerformOnceBeforeTransitioning`.
  - STAMP (`<StampMove>d__53` 0x39c394): `Apply<PlowPower>(PlowAmount
    160/150 (0x25b027))` to self.
  - PLOW (`<PlowMove>d__54` 0x39bd94): Attack `PlowDamage` 20/18
    (0x25b03a), then `Apply<StrengthPower>(PlowStrength 2 (0x25b047))`
    to self. Repeats forever until the phase flip.
  - STUN (`<StunnedMove>d__56` 0x39c6bc): clears the stun flag; no
    gameplay effect (a lost turn).
  - BEAST_CRY (`<BeastCryMove>d__57` 0x39b970): `Apply<RingingPower>`
    to the player.
  - STOMP (`<StompMove>d__58` 0x39c580): Attack `StompDamage` 17/15
    (0x25b04a).
  - CRUSH (`<CrushMove>d__59` 0x39bbbc): Attack `CrushDamage` 19/17
    (0x25b057) + `Apply<StrengthPower>(CrushStrength 4/3 (0x25b064))`
    to self.
- **Phase flip** — `PlowPower::AfterDamageReceived` (d__8 0x3870dc);
  PlowPower itself modifies nothing, it is a displayed HP threshold:
  guards target==owner, `DamageResult.UnblockedDamage > 0`, and
  `owner.CurrentHp <= Amount` (i.e. first time the beast's HP falls to
  ≤160/150); then removes every `TemporaryStrengthPower` instance,
  `Remove<StrengthPower>` (all Strength gained so far is stripped),
  calls `CeremonialBeast::SetStunned` (`<SetStunned>d__55` 0x39c2a4:
  `IsStunnedByPlowRemoval=1`, `IsInSecondPhase=1`),
  `CreatureCmd::Stun(owner, StunnedMove, followUp=BEAST_CRY.StateId)` —
  a forced move-state override — and removes PlowPower.
- `RingingPower` (0x251363, player-side, no amount): `AfterApplied`
  (d__4 0x388f20) afflicts `Ringing` on the player's cards;
  `AfterCardEnteredCombat` (d__5 0x38906c) afflicts every card that
  enters combat while active; `ShouldPlay` (0x2514cc + b__8_0 0x251528):
  a Ringing-afflicted card is unplayable once any card play by the
  owner has started this turn — i.e. **you can play only one card per
  turn while Ringing**; `AfterSideTurnEnd` (d__6 0x389168) removes the
  power at the player's turn end; `AfterRemoved` (0x251448) clears all
  Ringing afflictions.
- **Blockers**: (a) HP-threshold-triggered phase transition (reactive
  power that strips Strength incl. temporary, stuns, and rewires the
  move graph mid-fight); (b) `CreatureCmd::Stun` as a forced-move
  primitive (also needed by Lagavulin below); (c) card afflictions +
  affliction-conditional `ShouldPlay` + expiry (the #156 Enthralled
  hand-lock is the nearest primitive, but Ringing needs per-card
  affliction state, a plays-started-this-turn gate, and end-of-turn
  cleanup).

  `BURN_BRIGHT_FOR_ME_BRANCH` {alive → BURN_BRIGHT again (b__40_2
  0x266c26); died → OFF_WITH_YOUR_HEAD (b__40_3 0x266c31)};
  OFF_WITH_YOUR_HEAD → EXECUTION → ENRAGE → OFF_WITH_YOUR_HEAD.
  - PUPPET_STRINGS (`<PuppetStringsMove>d__41` 0x3adb80):
    `Apply<ChainsOfBindingPower>(3)` to the player.
  - YOU_ARE_MINE (`<YoureMineMove>d__42` 0x3adce0): Frail 99 + Weak 99
    + Vulnerable 99 on the player (three `Apply<…>(Decimal(99))`).
  - BURN_BRIGHT_FOR_ME (`<BurnBrightForMeMove>d__43` 0x3ad580):
    `Apply<StrengthPower>(GetValueIfAscension(9,1,1) = 1)` to every
    creature ≠ self (b__43_0 0x266c39) — i.e. the Amalgam gains +1
    Strength per turn — then self GainBlock 20 (inline).
  - OFF_WITH_YOUR_HEAD (`<OffWithYourHeadMove>d__44` 0x3ada70):
    MultiAttack 4/3 (0x266626) ×5.
  - EXECUTION (`<ExecutionMove>d__45` 0x3ad968): Attack 18/15
    (0x266631).
  - ENRAGE (`<EnrageMove>d__46` 0x3ad808): `Apply<StrengthPower>(2)`
    self.
  - Phase flip — `Queen::AfterDeath` (0x266afc): when the dying
    creature is the TorchHeadAmalgam: `HasAmalgamDied=1`, `Amalgam=null`,
    and if Queen's `NextMove` is the BURN_BRIGHT state →
    `MonsterModel::SetMoveImmediate(EnragedState)` — an immediate
    mid-round intent replacement, not just a branch on the next roll.
- **TorchHeadAmalgam** machine (0x26d054), initial TACKLE:
  TACKLE → TACKLE_2 → BEAM → TACKLE_3 → TACKLE_4 → BEAM (BEAM/T3/T4
  loop). TACKLE/TACKLE_2 (`<TackleMove>d__18` 0x3b844c): Attack 22/18
  (0x26cfe6). TACKLE_3/TACKLE_4 (`<WeakTackleMove>d__19` 0x3b8550):
  Attack 16/14 (0x26cff3). BEAM (`<SoulBeamMove>d__20` 0x3b828c):
  MultiAttack 8/8 (0x26d000) ×3. Innate (`<AfterAddedToRoom>d__14`
  0x3b814c): `Apply<MinionPower>` self — the existing
  `minion_cascade_death` machinery applies (Amalgam dies with Queen).
- `ChainsOfBindingPower` (0x24ad5b, player-side, Amount 3, permanent):
  - `AfterCardDrawn` (d__8 0x37d3c0): while the count of Bound
    afflictions applied this turn (CombatHistory `CardAfflictedEntry`,
    b__8_0 0x24af00) < Amount, `AfflictAndPreview<Bound>` on the drawn
    card — the first 3 cards drawn each turn become Bound.
  - `ShouldPlay` (0x24ae1b): a Bound card is unplayable once
    `Data.boundCardPlayed` is set — **at most one Bound card per
    turn**; `BeforeCardPlayed` (0x24adbc) sets the flag (dupes exempt
    via `IsDupe`).
  - `BeforeSideTurnEnd` (0x24ae50): resets the flag and
    `ClearAffliction`s every Bound card — Bound lasts only the turn it
    was applied.
- **Blockers**: (a) card-affliction-on-draw + affliction-conditional
  `ShouldPlay` cap + per-turn cleanup (the same affliction machinery
  family as Ringing above and W9's HexPower — one affliction engine
  primitive unblocks all three); (b) sibling-death phase flip incl.
  `SetMoveImmediate` mid-round intent replacement; (c) two-monster boss
  composition + cross-monster buff (trivial once (b) exists);
  MinionPower cascade already modeled. YOU_ARE_MINE's 99-stack
  Frail/Weak/Vuln are existing primitives.

### Shared-primitive rollup (work orders)

1. **Card afflictions** (Bound / Ringing / Hex-Tainted): per-card
   affliction state + `ShouldPlay` gates + expiry — unblocks QUEEN,
   CEREMONIAL_BEAST phase 2, and W9's KNIGHTS_ELITE.
2. **Forced move-state override** (`CreatureCmd::Stun(move, followUp)`
   / `SetMoveImmediate`): generic keyed seam completed in Batch 208; Beast
   and Queen remain blocked by their independent #220 card afflictions.
3. **Negative player Strength/Dexterity**: completed in Batch 207; Lagavulin
   admitted in Batch 208. Lost&Forgotten remains behind #198.
4. **Monster→HAND insertion**: AEONGLASS + Mytes (W7) + MechaKnight
   (W9).
5. **Player facing state** (Kaiser Crab only): targeted-play-tracking +
   conditional damage multiplier.
6. **Blocking mid-fight player choice** (Knowledge Demon only): a
   decision node inside the enemy turn.
## Fable wave: multiplicative damage factors — Shrink + Soar (#174, #197, 2026-07-16)

Two new multiplicative factors on the powered-attack damage pipeline (I7:
both exact as Fractions, factor order immaterial, one truncation in
`damage_monster`). Both gate on `IsPoweredAttack` — relic/potion/thorn
damage bypasses them. Note the game's own convention flip: Shrink returns
`(100 − DamageDecrease)/100` while Soar returns `DamageDecrease/100`.

- **ShrinkPower** (`ModifyDamageMultiplicative`, #174, corrected
  #869): owner == DEALER — the shrunk player's own powered attacks
  ×(100−30)/100 = ×7/10 (`DamageDecrease` CanonicalVars 30).
  Duration: **PERMANENT in the live game and current IL.** On v0.110.1
  db5d3552, `ShrinkerBeetle/<ShrinkMove>d__12::MoveNext` `0x366d68`
  loads `System.Decimal::MinusOne` at `IL_00ba` immediately before
  `Apply<ShrinkPower>`. `ShrinkPower.get_IsInfinite` `0xaad66` is exactly
  `Amount < 0`; `ShrinkPower/<AfterSideTurnEnd>d__15::MoveNext` `0x34216c`
  calls it at `IL_001e` and returns at `IL_0025` when true. Thus the move's
  `DebuffIntent(1)` is display-only, not the power amount. This corroborates
  the 2026-08-01 seed KGBFBD7L4T0T capture: the game's checksum
  full_state shows `SHRINK_POWER` applied at amount **-1** (infinite
  sentinel; the move's `DebuffIntent(1)` is display-only) and still active
  on player turn 3+, with the per-hit HP trail exactly matching ×7/10
  permanence (captures `163751.298_mcr`/`174506.939_mcr`; `mcr_replay`
  reproduces the aborted-attempt end state bit-for-bit). Sim:
  `State.player_shrink` is a presence flag for the one infinite instance
  and never decrements; restacking still raises (negative stacking unread;
  unreachable in the modeled encounter).
- **ENCOUNTER.SHRINKER_BEETLE_WEAK** (modeled): 1 beetle, HP 40–42 A8+
  (min 0x2679b5 / max 0x2679c1; below 38–40). Machine 0x2679e8:
  SHRINKER_MOVE (DebuffIntent display 1 → ShrinkPower -1 on the player;
  initial,
  once) → CHOMP_MOVE (`get_ChompDamage` 0x2679cd = 8 A9+/7) ↔ STOMP_MOVE
  (`get_StompDamage` 0x2679d8 = 14 A9+/13). Current `ShrinkMove` d__12
  body `0x366d68`.
- **SoarPower** (`ModifyDamageMultiplicative` 0x2529ed, #197): owner ==
  TARGET — powered attacks INTO the soaring owner × DamageDecrease/100 =
  ×1/2 ('DamageDecrease' CanonicalVars 50, 0x2529d5). Type 1 buff,
  StackType 2; **no turn hooks at all** — lifetime is move-managed:
  applied by JUDICIAL_FLIGHT, removed explicitly by VERDICT's
  `Remove<SoarPower>`. Sim: `Monster.soar` flag (in the memo key
  automatically).
- **ENCOUNTER.OWL_MAGISTRATE_NORMAL** (modeled): 1 owl, HP fixed 247 A8+
  (Min 0x26527e == Max 0x265290; below 231). Machine 0x26531c,
  deterministic 4-cycle from MAGISTRATE_SCRUTINY:
  SCRUTINY (d__29, `get_ScrutinyDamage` 0x2652a5 = 17 A9+/16) →
  PECK_ASSAULT (d__30, MultiAttack ×6, `get_PeckAssaultDamage` 0x2652b2 =
  4/4) → JUDICIAL_FLIGHT (d__31 0x3abae0: `set_IsFlying(true)` +
  `Apply<SoarPower>` self; NO attack) → VERDICT (d__32:
  `set_IsFlying(false)`, Attack `get_VerdictDamage` 0x265298 = 36 A9+/33,
  `Apply<VulnerablePower>(Decimal 4)` on the player targets
  (player-side SkipNextDurationTick), `Remove<SoarPower>`) → SCRUTINY…
  Exactly one player turn per cycle sees the halving (FLIGHT→VERDICT).
  Census cross-check: powers_applied [SoarPower, VulnerablePower],
  random_branches 0 ✓.

Guards: `test_shrinker_beetle_shrink_reduces_powered_attacks_permanently`,
`test_owl_magistrate_soar_halves_powered_attacks`; the W7 refusal pin
dropped OWL_MAGISTRATE_NORMAL (modeled) per its own instructions. Both
encounters unpinned (no live capture yet).

## P1 potions wave (2026-07-16)

Bundle 1 of the #138 potions blitz — 8 ids, 3 modeled, 5 refused. RVAs
are sts2.dll (`tools/dump_il.py`; OnUse bodies are async
`<OnUse>d__N::MoveNext`). Census cross-check: `potions_census.json` +
`test_modeled_potions_agree_with_il_census`.

Modeled:

- **POTION.BLOCK_POTION** — `get_CanonicalVars` BlockVar(12), var_props
  {Block:[4]} (the potentiated step, not modeled). `OnUse`
  (`<OnUse>d__10` 0x3925a0) = `CreatureCmd::GainBlock(DynamicVars.Block,
  null, 0)` on the player (TargetType 5 AnyAlly). The `null, 0` modifier
  args mean flat block — no Dexterity, the FORTIFIER precedent. Sim:
  `s.block += BLOCK_POTION_AMOUNT` (12).
- **POTION.CLARITY** — `get_CanonicalVars` (0x2562f8) DynamicVar array
  size 2: DamageDecrease-slot ClarityPower(3) and CardsVar(1). `OnUse`
  (`<OnUse>d__8` 0x392abc): `CardPileCmd::Draw(Cards=1)` on the player,
  then `Apply<ClarityPower>(ClarityPower=3)` on the player. ClarityPower
  (Type 1 buff, StackType 1 Intensity): `ModifyHandDraw` (0x24af95) adds
  `Decimal.One` — a single card, INDEPENDENT of the stack count — when
  the owner is the player; `AfterSideTurnStart` (`<AfterSideTurnStart>
  d__5` 0x37d62c) `PowerCmd::Decrement`s one stack. Net: the +1 turn-
  start draw for 3 turns. Sim: immediate `draw_cards(1)` +
  `s.clarity += 3`; `begin_player_turn` adds `1 if s.clarity>0` to the
  ModifyHandDraw total (additive with the bag relics / DrawCardsNextTurn)
  and decrements `s.clarity` at the AfterSideTurnStart hook, after the
  draw. `s.clarity` is a mutable State field → auto-keyed by `_KEY_PLAN`
  (the radiance precedent). No HP/survivability, so heal_potential (I3)
  is untouched.
- **POTION.BLESSING_OF_THE_FORGE** — no CanonicalVars. `OnUse`
  (0x25605c): iterate the HAND pile (`PileTypeExtensions::GetPile(2)`),
  `CardCmd::Upgrade(1)` each. The upgrade level rides in the sim's card
  tuple, so it persists through the pile cycle for the rest of combat.
  Sim reuses the AggressionPower per-card upgrade idiom over the whole
  hand: non-upgradable cards (`MAX_UPGRADE` absent → 0) no-op; an
  unmodeled upgraded spec raises (I5); and — like TOUCH_OF_INSANITY —
  an enchanted card, or (outside `exact_piles`) a hand card whose
  upgraded copy would become tie-distinguishable from an identical
  un-upgraded copy still in draw/discard, raises `NotImplementedError`.

Refused (IL cite + reason; no potion refusal registry, so these stay
`untouched` in the matrix — the cite is the follow-up work order):

- **POTION.ATTACK_POTION** — `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__6` 0x3922a8):
  `CardFactory::GetDistinctForCombat(3, RunRngSet::CombatCardGeneration)`
  over the character's Attack card pool → `CardSelectCmd::
  FromChooseACardScreen(1)` → `AddGeneratedCardToCombat` + `SetToFree
  ThisTurn`. Card generation from a random pool draw on the
  CombatCardGeneration RNG stream (not tracked by the sim) + a mid-fight
  card-add primitive. Escalation: card-generation engine primitive.
- **POTION.COLORLESS_POTION** — same shape as Attack Potion (`<OnUse>
  d__?` at the ColorlessPotion body): `GetDistinctForCombat(3,
  CombatCardGeneration)` over the Colorless pool → choose 1 → add free
  this turn. Same refusal.
- **POTION.BONE_BREW** — `get_CanonicalVars` SummonVar(15). `OnUse`
  (`<OnUse>d__10` 0x3927a8): `OstyCmd::Summon(DynamicVars.Summon=15)` —
  summons an ally creature to fight for the player. Needs an ally/summon
  engine primitive (the sim has no player-side minion). Escalation.
- **POTION.BEETLE_JUICE** — `get_CanonicalVars` DamageDecrease(30) +
  RepeatVar(4), TargetType 2 (enemy). `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__9` 0x392484):
  `Apply<ShrinkPower>(amount = Repeat = 4)` on the target. ShrinkPower
  (`ModifyDamageMultiplicative` 0x25205c): for the owner's POWERED
  attacks only, returns `(100 - DamageDecrease)/100 = 0.7` multiplicative;
  `AfterSideTurnEnd` decrements 1 (StackType Intensity, IsInfinite when
  Amount<0). Two blockers: (1) needs a monster-side ShrinkPower state +
  a multiplicative hook in the enemy powered-attack path; (2) 0.7 is
  NOT dyadic, so the sim's float damage pipeline (which is exact only
  because every multiplier is dyadic — the 1.5/0.75 note at combat_sim
  top) would round-diverge from the game's `System.Decimal` math. Exact
  modeling requires reworking the multiplicative damage step to exact
  Decimal — a correctness-critical `area:engine-core` change. Escalation
  (fable-tier).
- **POTION.BOTTLED_POTENTIAL** — `get_CanonicalVars` CardsVar(5). `OnUse`
  (`<OnUse>d__8` 0x3928ac): move the HAND pile into the draw pile
  (`CardPileCmd::Add`), `CardPileCmd::Shuffle` the draw pile, then
  `CardPileCmd::Draw(Cards=5)`. The explicit full-deck shuffle consumes
  a shuffle RNG stream whose variant (Stable vs Unstable) and stream
  identity are not pinned for this call site, and there is no
  fight_states capture to validate the resulting draw order. Refuse
  until the shuffle algorithm + stream are confirmed against a live
  capture (the GAMBLERS_BREW exact-piles refusal precedent, but here the
  whole deck is reshuffled).

## P2 potions wave (2026-07-16)

Bundle 2 of the #138 potions blitz — 8 ids: 1 modeled, 1 marked
ineligible, 6 refused. RVAs are sts2.dll (`tools/dump_il.py`; OnUse
bodies are async `<OnUse>d__N::MoveNext`). Census cross-check:
`potions_census.json` + `test_modeled_potions_agree_with_il_census`.

Modeled:

- **POTION.CURE_ALL** — `get_CanonicalVars` (0x2564b0) DynamicVar[] size
  2: EnergyVar(1) at index 0, CardsVar(2) at index 1. TargetType 5
  (AnyAlly → the player in solo). `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__10` 0x3930f0):
  `PlayerCmd::GainEnergy(DynamicVars.Energy=1)` on the player, awaited,
  THEN `CardPileCmd::Draw(DynamicVars.Cards=2, flag 0)` on the player.
  Despite the name there is **no heal** in the body — the tooltip is
  "Gain {Energy}. Draw {Cards}." only. Sim: `s.energy += CURE_ALL_ENERGY`
  then `draw_cards(s, CURE_ALL_CARDS)` — the ENERGY_POTION + SWIFT_POTION
  composition, energy first so a Void drawn loses from the incremented
  total. Not a targeted potion → the `("potion", p, None)` legal-actions
  branch. heal_potential (I3) is untouched (no HP capacity added).

Ineligible (marked `eligible=false` in
`tools/build_coverage_matrix.py`, INELIGIBLE_POTIONS, with the IL cite —
not a model and not a refusal):

- **POTION.DEPRECATED_POTION** — `DeprecatedPotion` (dump_il.py
  2026-07-16) has ONLY `get_Rarity` (0), `get_Usage` (1),
  `get_TargetType` (2) and the `.ctor`: **no `get_CanonicalVars` and no
  `OnUse` method at all**. Tooltip: "This potion has been removed from
  the game." With no OnUse body it cannot be used, so it is not real
  combat content and is excluded from the coverage gap (the
  deprecated/mock-row convention already used for non-combat encounters
  and deprecated enchantments).

Refused (IL cite + reason; no potion refusal registry, so these stay
`untouched` in the matrix — the cite is the follow-up work order):

- **POTION.COSMIC_CONCOCTION** — `get_CanonicalVars` CardsVar(3). `OnUse`
  (`<OnUse>d__8` at 0x2563dc's body): `CardPool<ColorlessCardPool>
  ::GetUnlockedCards` → `CardFactory::GetDistinctForCombat(Cards=3,
  RunRngSet::CombatCardGeneration)` → `CardCmd::Upgrade(1)` each →
  `CardPileCmd::AddGeneratedCardToCombat`. Card generation from a random
  Colorless-pool draw on the `CombatCardGeneration` RNG stream (not
  tracked by the sim) + a mid-fight card-add primitive — the exact
  shape P1 refused for POTION.COLORLESS_POTION. Escalation: card-
  generation engine primitive.
- **POTION.CUNNING_POTION — modeled by #138 Batch 35.** Current body
  `0x395ecc` creates 3 fresh L0 Shivs into Hand/Bottom (full-hand adds
  redirect to Discard/Bottom), lets generated-entry listeners observe those
  L0 exact instances, then upgrades only the returned locations. Both Shiv
  levels, overflow, local Phantom Retain payload, generated history, and
  ending-gated post-entry upgrade are pinned.
- **POTION.DISTILLED_CHAOS** — `get_CanonicalVars` RepeatVar(3). `OnUse`
  (`<OnUse>d__8` 0x2565e8's body): `CardPileCmd::AutoPlayFromDrawPile
  (Repeat=3, flags 2,0)`. Auto-plays the top 3 draw-pile cards — needs
  (a) exact draw-pile order, (b) an auto-play engine primitive, and
  (c) random target selection for any auto-played attacks (auto-play
  picks targets off an untracked stream). No auto-play support in the
  sim. Escalation: auto-play-from-draw-pile primitive.
- **POTION.DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION** — no CanonicalVars. `OnUse`
  (`<OnUse>d__6` 0x256651's body): `CardSelectCmd::FromCombatPile
  (DrawPile, count=1)` (player choice) → `FirstOrDefault` →
  `CardPileCmd::Add(hand, pos append)`. A player-selection-from-draw-pile
  primitive that moves the chosen instance to hand. The residual draw
  order depends on *which* instance is pulled and is NOT interchangeable
  even among identical copies (draw = [A,X,B,X,C]: removing the first vs
  second X leaves [A,B,X,C] vs [A,X,B,C], different future-draw
  sequences), so it is unsound in non-`exact_piles` fights; and no
  fight_states capture pins the behavior for `exact_piles` fights.
  Refuse until a live capture exists (the draw-pile-manipulation refusal
  family: BOTTLED_POTENTIAL / GAMBLERS_BREW-exact). Escalation: draw-pile
  selection primitive + capture pin.
- **POTION.ENTROPIC_BREW** — no CanonicalVars. `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__6`
  0x256781's body): `PotionFactory::CreateRandomPotionOutOfCombat
  (RunRngSet::CombatPotionGeneration)` → `PotionCmd::TryToProcure` while
  `HasOpenPotionSlots`. Fills empty belt slots with randomly-generated
  potions off the `CombatPotionGeneration` RNG stream (not tracked); the
  generated potion identities are not derivable and would change the
  modeled belt mid-fight. Escalation: potion-generation RNG stream +
  belt-mutation.
- **POTION.ESSENCE_OF_DARKNESS** — no CanonicalVars; ExtraHoverTips
  `FromOrb<DarkOrb>`. `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__8` 0x2567d5's body):
  `OrbQueue::get_Capacity` → `Channel<DarkOrb>` once per orb slot. Pure
  Defect/orb mechanics — the sim has no orb system (`OrbQueue`, Channel,
  Dark orbs are all absent; combat_sim lists "orb channelers" among the
  consumer mechanics that fail loudly outside CARDS). Escalation: orb
  engine primitive.

## E4 engine bundle (2026-07-16)

Three additive monster→pile primitives, each IL-verified against sts2.dll
(build in the census scripts) and cross-checked against
`encounters_census.json` / `cards_census.json` (I1). Landed with the
`monster_act` dispatch hardened to RAISE on any unhandled move kind.

### #165 — Slimed status card + insert-to-draw move kind

- **CARD.SLIMED** (`content/cards/status.py`). ctor 0x295df3 = `(1,4,8,0,1)`
  — byte-identical to Toxic's ctor: cost 1, CardType 4 (status), keyword
  Exhaust (CanonicalKeywords 0x295e10, cf. Toxic 0x299623). PLAYABLE:
  OnPlay `<>d__7` 0x4021ec = `CardPileCmd::Draw(CardsVar 1)` (draw 1), then
  the Exhaust keyword removes it. Unlike Toxic it has NO turn-end hook
  (CanonicalVars 0x295e03 is CardsVar 1, not a DamageVar) — inert while
  sitting in hand. Modeled `cost=1, steps=[("draw",1)], exhausts=True,
  is_status_curse=True`. Census confirms cost 1, keywords ["Exhaust"],
  draws true, type status.
- **`insert_draw` move kind** (+ `_insert_draw_random` helper). The generic
  monster→DRAW-pile-Random insert: `AddToCombatAndPreview<T>(pileType=Draw,
  count=N, position=Random)` inserts each copy at a random draw position
  consuming one Shuffle draw `NextInt(0, size+1)` — the PersonalHive/Dazed
  (`_insert_dazed`) + Soul Fysh BECKON path. args = (card_key, count).
- **SLIMES_WEAK/NORMAL + FLYCONID_NORMAL still REFUSED (I5).** The primitive
  is necessary but not sufficient: LeafSlimeS (machine 0x262b70) and
  TwigSlimeM (0x26e054) carry `RandomBranchState` machines (census
  random_branches 1) — the slimes additionally need per-monster random-AI
  wiring (the Mawler/Inklet primitive class) plus full move-machine + HP
  reads for all four slime types; FLYCONID also needs #149's two
  RandomBranchState machines. The Slimed inserts themselves were re-read:
  LeafSlimeS GOOP / LeafSlimeM StickyShot / TwigSlimeM StickyShot each call
  `AddToCombatAndPreview<Slimed>` at CardPilePosition Random (TwigSlimeS
  does NOT — census card_effects []). Left as `make_monsters` refusals.

### #191 — add_status_hand move kind (MYTES_NORMAL registered)

- **`add_status_hand` move kind.** `AddToCombatAndPreview<T>(pileType=Hand
  =2, count=N, position=Bottom=1)` appends N copies of the card to the
  player's HAND end. A full 10-card hand redirects the overflow to the
  discard (CardPileCmd `<Add>d__10` isFullHandAdd, IL 0x426ff4 — the same
  per-card `len >= MAX_CARDS_IN_HAND` check the card "move" op uses). The
  hand persists across the enemy→player boundary: `end_player_turn` flushes
  it before the monster phase, and `begin_player_turn` draws additively
  onto it, so the injected cards sit in the player's next hand — resolving
  the "Burn-in-hand persistence" question the W9 read flagged as unverified.
- **MYTES_NORMAL.** `MytesNormal::GenerateMonsters` 0x27e744: two Mytes,
  slot 'first' (created first) then 'second', no Encounter-stream draw →
  two Niche HP rolls (HP getters 0x2643ff/0x26440b = A8+ [64,69]). Machine
  0x264444: INIT_MOVE ConditionalBranchState (b__17_0 `SlotName=='first'`
  → TOXIC / b__17_1 `=='second'` → SUCK); `set_FollowUpState` chain
  TOXIC→BITE→SUCK→TOXIC. So 'first' opens loop_pos 0 (TOXIC), 'second'
  loop_pos 2 (SUCK). Moves: TOXIC (add_status_hand, d__18 0x3aa9d0 = 2
  Toxic to hand Bottom); BITE (d__19, SingleAttack BiteDamage 0x264417 =
  15/13); SUCK (attack_strength, d__20 = Attack SuckDamage 0x264424 6/4
  then Apply<StrengthPower> SuckStrength 0x26442f 3/2 to itself). The Toxic
  card is already modeled. Census random_branches 0, powers StrengthPower.
- **MECHA_KNIGHT_ELITE / AEONGLASS** (W9/B1's other `add_status_hand`
  consumers) are NOT registered — only the primitive they need is landed;
  their encounters carry unread mechanics (ArtifactPower + windup, etc.).

### #166 — 'haunt' composite move kind (HAUNTED_SHIP_NORMAL registered)

- **`haunt` move kind.** HauntMove `d__20` 0x3a48dc: `Apply<WeakPower>(3)`
  on the player (ldc.i4.3), then `AddToCombatAndPreview<Dazed>(get_HauntDazed
  0x26070e = 5, pileType 3=Discard, position 1=Bottom)` = 5 Dazed appended
  to the discard's Bottom, no Shuffle draw (the phrog INFECT shape). Weak is
  enemy-applied → WasJustAppliedByEnemy skips the immediate end-of-turn tick

### KNOWLEDGE_DEMON — I10 verdict: NOT a card-afflicting monster (#210)

**Question (from T200/PR #204):** the #200 census fix surfaced four
`ModelDb::Card<T>` entries in `KnowledgeDemon.card_effects`
(Disintegration, MindRot, Sloth, WasteAway), but KNOWLEDGE_DEMON is not in
`solve_fight.CARD_AFFLICTING_MONSTERS`. Does the boss insert these curses
into the player's piles mid-fight (which would make a prior fight's
Shuffle counter a baseline+k, I10)?

**Verdict: NO — leave KNOWLEDGE_DEMON OUT of `CARD_AFFLICTING_MONSTERS`.**
The four `Card<T>` lookups are choice-screen candidates, not pile inserts.
This independently confirms the B1 boss wave census note (this file,
"KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_BOSS — REFUSED"). Cites (all re-read from sts2.dll):

- **All four `ModelDb::Card<T>` sites live in one method:**
  `KnowledgeDemon::.cctor` (RVA 0x2621ec) — the static constructor that
  builds the `_curseOfKnowledgeSets` field. IL_0050 `Card<Disintegration>`,
  IL_0058 `Card<MindRot>`, IL_006e `Card<Disintegration>`, IL_0076
  `Card<Sloth>`, IL_008c `Card<Disintegration>`, IL_0094 `Card<WasteAway>`,
  each `stelem.ref` into a `KnowledgeDemon/IChoosable[]`, then
  IL_00a5 `stsfld _curseOfKnowledgeSets`. The result is a jagged
  `IChoosable[][]` of three 2-card pairs — {Disintegration, MindRot},
  {Disintegration, Sloth}, {Disintegration, WasteAway} — indexed by the
  curse counter. These are the CURSE_OF_KNOWLEDGE **choice candidates**.
- **The choice path never inserts.** CURSE_OF_KNOWLEDGE →
  `ChooseCurse <ChooseCurse>d__39::MoveNext` (0x3a6908): IL_00a2 `await
  CardSelectCmd::FromChooseACardScreen` (a blocking 1-of-2 player pick),
  then IL_0112 `callvirt IChoosable::OnChosen` on the chosen candidate.
- **Every OnChosen only applies a PLAYER power** — none touches a pile:
  - `Disintegration/<OnChosen>d__7::MoveNext` 0x3df30c IL_004f
    `Apply<DisintegrationPower>`.
  - `MindRot/<OnChosen>d__7::MoveNext` 0x3f2aa4 IL_0054 `Apply<MindRotPower>`.
  - `Sloth/<OnChosen>d__7::MoveNext` 0x4022f8 IL_0054 `Apply<SlothPower>`.
  - `WasteAway/<OnChosen>d__9::MoveNext` 0x40cbb4 IL_0054 `Apply<WasteAwayPower>`.
- **Grep-clean (both directions):** the entire `KnowledgeDemon` type has
  **no** `AddToCombatAndPreview` / `AddGeneratedCard*` / `CardPileCmd` /
  `AddTo{Deck,Discard,Draw,Hand}` / `ShuffleIn` call. The curse cards
  never enter draw/discard/hand, so they consume zero Shuffle draws — I10
  add-free. (The curse family's `OnChosen` also fires at reward-screen
  acquisition outside combat, which is deck-visible in the `.run` and
  irrelevant to mid-combat Shuffle accounting.)

Census (I1) agreement: `powers_applied` correctly shows only
`StrengthPower` (from PONDER) — the four curse powers come from the CARD
classes' `OnChosen`, not from the monster, exactly as the choice-candidate
reading predicts. **No code change**; `CARD_AFFLICTING_MONSTERS` unchanged.

### LOUSE_PROGENITOR_NORMAL — MODELED (#195; Batch 197)

- Current-build roster read: `LouseProgenitorNormal::GenerateMonsters`
  **0x27ffe3** creates one unnamed-slot Louse Progenitor. Its Min/Max getters
  **0x264a8d / 0x264a9f** give A8+ HP **138..141** (below A8: 134..136), so
  generation consumes exactly one Niche unique-HP draw and no MonsterAi draw.
- Fixed machine **0x264b44** opens `WEB_CANNON_MOVE`, then rotates
  `WEB_CANNON -> CURL_AND_GROW -> POUNCE -> WEB_CANNON`. Web wrapper/body
  **0x264c14 / 0x3abfdc** clears `Curled`, attacks 10 A9+ (below: 9; getter
  **0x264ad9**), then applies Frail 2. Curl-and-Grow wrapper/body
  **0x264c60 / 0x3abc58** gains Block 18, applies Strength 5, then sets
  `Curled=true`. Pounce wrapper/body **0x264ca4 / 0x3abe44** clears Curled,
  then attacks 16 A9+ (below: 14; getter **0x264ae6**).
- Spawn wrapper/body **0x264b00 / 0x3abb14** applies `CurlUpPower` with the
  CurlBlock getter **0x264af3** = 18 A8+ (below: 14). `CurlUpPower` is Type 1
  / StackType 1 (**0x24d264 / 0x24d267**) and scales in multiplayer
  (`ShouldScaleInMultiplayer` **0x24d26a**); the solo encounter owns one
  instance.
- Exact reactive boundary: `AfterDamageReceived` **0x24d288** requires the
  event target to equal the owner, `IsPoweredAttack`, and a non-null source
  `CardModel`. It has **no positive/unblocked-damage gate**, so a fully blocked
  hit qualifies. Its private Data stores the first exact card object; later
  hits from that same multi-hit card are idempotent, while a different card
  cannot overwrite the latch. `AfterCardPlayed` wrapper/body
  **0x24d2f4 / 0x381ab4** requires that same physical object, clears the latch,
  gains Block Amount with props 4, sets the concrete Louse curled, then removes
  CurlUp. The solver never treats that uid as sufficient provenance: before
  any card-sourced Damage mutates block/HP/latches it proves the uid is the
  top active token, resolves through every combat pile to exactly one live
  `PhysicalCard`, and matches both the complete frozen payload and a registered
  frozen source spec. Duplicate live locations, unknown specs, and spec/payload
  drift refuse atomically. Resumable attacks preserve Batch 173's preexisting
  exact null provenance only when both frozen and current forms are
  `(payload=None, uid=-1)`; null/physical transitions refuse before the attack
  frame is popped. The resumable enemy AfterCardPlayed frame freezes
  uid, complete payload, and source spec; resume proves all three against the
  still-active exact object before popping the frame or mutating an enemy, so
  a Galvanic/Centennial nested Draw cannot forge or lose the identity.
- Death clears CurlUp and its private latch before any later card callback.
  Null-card powered damage, unpowered damage, terminal callbacks, malformed
  amounts, missing/mismatched/duplicate identity, and payload/spec drift do not
  approximate this lifecycle; every such boundary refuses atomically.
  Tests: `test_batch197_louse_progenitor.py`.

## F1 small fixes (2026-07-16)

Three targeted engine fixes (#230, #233, #234). Two refused potions from
the P1/P2 waves modeled now that their blockers are cleared, plus an
energy-gate bug found during the P2 review. RVAs are sts2.dll
(`tools/dump_il.py`; OnUse bodies are async `<OnUse>d__N::MoveNext`).
Census cross-check: `potions_census.json` +
`test_modeled_potions_agree_with_il_census`.

- **POTION.BEETLE_JUICE — enemy-side ShrinkPower (#230).** P1 refused
  this as fable-tier because ShrinkPower's `(100−30)/100 = 0.7` is a
  NON-dyadic multiplier; PR #226 (Fable multiplicative wave) has since
  landed the exact-Fraction machinery and modeled the multiplier.
  `get_CanonicalVars` DamageDecrease(30) + RepeatVar(4), TargetType 2
  (enemy). `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__9` 0x392484) at IL_0052–0074:
  `target.Apply<ShrinkPower>(amount = DynamicVars.Repeat.BaseValue = 4,
  appliedBy = Owner.get_Creature = the player)`. So Beetle Juice puts
  4 stacks of ShrinkPower on the TARGET MONSTER — the monster's own
  powered attacks are shrunk (tooltip "Enemy's attacks deal 30% less
  damage for the next 4 turns"). Sim: `Monster.shrink`; the potion applies
  `apply_monster_debuff(m, "shrink", BEETLE_JUICE_STACKS=4)` (ShrinkPower
  `get_Type` 2 = debuff, so it rides the same ArtifactPower gate as
  Weak/Vuln — the WEAK_POTION precedent), and `monster_attack_player`
  multiplies a shrunk monster's powered damage by `Fraction(dmg) * 7/10`;
  block absorb uses `min(s.block, dmg)` with the int block so the Fraction
  path truncates exactly — value-identical for the plain-float path).
  ShrinkPower's current `AfterSideTurnEnd` body `0x3445c0` first checks
  `get_IsInfinite` `0xaad66`. Beetle Juice's positive amount 4 is finite,
  so an owner present in the ending enemy side reaches `Decrement`: one
  stack per shrunk monster turn. Re-application while a stack is active adds
  four to the existing finite Intensity; it does not register a second power
  subscriber, so the aggregate still decrements exactly once at each later
  owner side end. Non-dyadic factor handled as Fraction (I7); the 30 factor
  is ShrinkPower's fixed CanonicalVars.
  Guard:
  `test_beetle_juice_shrinks_enemy_attacks_and_restacks_intensity`.

- **POTION.ENERGY_POTION / POTION.CURE_ALL — NoEnergyGainPower gate
  (#233).** Bug found in the P2 review (claim convention): both branches
  did a bare `s.energy +=` without the `s.no_energy_gain` gate the card
  `energy` step has. IL verdict — the grant routes through
  `PlayerCmd::GainEnergy`, NOT a raw energy set: EnergyPotion `<OnUse>d__10`
  MoveNext (0x3936d4) IL_0049–0063 loads `DynamicVars.Energy.BaseValue`
  and the target's Player and calls `PlayerCmd::GainEnergy`; CureAll
  `<OnUse>d__10` (0x3930f0) does the same for its EnergyVar(1) before the
  Draw(2). `PlayerCmd::GainEnergy` (`<GainEnergy>d__3` MoveNext 0x43405c)
  IL_0062 calls `Hook::ModifyEnergyGain` → finalAmount, and
  `NoEnergyGainPower::ModifyEnergyGain` (0x24f835) returns `Decimal.Zero`
  when the owner is the Player (else passthrough) — so a NoEnergyGainPower
  (Expect A Fight rider, active until its own side end) zeroes either
  potion's grant. Reachable divergence: drink either the turn Expect A
  Fight was played. Fix: gate both on `s.no_energy_gain` with the
  `energy_gain_blocked` log; CURE_ALL's Draw(2) is unconditional (only
  the energy is blocked). Guard:
  `test_energy_gain_potions_gated_by_no_energy_gain`.

- **POTION.DISTILLED_CHAOS — generalized auto-play flip (#234).** P2
  refused this for want of an auto-play-from-draw-pile primitive, but the
  engine already models the single-card force-exhaust variant (`_havoc_flip`,
  pinned by the 8DVXPWUWRY capture). `get_CanonicalVars` RepeatVar(3).
  `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__8` 0x2565e8): `CardPileCmd::AutoPlayFromDrawPile
  (count = Repeat.IntValue = 3, position = 2 Top, forceExhaust = 0)`.
  The `AutoPlayFromDrawPile` signature (0x2da734) is
  `(choiceContext, player, count, position, forceExhaust)`; Havoc's card
  call site (`<Havoc>d__19` 0x429184) passes `forceExhaust = ldc.i4.1`
  (TRUE), Distilled Chaos passes `ldc.i4.0` (FALSE). So the ONLY
  differences are count (3 vs 1) and the exhaust flag. `_havoc_flip` now
  takes `count` and `force_exhaust`; the per-flip body is
  `_auto_play_flip`. With `force_exhaust=False` a played non-power card
  takes its NATURAL result pile — Exhaust-keyword cards still exhaust
  (`spec.exhausts`), the rest DISCARD (append to `s.discard`, the
  `_finish_card_play` non-exhaust branch) instead of force-exhausting.
  Powers still `RemoveFromCombat` (unchanged). The count loop stops only
  on player death (`s.over and hp<=0`), never on a mid-flip win — matching
  the `_run_steps` IsEnding rule (later flips keep consuming streams). The
  unplayable (keyword-4) flip in the discard variant is REFUSED: without
  forceExhaust, `MoveToResultPileWithoutPlaying` (`0x31b6e4`) routes
  by the card's own Keywords (ExhaustOnNextPlay/Ethereal → Exhaust, else
  Discard) — an unverified branch (I5). Every other `_havoc_flip` refusal
  (empty cycle, Smogged skill, selection step, Glam/
  Duplicator, X-cost, no hittable target) carries over. N=1 Havoc is
  bit-identical (force_exhaust=True always exhausts, same log labels; the
  Havoc pin is untouched). Per-flip target roll is the existing
  `CombatTargets.NextItem` model. Guard:
  `test_distilled_chaos_flips_three_and_discards_vs_havoc_exhaust`.

Coverage: potion modeled 23→25 (BEETLE_JUICE, DISTILLED_CHAOS). Suite:

### `weak_player` move kind + `BOWLBUG_SILK` (#238)

New `combat_sim.py` move kind `weak_player`: an enemy applies Weak N to the
player with no attack. Enemy-applied ⇒ `WasJustAppliedByEnemy` skips the
immediate end-of-turn tick, so it sets `player_weak_fresh`
(SkipNextDurationTick) — the exact `frail_player` (rat SCREECH) /
`vuln_player` (Mawler ROAR, #192) mirror, mutating the existing
`s.player_weak`. Consumes zero RNG streams. Also adds the `BOWLBUG_SILK`
monster-kind constant.

**BowlbugSilk** (census `{hp_min [8,41,40], hp_max [8,44,43], move_states 2,
random_branches 0, powers [WeakPower]}`, all re-verified):
- HP `get_MinInitialHp` 0x25a3f0 `(8,41,40)` / `get_MaxInitialHp` 0x25a3fc
  `(8,44,43)` → A8+ **(41,44)**, below (40,43).
- `get_ThrashDamage` 0x25a408 `GetValueIfAscension(9,5,4)` → 5 A9+/4.

  `MultiAttackIntent(get_ThrashDamage, 2)`; TOXIC_SPIT_MOVE = `DebuffIntent(0)`.
  FollowUps THRASH↔SPIT alternate (IL_0064-006d); ctor initial state = loc.2
  = **TOXIC_SPIT_MOVE** — the Silk **opens on the Weak**.
- SpitMove d__14 MoveNext 0x39a650: IL_0180 `ldsfld Decimal::One`, IL_018d
  `Apply<WeakPower>` on the player (Weak **1**), no attack/block/card →

- ThrashMove d__13 MoveNext 0x39a8ac: `DamageCmd::Attack(ThrashDamage)`
  IL_002e `.WithHitCount(2)` = MultiAttack 5/4 × 2, no rider → `attack (5, 2)`.
- Registration (`content/encounters/normal.py`): `BOWLBUG_SILK_LOOP =
  (("TOXIC_SPIT_MOVE","weak_player",(1,)), ("THRASH_MOVE","attack",(5,2)))`,
