## P3 potions wave (2026-07-16)

Bundle 3 of the #138 potions blitz — 8 ids (alphabetical FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE
→ GLOWWATER_POTION): 3 modeled, 5 refused. RVAs are sts2.dll
(`tools/dump_il.py`; OnUse bodies are async `<OnUse>d__N::MoveNext`).
Census cross-check: `potions_census.json` +
`test_modeled_potions_agree_with_il_census`.

Modeled:

- **POTION.FYSH_OIL** — `get_CanonicalVars` StrengthPower(1) +
  DexterityPower(1). `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__10` 0x39466c):
  `Apply<StrengthPower>(Strength=1)` then `Apply<DexterityPower>
  (Dexterity=1)` on `Owner.Creature` (the player; both applied to the
  owner regardless of the picked ally — TargetType 5 AnyAlly). Both are
  permanent Intensity powers — the exact STRENGTH_POTION + DEXTERITY_POTION
  composition. Sim: `s.strength += 1; s.dexterity += 1`. Non-targeted →
  the `("potion", p, None)` legal-actions branch. No HP, so heal_potential
  (I3) is untouched.
- **POTION.FOUL_POTION** — `get_CanonicalVars` DynamicVar[] size 2:
  Damage(12) at index 0, Gold(100) at index 1; `var_props` {Damage:[4]}
  (nonCardUnpowered = blockable, no Strength/Vuln scaling — the FIRE /
  EXPLOSIVE_AMPOULE props). `get_TargetType` returns 3 in-combat (8 out).
  `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__10` 0x394228): `CreatureCmd::Damage(Damage.BaseValue,
  Damage.Props, ownerCreature, null, null)` over
  `combatState.Creatures.Where(c => !c.IsPet)` (the `<>c::<OnUse>b__10_0`
  lambda) — 12 blockable unpowered to EVERY non-pet creature, i.e. all
  enemies AND the player. The rest of the body (MerchantRoom / EventRoom
  FakeMerchant `FoulPotionThrown` + `PlayerCmd::GainGold(Gold)`) is the
  out-of-combat "throw at the Merchant for 100 gold" branch, unreachable
  in combat (TargetType 3). Sim: each `s.alive()` monster takes
  `damage_monster(powered=False)` (the EXPLOSIVE_AMPOULE AoE — blockable,
  no Strength/Vuln, no Skittish/PersonalHive), then the player takes 12
  via `_galvanic_damage` (props-4 blockable player HP loss → Centennial
  Puzzle + Inferno, the documented player-side unblocked-damage sites).
  The game applies all creatures in ONE `CreatureCmd::Damage` over the
  Creatures list; the enemy/player order is immaterial to final HP — no
  modeled monster power retaliates on unpowered damage, and Inferno's
  player-triggered retaliation is additive (a survivor ends at hp − 12 −
  Inferno either way; a monster the direct 12 kills is dead regardless of
  Inferno order). First modeled potion that damages the player. Non-
  targeted (AoE) → the `("potion", p, None)` branch.
- **POTION.GLOWWATER_POTION** — `get_CanonicalVars` CardsVar(10). `OnUse`
  (`<OnUse>d__10` 0x394bb0): `PileTypeExtensions::GetPile(2=Hand).Cards
  .ToList()` (snapshot), `foreach` → `CardCmd::Exhaust(card, 0, 0)`, THEN
  `CardPileCmd::Draw(Cards=10)` on the player. Sim: remove each snapshotted
  live source from hand, then dispatch `_card_exhausted` before advancing to
  the next card; stop before the next command if combat ended. Reentrant
  Dark Embrace draws therefore see exact capacity and are never clobbered.
  The final `draw_cards(10)` uses the command's normal ending gate.
  Exhausting the WHOLE original hand is
  unambiguous — every copy leaves, so unlike ASHWATER's player-chosen
  subset there is no identical-copy flush-order choice and NO exact_piles
  refusal is required; the draw is the standard StableShuffle reshuffle
  path and exhausted cards never re-enter the draw pile. Non-targeted →
  the `("potion", p, None)` branch. No HP → heal_potential (I3) untouched.

Refused (IL cite + routing issue; no potion refusal registry, so these
stay `untouched` in the matrix — the cite is the follow-up work order):

- **POTION.FAIRY_IN_A_BOTTLE** — `get_Usage` 3 (a passive triggered
  potion, not an active use). Carries `ShouldDie` (0x25690f: true unless
  the dying creature is the owner) and `AfterPreventingDeath`
  (`<AfterPreventingDeath>d__10` 0x396bd8: calls `OnUseWrapper` on lethal)
  hooks; the `OnUse` body (`<OnUse>d__8` 0x396ca8) is

  the sim has no support for. Route: **#215** (survive-lethal power family
  — WATERFALL_GIANT SteamEruption / TEST_SUBJECT Adaptable). Escalation
  (fable, area:engine-core).
- **POTION.FOCUS_POTION** — `get_CanonicalVars` (0x256a90) FocusPower(2).
  `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__10` 0x39402c): `Apply<FocusPower>(DynamicVars
  ['FocusPower'].BaseValue=2)` on the player's Creature. Focus scales orb
  passive/evoke output — the sim has no orb system (Focus, OrbQueue,

- **POTION.FRUIT_JUICE** — historical P3 refusal, resolved by #250 / Batch
  191 after the shared `gain_player_max_hp` primitive made `max_hp` keyed.
  The fresh v0.109.1 body/command/wrapper reads, native-cap arithmetic, and
  unused-copy I3 ceiling are recorded in the Batch 191 section below.
- **POTION.GHOST_IN_A_JAR** — `get_CanonicalVars` IntangiblePower(1).
  `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__10` 0x394990): `Apply<IntangiblePower>(1)` on the
  player. IntangiblePower is modeled MONSTER-side only (`Monster.intangible`
  + the `ModifyDamageCap` clamp in the monster-damage path); there is no
  player-side `intangible` field and no cap on the player-damage sites
  (`_galvanic_damage` / monster attacks / `player_hp_loss`). Player
  Intangible caps every incoming damage instance at 1 (pre-block,
  `ModifyDamageCap` 0x24e951; HP loss via `ModifyHpLostAfterOsty`), and
  decrements at the owner's side end — a cross-cutting new engine
  primitive touching every player-damage site. Route: **new issue**
  (player-side IntangiblePower; fable, area:engine-core). Escalation.
- **POTION.GIGANTIFICATION_POTION** — `get_CanonicalVars`
  GigantificationPower(1). `OnUse` (`<OnUse>d__8` 0x394a8c):
  `Apply<GigantificationPower>(1)` on the player. GigantificationPower
  (Type 1 buff, StackType 1) binds the FIRST attack command via
  `Data::commandToModify` and `ModifyDamageMultiplicative` (0x24d7e4)
  returns Decimal(3) for that one command (One otherwise); `AfterAttack`
  (`<AfterAttack>d__8` 0x24d850) clears it — i.e. the next attack you play
  deals ×3, consumed once. The sim models multiplicative factors
  enemy-side only (Shrink/Soar, #197/#226); there is no player-side
  consume-once next-attack multiplier, and "next attack" binding under
  multi-hit / multi-target attacks + the I7 additive-then-multiplicative
  pipeline ordering is unread. Route: **new issue** (player-side
  consume-once attack multiplier; fable, area:engine-core). Escalation.

Bundle 4 of the #138 potion coverage swarm: 8 potions, alphabetical

LIQUID_MEMORIES, LUCKY_TONIC, MAZALETHS_GIFT → new engine-core issues;
OROBIC_ACID → #228). OnUse bodies are async — the real logic lives in the
nested `<OnUse>d__N::MoveNext` (dumped via `tools/dump_il.py`).

### Modeled

- **HEART_OF_IRON** — `PlatingPower` 7 on the player. `get_TargetType` 5
  (AnyAlly → the player in solo, the FYSH_OIL/REGEN precedent → non-targeted
  for the sim, `target=None`). OnUse d__10 0x2570d8; body
  `<OnUse>d__10::MoveNext` 0x394db0: `Apply<PlatingPower>(DynamicVars
  ['PlatingPower'].BaseValue = 7)` on `Owner.Creature`. Reuses the existing
  Gorget / `'plating'` step field: block at `BeforeSideTurnEndEarly` (before
  the enemy Infection-family turn-end damage), −1 at each player turn start
  from turn 2. `s.plating += 7`.
- **LIQUID_BRONZE** — `ThornsPower` 3 on the player. `get_TargetType` 5
  (→ player, non-targeted). OnUse d__10 0x2571e4; body 0x394f9c:
  `Apply<ThornsPower>(3)` on `Owner.Creature`. Reuses the Bronze Scales /
  `'thorns'` step field (retaliate blockable-unpowered on unblocked hits
  taken). `s.thorns += 3`.
- **POISON_POTION** — `PoisonPower` 6 on a **targeted** enemy.
  `get_TargetType` 2 (single enemy). OnUse d__10; body 0x39570c:
  `target.Apply<PoisonPower>(DynamicVars.Poison.BaseValue = 6)` by
  `Owner.Creature`. A player-originated type-2 debuff, so it routes through
  the ArtifactPower gate (`apply_monster_debuff(m, "poison", 6)`), exactly
  like Weak/Vuln. PoisonPower stacks **additively** and the existing
  `AfterSideTurnStart` tick/Decrement (0x3874ec) already drains it — so
  re-application on an already-poisoned monster is exact and needs **no**
  ordering refusal (contrast BEETLE_JUICE/ShrinkPower, whose own-hook vs
  duration-tick order is unread). Added to the targeted-potion
  `legal_actions` branch alongside WEAK/FIRE/VULN/BEETLE_JUICE.

### Refused (I5 — refuse-don't-guess, each routed)

- **KINGS_COURAGE** — `ForgeCmd::Forge(15, player)` (OnUse d__10 0x394eac).
  `<Forge>d__2::MoveNext` 0x432b78: if the player has no `SovereignBlade`,
  `CreateCard<SovereignBlade>` + `AddGeneratedCardToCombat(HAND)`, then
  `IncreaseSovereignBladeDamage(15)` (`SovereignBlade::AddDamage` — a mutable
  per-instance damage payload) + `Hook::AfterForge`. The Forge/SovereignBlade
  weapon-card system (generated dynamic-damage card + `CreatedThroughForge`
  flag + AfterForge hook) is unmodeled → **new issue #257** (fable,
  engine-core, content).
- **LIQUID_MEMORIES** — pick 1 card from the DISCARD pile
  (`GetPile(3)` → `CardSelectCmd::FromCombatPile`), `SetToFreeThisTurn`,
  move to HAND (`CardPileCmd::Add(2)`) (OnUse d__6 0x395098). Needs a
  turn-scoped free-cost payload (engine only has `SetToFreeThisCombat` =
  permanent, via TOUCH_OF_INSANITY), player selection from the discard pile,
  and the identical-copy tie-distinguishability refusal → **new issue #258**
  (fable, engine-core).
- **LUCKY_TONIC** — `Apply<BufferPower>(1)` on the player (OnUse d__10
  0x39523c). `BufferPower::ModifyHpLostAfterOstyLate` 0x24a955 zeroes the
  next HP-loss instance targeting the owner; `AfterModifyingHpLostAfterOsty`
  d__5 0x24a968 decrements a stack per negated instance. Player-side HP-loss
  negation (distinct from #215 survive-lethal and #251 player Intangible) is

- **MAZALETHS_GIFT** — `Apply<RitualPower>(1)` on the **player** (OnUse d__10

  on the monster side; player-side Ritual is a new keyed field + turn-end
  Strength tick → **new issue #256** (fable, engine-core).
- **OROBIC_ACID** — `RunRngSet::get_CombatCardGeneration` +
  `CardFactory::GetDistinctForCombat` ×3 (Attack/Skill/Power pools, each
  `Where`-filtered by type), adding a random card of each type to hand, free
  this turn (OnUse d__6 0x395468). The CombatCardGeneration-stream
  card-generation family → **#228** (existing).

## E-TL wave (2026-07-16)

Per-event trigger-hook layer BASE (#173) + **Afterimage** as the first card
modeled on it. Serialized engine-core slot; IL verified independently with the
repo tools (dump_type.py + a NestedClass-table walk for the async body).

### The layer

`CombatState::IterateHookListeners` (**0x2dffd1**) enumerates hook listeners in
a canonical order, per creature, players+allies BEFORE enemies: (1) the
creature's Powers in application order, (2) the creature model, (3) player
only: Relics -> PotionSlots -> Orbs -> card piles. Every `Hook::<Event>`
dispatcher walks that same sequence, so a PLAYER power fires before every ENEMY
hook and before the player's own relics.

The sim keeps each power as a scalar `State` field (I2) and cannot honour
application order among same-creature powers directly. The base
(`_powers_before_card_played` / `_powers_after_card_played`) fires the modeled
PLAYER powers at each event in a FIXED sequence — sound only under a per-pair
commutation audit (invariant-walks/2026-07-16-18-e-tl-trigger-layer.md): every
pair that can co-activate at one event must commute or the second-to-fire must
raise (I5). `_after_card_played` now fires the player-power hooks FIRST, then
calls `_after_card_played_body` (enemy powers + relics, unchanged placement) —
the design's "player powers -> monster powers -> relics" order. Threaded through
all three play sites (main loop, select-resume, Havoc/Distilled-Chaos flip);
the BeforeCardPlayed latch rides on `State.pending` (int, hashable).

### Afterimage (`AfterimagePower`)

- Type/StackType: `get_Type` **0x24a0a9** -> 1 (buff); `get_StackType`
  **0x24a0ac** -> 1 (Intensity = additive).
- `BeforeCardPlayed` **0x24a0c8**: owner gate, then
  `amountsForPlayedCards.Add(card, get_Amount)` — **latches the current Amount
  at play START**.
- `AfterCardPlayed` async body = nested `<AfterCardPlayed>d__9::MoveNext`
  **0x37b270** (outer builder 0x24a114): owner gate,
  `amountsForPlayedCards.Remove(card, out amount)` (the .NET remove-and-out
  overload), `amount > 0` gate, then `CreatureCmd::GainBlock(owner, amount,
  prop 4, null, 1)`. **Prop 4 = relic-style block: NO Dexterity, NO Unmovable,
  NO Frail** (the Anchor/FeelNoPain rule) -> a flat `s.block += amount`.

Latch consequences (modeled exactly): casting Afterimage grants nothing (Before
saw amount 0; the +1 lands later in OnPlay), a second cast grants the OLD
amount and stacks to 2, and each duplicate play grants the latch again
(per-CardPlay Add/Remove). Admitted to CARDS via the template layer by mapping
`("AfterimagePower","self") -> "afterimage"` in `_TEMPLATE_POWER_STEPS`; the
card's own census hooks are `[]` so the hook-gate always passed.

Coverage: card modeled 157→158 / rare untouched 60→59 (CARD.AFTERIMAGE). Suite:
261 passed, 2 skipped (+1 behavioral test; W6 refusal pin narrowed — AFTERIMAGE
removed — and STRENGTHENED with a positive admission+effect pin). No
fight_states pin weakened. The other 7 #173 cards stay refused (follow-up
waves).

  (MoveNext 0x368b5c): guard `participants.Contains(owner.Creature)` and
  `PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber <= 1` (IL_004d `ble.s`), then
  `for i in 0..Lightning: Channel<LightningOrb>(owner)` (IL_0069

  Lightning orb at the start of turn 1**. Awaits O1 `channel()` + a turn-1

- **RELIC.INFUSED_CORE** — `get_Rarity` 0x23fac5 = 1; CanonicalVars 0x23fac8

## CW2 card wave (2026-07-16)

Second card wave on the #173 per-event trigger layer: the **AfterBlockGained /
BeforeHandDraw / ModifyHpLost / ModifyCardPlayCount** power families. Slice
built from the census (every card whose applied `PowerCmd::Apply<XPower>` hosts
one of those hooks, DLL TypeDef/MethodDef scan). **0 modeled, 10 refused** —
each needs a new `State` field plus a new hook site or pipeline stage, i.e. a
`combat_sim.py` edit CW2 is forbidden to make; so this is reads-and-refusal-specs
only (docs + one refusal test). All RVAs read in full, async bodies via the
NestedClass table. Walk + full commutation audits:
`invariant-walks/2026-07-16-23-cw2-block-draw-modifier-hooks.md`. Filed three
new trigger-layer-event primitives (**#267** AfterBlockGained, **#268**
BeforeHandDraw, **#269** ModifyCardPlayCount, all `blocked_by` #138); Buffer
awaits **#255**, Apparition **#251**, Call of the Void also **#228**.

### The player HP-loss pipeline (Buffer, the closest-review item)

`Hook::ModifyHpLost` (**0x2afc58**) runs four stages in fixed order over
`IterateHookListeners` (0x2dffd1): (1) `ModifyHpLostBeforeOsty` [HardenedShell],
(2) `ModifyHpLostBeforeOstyLate`, (3) `ModifyHpLostAfterOsty`
[**IntangiblePower**/Apparition, Slippery, TungstenRod, BeatingRemnant],
(4) `ModifyHpLostAfterOstyLate` [**BufferPower**/Buffer, TheBoot]. After each
listener the orchestrator adds it to the modifiers list only if
`Decimal.Truncate(before) != Decimal.Truncate(after)`, and only those get their
`AfterModifying…` hook — the gate that makes a fully-blocked (0) hit spend no
Buffer stack.

- **BufferPower** (get_Type 1 / StackType 1, 0x24a94f/0x24a952):
  `ModifyHpLostAfterOstyLate` **0x24a955** returns `Decimal.Zero` when the loser
  is the owner (negates the whole instance), else the amount unchanged.
  `AfterModifyingHpLostAfterOsty` d__5 (0x24a968 / MoveNext 0x37c854) →
  `PowerCmd::Decrement` (one stack per negated instance). No `AfterSideTurnEnd`
  → **persists until consumed**.
- **Ordering (from the stage sequence, not application history):**
  - **vs Intangible** — Intangible caps owner HP-loss to 1 at stage 3
    (`ModifyHpLostAfterOsty` 0x24e915, when `amount ≥ 1`); Buffer negates the
    remaining 1 to 0 at stage 4 and spends one stack; Intangible unchanged (it
    decrements at AfterSideTurnEnd, its AfterModifying 0x24e944 is only Flash).
    Fixed: Osty before OstyLate.
  - **vs HardToKill** — HardToKillPower has **no** ModifyHpLost hook (DLL scan;
    combat_sim.py:1595); it only owns `ModifyDamageCap` 0x24dd44 (pre-block,
    pre-pipeline), so it never shares a stage with Buffer — cap → block → Osty
    stages → Buffer negate, no ambiguity.
  - **within stage 4** — the only other modeled participant is the relic
    TheBoot; player powers precede relics (0x2dffd1) so Buffer fires first
    (TheBoot out of CW2 scope, flagged for #255). No two modeled player powers
    share stage 4.

### Historical refusals (resolved entries point at their closing batch)

- **BEACON_OF_HOPE** — **resolved by Batch 277 / #1169**. Current ctor
  **0xdc2a6**, MultiplayerOnly getter **0xdc2b3**, and
  `BeaconOfHopePower` Type/StackType **0xa328f/0xa3292**.
  Exact `AfterBlockGained` d__8 **0x333438** gates
  `amount ≥ 1`, `amountToGive = amount × 0.5`, if `≥ 1` grant props-4 block to
  each teammate matching b__8_0 (0x24a61b: alive, IsPlayer, `!= owner`); latches
  `_hasAlreadyBeenGivenBlock` (0x24a5b1). The old #267 solo-no-op conclusion
  is **superseded by #439**: `get_MultiplayerConstraint` is
  MultiplayerOnly, so a legal context can contain another player teammate and
  make the grant observable. Batch 277 adds the exact teammate Block quotient,
  complete remote hook boundary, and acquisition-ordered local dispatch.
- **JUGGERNAUT** (ctor 0x28df13, power 2) — `JuggernautPower` (Type/StackType 1).
  `AfterBlockGained` 0x24ebf8 → d__4 0x384218: gate `amount > 0`, block-gainer
  `== owner`, pick a random `HittableEnemies` member via
  `RunRngSet::get_CombatTargets .NextItem` → `CreatureCmd::Damage(enemy, Amount,
  props 4, owner)`. RNG (I6): CombatTargets (modeled). → **#267**.
- **CALL_OF_THE_VOID** (ctor 0x284f6c, power 1; upgrade Innate) —
  `CallOfTheVoidPower` (Type/StackType 1). `BeforeHandDraw` 0x24ad08 → d__6
  0x37d1dc: for `Amount` iterations `CardFactory::GetDistinctForCombat(player, 1,
  get_CombatCardGeneration).First()`, apply keyword 2 (Ethereal), add to hand.
  CombatCardGeneration stream → **#228** family + **#268**.
- **FOREGONE_CONCLUSION** (ctor 0x28ad31, skill 1) — `ForegoneConclusionPower`
  (Type/StackType 1). `BeforeHandDraw` 0x24d1b4 → d__4 0x381078:
  `CardPileCmd::ShuffleIfNecessary` (Shuffle, I6) then a `CardSelectorPrefs` over
  `GetPile(1)` (DRAW pile) sized by `get_Amount` — a player draw-pile selection
  at turn start. → **#268**.
- **BUFFER** (ctor 0x284673, power 2) — see the pipeline section above. → **#255**.
- **APPARITION** (ctor 0x2823b2, skill 1, Ethereal+Exhaust) — applies
  `IntangiblePower` on the PLAYER (the class the sim models only on monsters as
  `m.intangible`): needs the player side of `ModifyDamageCap` 0x24e951 (cap
  incoming to 1, pre-block) + `ModifyHpLostAfterOsty` 0x24e915 (cap HP loss to 1)
  + AfterSideTurnEnd decrement + Ethereal. The player damage path has no such
  hook today. → **#251**.
- **BURST** (ctor 0x284b9a, skill 1) — `BurstPower.ModifyCardPlayCount` 0x24aa85:
  owner **Skill** (Type 2) → `playCount + 1`. AfterModifyingCardPlayCount d__5
  0x37cbe8 `PowerCmd::Decrement`; AfterSideTurnEnd d__6 0x37ccac `Remove` when
  owner ∉ ending side (survives own turn end, removed at enemy side end —
  FlameBarrier shape). → **#269**.
- **ONE_TWO_PUNCH** (ctor 0x2912d7, skill 1) —
  `OneTwoPunchPower.ModifyCardPlayCount` 0x24fc0c: owner **Attack** (Type 1) →
  +1; Decrement per use; AfterSideTurnEnd expiry. → **#269**.
- **SIGNAL_BOOST** (ctor 0x295b50, skill 1, Exhaust) —
  `SignalBoostPower.ModifyCardPlayCount` 0x25221d: owner **Power** (Type 3) → +1;
  Decrement per use; **no** AfterSideTurnEnd (persists). Doubling a power is the
  refused `s.duplication and spec.is_power` path (combat_sim.py:4421). → **#269**.
- **ECHO_FORM** (ctor 0x288bde, power 3, Ethereal) —
  `EchoFormPower.ModifyCardPlayCount` 0x24c8d0: any type; +1 while
  `CardPlaysStarted.Count(Actor==owner && CardPlay.IsFirstInSeries &&
  HappenedThisTurn) < Amount` (b__4_0 0x24c936). **No** stack consumption / **no**
  AfterSideTurnEnd — permanent, "first N cards each turn" via the turn-scoped
  history count. Power-replay inherits the same refusal. → **#269**.

All four ModifyCardPlayCount powers add a constant **+1** to the sim's
`plays = 1 + glam + s.duplication` (combat_sim.py:4430), additive with
Duplicator and Glam and disjoint from PenNib (full audit in the walk).

Coverage: no matrix delta — per the W6 precedent the `refused` status is only
populated from `card_templates.json["refused"]`, and these power-hosted

Beacon/Buffer/Burst/CallOfTheVoid pins). Suite: 262 passed, 2 skipped (+1 test;
baseline 261/2). No `combat_sim.py` / `content` / fight_states change; no pin

## O1 orb engine (2026-07-16)

The Defect/Necrobinder orb + Focus primitive (issue #239), implemented in
`combat_sim.py`. This is the ENGINE only — no card/potion/relic channels an
orb yet (#240 is the content fan-out), so in every fight the sim currently
accepts `orbs` stays empty and both turn walks are no-ops. All RVAs sts2.dll
(census build), each read this sitting with the repo tools; the full lifecycle
design is #235, the invariant walk is
`invariant-walks/2026-07-16-19-o1-orb-engine.md`.

### State (memo key, I2)

`orb_slots` (OrbQueue.Capacity 0..10), `orbs` (queue-order tuple of
`(kind, val)`; `val` = Dark evoke accumulator / Glass raw `_passiveVal`, else
None), `focus` (FocusPower.Amount, may be negative), `temp_focus`
(TemporaryFocusPower contribution, expires at own AfterSideTurnEnd). Plus the
per-fight CONSTANT `orb_base_slots` (CharacterModel.BaseOrbSlotCount: 0 for
Necrobinder / base `0x22960e`, 3 for Defect `0x280b6f`), in `_KEY_CONSTANTS`.

### Lifecycle

- **channel(kind)** `OrbCmd/<Channel>d__3 0x436964` (v0.109): the sole
  combat-over guard is at entry (IL `0029–0035`) →
  zero-slot bootstrap (`BaseOrbSlotCount==0 AND Capacity==0 → AddSlots 1`,
  IL_0071/007e/008c — orbs are NOT Defect-gated, a zero-base character reaches
  the system here) → auto-evoke the OLDEST orb when full (`Count>=Capacity →
  EvokeNext dequeue`, IL `011f–0181`) → **even if that awaited evoke makes
  combat terminal, continue without another terminal check** → TryEnqueue
  (IL `0186–01f9`; `false iff Capacity==0`, silent
  no channel/history/hook, `0x2c2440`) → on success AfterOrbChanneled
  (history IL `0204–021a`, hook IL `025c–02c8`). Capacity-0 for a nonzero-base
  character (slots stripped) is a silent no-op. The lethal-full-queue
  continuation and the still-valid entry-terminal no-op are pinned by #449.
- **evoke_next / evoke_last** `OrbCmd::EvokeNext 0x2dc298 / EvokeLast
  0x2dc2ec → Evoke(First/Last, dequeue) <Evoke>d__6 0x43319c`: dequeue, run
  `orb.Evoke(ctx)`, AfterOrbEvoked. **Evoke never fires the passive.**
- **add_orb_slots** `OrbCmd::AddSlots 0x2dc118`: `Min(10-Capacity, n)`, cap 10.
  **remove_orb_slots** `RemoveSlots 0x2dc190 → RemoveCapacity 0x2c2402`:
  `Capacity=Max(0,Capacity-n)`, drop the RIGHTMOST orbs until `Count<=Capacity`
  — silent, NO evoke, NO hook.

### Turn ordering

- **Turn end**: `orb_turn_end_passives` runs FIRST in DoTurnEnd
  (`<DoTurnEnd>d__128` IL_0042) — after BeforeSideTurnEnd hooks
  (plating/regen/cloak_clasp/templates), before turn-end-in-hand / ethereal /
  flush, and before `temp_focus` expiry (Phase Two). `OrbQueue::BeforeTurnEnd
  0x2c24bc` snapshots `Orbs.ToList()`; Lightning/Frost/Dark/Glass override
  `BeforeTurnEndOrbTrigger` (Plasma does not — it is turn-START).
- **Turn start**: `orb_turn_start_passives` (Plasma only) runs AFTER
  `Hook::AfterSideTurnStart` (`OrbQueue::AfterTurnStart 0x2c2508`).
- **TriggerPassive** `<TriggerPassive>d__74 0x364370`:
  `count=ModifyOrbPassiveTriggerCount(1)` then fires the passive `count`
  times; O1 count≡1 (GoldPlatedCables is #240).

### Values and Focus

`orb_value(base) = max(0, base + focus + temp_focus)` — the ModifyOrbValue
clamp, applied PER READ (`FocusPower::ModifyOrbValue 0x24d11f`, owner-gated,
AllowNegative). temp Focus is live during the turn-end passives. Base values
(all type-4 damage/block, IsPoweredAttack false ⇒ NO Strength/Vulnerable):

| Orb | Passive (turn end unless noted) | Evoke | Focus |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lightning | 3 dmg, 1 CombatTargets.NextItem roll (null target) | 8 dmg, same 1 roll | yes |
| Frost | 2 block to owner | 5 block | yes |
| Dark | `_evokeVal += ModifyOrbValue(6)` (init raw 6) | `MinBy(CurrentHp)` enemy takes raw `_evokeVal` | accumulation only |
| Plasma | GainEnergy(1) at turn START (raw One, bypasses ModifyOrbValue) | GainEnergy(2) | NO |
| Glass | snapshot ModifyOrbValue(`_passiveVal` init 4); ≤0 → skip; else raw `_passiveVal-=1` + snapshot AoE | `2×PassiveVal` AoE | yes |

Plasma routes through `PlayerCmd::GainEnergy`, so `NoEnergyGainPower` zeroes it
(#233). 5-orb random pool `OrbModel::_validOrbs 0x22db20` =
[Lightning, Frost, Dark, Plasma, Glass].

### RNG (I6)

The only orb RNG consumer is Lightning's null-target
`CombatTargets.NextItem` (`ApplyLightningDamage <...>d__15 0x3980cc`
IL_008e-00aa): **one draw per activation** (turn-end passive or evoke) over
hittable opponents; empty pool → None, no draw (`_roll_target`). Frost/Plasma
are target-free; Dark evoke is deterministic MinBy; Glass is AoE — none draws.

### Hardening (I5)

`channel`/dispatch RAISE on any kind outside the 5. The unmodeled hook
listeners (Metronome / ThunderPower / StormPower / GoldPlatedCables /
LightningRodPower / InfusedCore / HibernatePower) are all outside
`KNOWN_RELICS`/`CARDS`/the power vocabulary, so any fight carrying one is
already refused at `start_combat` (I8/I1); O1's hook stubs
(`_orb_after_channeled`, `_orb_after_evoked`, `_orb_passive_trigger_count`,
`orb_value`) are exactly-correct no-ops for accepted fights and mark the #240
wire-in sites. No coverage-matrix delta; no fight_states pin references an
orb id.

## O2 orb content wave (2026-07-16)

First orb/Focus content fan-out (#240, #138) on the O1 engine primitive
(#239). All RVAs read this sitting with dump_il.py; walk in
`invariant-walks/2026-07-16-26-o2-orb-content.md`. Shipped: FOCUSED_STRIKE,
HOTFIX, FOCUS_POTION, ESSENCE_OF_DARKNESS (Tier 1, closes #240) plus ZAP,
BALL_LIGHTNING, RAINBOW (plain-channel cards). Not reached (still refused):
TeslaCoil/Tempest/Voltaic; Thunder/Storm/LightningRod; Cracked/Infused Core,
Metronome, Gold Plated Cables.

### Focus consumers (temp / permanent)

- **FocusedStrike** (`.ctor 0x28ab07`, CanonicalVars `0x28ab44` = Damage 9 +
  FocusPower 1; OnUpgrade `0x28abc3` Damage +2 / FocusPower +1; Strike tag
  `0x28ab14`). OnPlay `<OnPlay>d__7::MoveNext 0x3e57e0`:
  `DamageCmd::Attack(Damage) FromCard Targeting(target)` then
  `Apply<FocusedStrikePower>(FocusPower, owner)`. Model:
  `[("attack", 9|11, 1), ("temp_focus", 1|2)]`, strike_tag.
- **Hotfix** (`.ctor 0x28d126`, CanonicalVars `0x28d15c` = FocusPower 2;
  keyword Exhaust `0x28d154`; OnUpgrade `0x28d1bb` = RemoveKeyword(1)). OnPlay
  `<OnPlay>d__7::MoveNext 0x3ebb28`: `Apply<HotfixPower>(FocusPower 2, owner)`,
  no damage. Model: `[("temp_focus", 2)]`, is_skill, exhausts (L0 only).
- **FocusedStrikePower / HotfixPower** extend **TemporaryFocusPower**
  (BeforeApplied `d__20 0x38eff4` applies FocusPower(+n); AfterSideTurnEnd
  `d__22 0x38ee7c` removes self + FocusPower(−n)) → the `temp_focus` field:
  focus += n on play, −= n at the owner's turn end (cleared with temp_strength
  at the AfterSideTurnEnd site, LIVE for that turn's turn-end orb passives —
  #235 finding 4).
- **FocusPotion** OnUse `<OnUse>d__10::MoveNext 0x39402c`:
  `Apply<FocusPower>(FocusPower var 2, owner)` — permanent (no decay) →
  `s.focus += 2` (`FOCUS_POTION_FOCUS`). Census CanonicalVars FocusPower 2.

### Orb channels

- **EssenceOfDarkness** OnUse `<OnUse>d__8::MoveNext 0x3938f4`:
  `count = OrbQueue.Capacity` snapshot BEFORE the loop (IL_002e-0033), then
  `for i in 0..count: Channel<DarkOrb>` (IL_0041 body, `blt` IL_00c0). count =
  the orb-slot count AT USE TIME → on a 0-slot character (Ironclad/Necrobinder)
  it is 0 and **NOTHING channels** — the Channel-internal zero-slot bootstrap
  is never reached (the loop body never runs). Census tooltip "Channel a Dark
  for each of your Orb Slots" confirms it; var-less. Model:
  `for _ in range(s.orb_slots): channel(DARK)`. **This is the exact IL
  resolution of #235 finding 1's Essence example — 0, not 1.**
- **Zap** (`.ctor 0x29ae05`; OnPlay `d__3 0x40da88` `Channel<LightningOrb>`;
  OnUpgrade `0x29ae83` cost 1→0). Model `[("channel","LIGHTNING",1)]`.
- **BallLightning** (`.ctor 0x282a63`; OnPlay `d__5 0x3d0e64` `Attack(Damage)
  FromCard` then `Channel<LightningOrb>`; OnUpgrade `0x282afb` Damage 7→10).
  Model `[("attack",7|10,1), ("channel","LIGHTNING",1)]` — attack first.
- **Rainbow** (`.ctor 0x2932ec`; OnPlay `d__5 0x3fb04c` `Channel<LightningOrb>`
  → `<FrostOrb>` → `<DarkOrb>` one each; OnUpgrade `0x29337f` RemoveKeyword(1)).
  Model three ordered channel steps, is_skill, exhausts (L0 only).

### Base orb slots (I8 seeding)

`CharacterModel::get_BaseOrbSlotCount` default `0x22960e` = 0 (Ironclad /
Necrobinder / every non-Defect character); `Defect::get_BaseOrbSlotCount`
`0x280b6f` = 3. Because every card/potion above is Defect-pool, an accepted
fight can begin with a Defect character, so `start_combat` seeds
`orb_base_slots`/`orb_slots` from the run's character
(`_CHARACTER_BASE_ORB_SLOTS`, Defect 3 else 0) — threaded from `solve_fight`
(run.character) and `mcr_replay` (save `character_id`). When the character is
undetermined AND slot-sensitive content is present
(`_ORB_SLOT_SENSITIVE_POTIONS`/`_CARDS`), start_combat REFUSES rather than
default to 0 and mis-model a Defect fight. Strengthened refusal pins: W4
(FocusedStrike/Hotfix) and P3 (Focus Potion) refusal lists lost those ids to
positive `test_o2_*` pins.

## O5 seven-card orb channel fanout (2026-07-18)

Batch 18 / #138 admits seven bounded Defect cards on the existing orb engine,
after #449/#450 corrected current-build Channel terminal continuation. Source:
v0.109.0 / `c12f634d`, archived `sts2.dll` SHA-256
`06c78d946ca70658e85abb28f6dc2ee0a023a4467faf0708ff542180fe5f4c82`.
Complete current-build bodies and constructors were read; the invariant walk
is `invariant-walks/2026-07-18-103-orb-seven-card-fanout.md`. The durable
complete-body evidence is archived in
[#138 comment 5011983226](https://github.com/sansb/StsHistoryViewer/issues/138#issuecomment-5011983226).

### Cards and exact command order

- **Cold Snap** (`.ctor 0x2874dd`, cost 1, common Attack, AnyEnemy):
  `<OnPlay>d__5 0x3dc058` attacks for Damage 6 (OnUpgrade +3), then
  `Channel<FrostOrb>`.
- **Coolheaded** (`.ctor 0x287e3b`, cost 1, common Skill, Self):
  `<OnPlay>d__5 0x3ddd30` channels Frost, then
  `CardPileCmd.Draw(Cards=1, fromHandDraw=false)` (OnUpgrade Cards +1).
  DrawInternal's own entry-terminal gate, ShouldDraw/NoDraw gate, hand-space
  clamp, and reshuffle behavior remain in `draw_cards`; in particular, a
  lethal full-queue Lightning auto-evoke still enqueues Frost and runs
  AfterOrbChanneled, then the later Draw no-ops.
- **Darkness** (`.ctor 0x28892d`, cost 1, uncommon Skill, Self):
  `<OnPlay>d__3 0x3df908` channels Dark, then lazily enumerates the now-live
  `OrbQueue.Orbs.OfType<DarkOrb>()` in queue order. For each Dark (including
  the newly channeled one) it calls
  `OrbCmd::Passive(orb, null, countAffectedByHooks=false)` once, or twice
  when upgraded. The localized `darkness` step calls the existing
  `orb_passive` primitive with the hook-count flag false, so Gold Plated
  Cables never adds a trigger. Dark Passive cannot add/remove/reorder queue
  members; snapshotting the matching live indices before the calls is
  behaviorally identical to the lazy enumeration. Each Passive retains its
  own entry-terminal gate, so a lethal Channel completes its enqueue/hook tail
  under #450 while the later accumulation calls no-op.
- **Fusion** (`.ctor 0x28ccdf`, cost 1, uncommon Skill, Self):
  `<OnPlay>d__5 0x3e9b2c` channels Plasma. Base has Exhaust; OnUpgrade
  `0x28cd63` removes Exhaust. Natural L0 Exhaust wins over Rebound/Nostalgia;
  L1 naturally Discards and may be redirected. A force-exhaust auto-play
  exhausts either level, while Distilled Chaos (`forceExhaust=false`) keeps
  the natural L0/L1 split.
- **Glasswork** (`.ctor 0x28d2d3`, cost 1, uncommon Skill, Self):
  `<OnPlay>d__7 0x3ea7f0` gains Block 5 (OnUpgrade +3), then channels Glass.
  A terminal Juggernaut response to the first command makes Channel's real
  entry gate no-op.
- **Null** (`.ctor 0x292943`, cost 2, uncommon Attack, AnyEnemy):
  `<OnPlay>d__5 0x3f8b7c` attacks for Damage 10 (OnUpgrade +3), applies Weak
  2 (OnUpgrade +1), then channels Dark. The Weak application uses the existing
  visible-Type-2 Artifact gate and Unsettling Lamp card latch. A lethal attack
  suppresses both later commands.
- **Shadow Shield** (`.ctor 0x296c49`, cost 2, uncommon Skill, Self):
  `<OnPlay>d__7 0x4038bc` gains Block 11 (OnUpgrade +4), then channels Dark;
  it shares Glasswork's terminal Juggernaut ordering.

### Shared queue, replay, result, and RNG contracts

All seven join `_ORB_SLOT_SENSITIVE_CARDS`: unknown character refuses because
base 0 versus Defect base 3 changes bootstrap/capacity/auto-evoke behavior.
They do **not** independently join `_TARGETS_CONSUMER_DECK_CARDS`. None can
create Lightning; a pre-existing Lightning in production necessarily came
from an already-gated modeled card or relic source. Havoc and Distilled Chaos
are likewise already gated when their auto-play target needs a random enemy.
With no such source these seven consume zero CombatTargets draws; when their
full-queue Channel auto-evokes a pre-existing Lightning, it consumes exactly
one and leaves Shuffle, Niche, MonsterAi, and CombatCardSelection unchanged.

Channel is the shared v0.109 primitive documented above: base-0/zero-capacity
bootstraps one slot; Defect capacity 3 enqueues normally; a nonzero-base
character stripped to zero capacity silently fails TryEnqueue; full queues
evoke the oldest then append the new orb. Focus modifies evoked/passive orb
values at the existing read sites. Metronome observes every successful
channel, including the terminal continuation. Duplicator, Burst,
One-Two-Punch, Echo Form, Havoc, Distilled Chaos, and normal result-location
routing all reuse the existing play-body/result-once pipelines; the seven add
no separate replay or pile rule.

## EN1 enchantment wave (2026-07-16)

First ENCHANTMENT read wave (#138). 17 enchantments (the untouched
`category:"enchantment"` slice, minus the ineligible DEPRECATED_ENCHANTMENT /
MOCK_FREE_ENCHANTMENT) were IL-read and **REFUSED with implementable specs**
(I5). All are refused because the enchant-modifier architecture keeps every
payload interpretation in `combat_sim.py` (`ench_damage_bonus`,
`ench_block_bonus`, `ench_glam_extra_plays`, `glam_spend`, `card_cost` ~L563-611)
and the play pipeline — so modeling any one is a combat_sim edit, out of a
content wave's scope. `versions/v0.111.0/solver/content/enchantments.py` is UNCHANGED; the 17 ids
stay `untouched` in `coverage_matrix.json` (enchantments have no checked-in
refused table — `build_coverage_matrix.py` derives only modeled|untouched). The
enforcement backstop is combat_sim.py ~L2978: an enchantment not in
`KNOWN_ENCHANTMENTS` raises `NotImplementedError` at `start_combat`; the new
`test_en1_enchantments_are_absent_from_known_enchantments` pins the absence.

**Superseded in part by Batch 36 (2026-07-18):** ADROIT, SOWN, SWIFT, and
INKY are now modeled by the exact OnPlay wrapper described in W133 below;
the remaining 13 EN1 enchantments retain their fail-closed refusals. This
section remains the original census/evidence record, not the current coverage
frontier.

All RVAs sts2.dll (macOS arm64, census build). Async hook bodies read from the
nested `<Hook>d__N::MoveNext` classes (NestedClass table via dump_il.py). Enums
pinned this wave (dump_type.py): **CardType** None=0, Attack=1, Skill=2, Power=3,
Status=4, Curse=5, Quest=6. **CardKeyword** None=0, Exhaust=1, Ethereal=2,
Innate=3, Unplayable=4, Retain=5, Sly=6, Eternal=7. **CardTag** None=0, Strike=1,
Defend=2, Minion=3, OstyAttack=4, Shiv=5. (These agree with the CardType/
CardKeyword pins from the CW1 wave.)

| SLUMBERING_ESSENCE | SlumberingEssence | none | `BeforeFlush` 0x28070c (sync) | at end-of-turn flush, if card still in hand (`Pile.Type==2`): `EnergyCost.AddUntilPlayed(-1,false)` — cost −1 until played (stacks each unplayed turn) | CardEnergyCost modifier | none |
| SOULS_POWER | SoulsPower | card has Exhaust from source `GetKeywordsWithSources(2)` | `OnEnchant` 0x28079d (enchant-time ONLY) | `CardCmd.RemoveKeyword(Exhaust)` from the card | none (combat) | none |
| SOWN | Sown | none | OnPlay [0x2807c0 / d__2 0x3ce618] | first play this combat (`Status` gate): `set_Status(1)` then `PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(Amount)` | `Status` (once/combat flag) | none |
| SPIRAL | Spiral | `Rarity==1` (common) AND CardTag Strike or Defend | `EnchantPlayCount` 0x28087a | play count += `Times` (IntVar `'Times'=1`) — card plays 1 EXTRA time (persistent, unlike GLAM which is spent) | `'Times'` var (=1) | none |
| STEADY | Steady | none | `OnEnchant` 0x2808a8 (enchant-time ONLY) | `AddKeyword(Retain)` on the card | none (combat) | none |
| SWIFT | Swift | none; `ShowAmount=1` | OnPlay [0x2808c4 / d__4 0x3ce704] | first play this combat (`Status` gate): `set_Status(1)` then `CardPileCmd.Draw(Amount)` | `Status` (once/combat flag) | Draw (draw-pile order; a reshuffle mid-draw draws the Shuffle stream — I6) |
| VIGOROUS | Vigorous | Attack; `ShowAmount=1` | `EnchantDamageAdditive` 0x280998 (Status-gated) + `AfterCardPlayed` 0x2809c1 (sync) | while `Status` false (first play only): powered attack +`Amount`; `AfterCardPlayed` sets `Status=1` so the bonus is gone on later plays | `Status` (one-shot flag) | none |

### I1 census agreement (no STOP)
`enchantments_census.json` carries only `{class, kind}` per id (EnchantmentModel's
ctor takes no args, no rarity enum — see census header), so there is no numeric
field to contradict. Every id above is `kind:"enchantment"` in the census and
the class names match. No census contradiction → no I5 STOP.

### Architecture: why all 17 refuse
The existing enchantment helpers are **additive-only** (`ench_damage_bonus`
handles SHARP/TEZCATARAS_EMBER; `ench_block_bonus` handles NIMBLE;
`ench_glam_extra_plays`/`glam_spend` handle GLAM; `card_cost` handles the
TEZ/TOI free-cost markers). There is **no** enchantment OnPlay/AfterCardPlayed/
AfterCardDrawn/BeforeFlush/ModifyShuffleOrder/EnchantPlayCount dispatch and **no**
multiplicative enchantment helper. So:
- CORRUPTED/INSTINCT need a NEW `ench_damage_mult` helper (a `Πmultiplicative`
  factor per I7; ×1.5 is NON-dyadic → the bundle must route it through Fraction
  like the ShrinkPower ×7/10 path, NOT a float).
- INKY/VIGOROUS/MOMENTUM extend the additive helper but ALSO need per-play state
  (VIGOROUS one-shot Status; MOMENTUM/GOOPY a growing counter mutated on play).
- ADROIT/SOWN/SWIFT/INKY/CORRUPTED need a genuinely new enchant-OnPlay hook site
  in the play pipeline (block / energy / draw / self-damage / apply-Weak).
- PERFECT_FIT/SLITHER/SLUMBERING_ESSENCE/SPIRAL/IMBUED touch pile order, cost, or
  play-count machinery (I9/I6-sensitive; SLITHER consumes the `CombatEnergyCosts`
  RNG stream, a stream not currently modeled).
- ROYALLY_APPROVED/STEADY/SOULS_POWER are OnEnchant-ONLY keyword mutations
  (add Innate/Retain, remove Exhaust) — no combat hook, but they change the
  card's keyword set, which the sim keys on `(id, upgrade)` in `CARDS`; there is
  no path for an enchantment to carry a keyword delta into the card spec, and
  Retain/Innate have their own modeled keyword paths, and Sly uses #171's
  DiscardAndDraw auto-play path. Registering any other keyword
  without interpreting the delta would treat the card as its unmodified base —
  exactly the I8 wrongness class (silent deck-cycling change). Refused, not inert.

### Recommended engine fan-in bundles (by shared hook surface)
- **Bundle 1 — damage/block modifier helpers** (extend `ench_damage_bonus`/
  `ench_block_bonus`, ADD `ench_damage_mult`; per-play state for the growers):
  INSTINCT, CORRUPTED (mult half), VIGOROUS, MOMENTUM, INKY (additive half),
  GOOPY. `area:engine-core`, serialize/bundle.
- **Bundle 2 — enchant OnPlay hook site** (new dispatch in the play pipeline:
  gain-block / gain-energy / draw / self-damage / apply-Weak; + auto-play):
  ADROIT, SOWN, SWIFT, the OnPlay halves of CORRUPTED & INKY, IMBUED.
  `area:engine-core`.
- **Bundle 3 — pile/cost/play-count + enchant-time keyword mutation** (I9/I6 and
  card-spec deltas): PERFECT_FIT, SLITHER (RNG stream), SLUMBERING_ESSENCE,
  SPIRAL, ROYALLY_APPROVED, STEADY, SOULS_POWER. `area:engine-core`.

CORRUPTED and INKY straddle Bundles 1+2 (a multiplicative/additive damage factor
AND an OnPlay side-effect); implement them once, in whichever bundle lands first,
crediting the other half.
## CW3 card wave (2026-07-16)

Third card wave on the #173 per-event trigger layer: the **next** ongoing-hook
families by census after CW1 (AfterCardPlayed / AfterCardDrawn) and CW2
(AfterBlockGained / BeforeHandDraw / ModifyHpLost / ModifyCardPlayCount) —
**AfterDamageReceived**, **AfterCardExhausted**, and **AfterSideTurnStart**
player powers. Slice built from the census: every card whose applied
`PowerCmd::Apply<XPower>` hosts one of those hooks (DLL TypeDef/MethodDef scan),
minus everything already `modeled`/`refused` in `coverage_matrix.json` and the
CW1/CW2 families, minus the orb/Focus/Doom-entangled powers (Coolant reads
`OrbQueue` → O-family; BiasedCognition applies FocusPower → O1/O2; Countdown/
Neurosurge apply DoomPower → Doom family). **0 modeled, 10 refused** — each
needs a new `State` field plus a handler, i.e. a `combat_sim.py` edit CW3 is
forbidden to make; so this is reads-and-refusal-specs only (docs + one refusal
test). All RVAs sts2.dll (census build); async hook bodies read in FULL in the
nested `<Hook>d__N::MoveNext` (enclosing pinned via the NestedClass table — the
`<AfterDamageReceived>d__4` name collides across Reflect/FlameBarrier/Slumbering
Beetle/Lagavulin, so each was pinned by EnclosingClass before reading). Walk +
full commutation audit:
`invariant-walks/2026-07-16-31-cw3-damage-exhaust-turnstart-hooks.md`.

**Distinct from CW1/CW2: no new trigger-layer event is needed.** Every item
slots into a dispatch site the engine ALREADY runs for a sibling power, so no
new `#`-issue is filed (contrast CW2's #267/#268/#269):
- **AfterDamageReceived** → the `flame_barrier` retaliation site in
  `monster_attack_player` (combat_sim.py ~L2516, after per-hit block absorb).
- **AfterCardExhausted** → the shared `_card_exhausted` dispatch sites (the
  Feel No Pain precedent, "call at EVERY site that exhausts one of the player's
  cards").
- **AfterSideTurnStart** → `begin_player_turn`'s per-turn power ticks
  (the `plating` decrement / `radiance` / `energy_next_turn` precedents).

Each card's OnPlay already translates to a lone `["power","<X>Power","self",n]`
step in `card_templates.json["cards"]`; each stays OUT of `CARDS` only because
its power is unmapped in `_TEMPLATE_POWER_STEPS` (combat_sim.py ~L411), so the
coverage status is **untouched** (translated card, unmodeled power — like CW1/
CW2), not `refused`. No `card_templates.json` / `coverage_matrix.json` edit —
regen is a no-op. Pin:
`test_cw3_refused_damage_exhaust_turnstart_cards_are_absent_from_cards`.

Enum reminder (CW1 pins): `CardType` None=0 / **Attack=1** / Skill=2 / Power=3.
`PowerModel` StackType: 1 = Intensity (additive) / 2 = Duration.

### AfterDamageReceived family (existing `flame_barrier` retaliation site)

- **CARD.REFLECT** (skill 1; `ReflectPower`, get_Type 0x2511bf=1 / StackType
  0x2511c2=1). AfterDamageReceived outer 0x2511c8 → `<AfterDamageReceived>d__4::
  MoveNext` **0x388ac8**: gates `target == owner`, `result.BlockedDamage > 0`,
  `props.IsPoweredAttack`, `dealer != null` → `Damage(dealer,
  (Decimal)result.BlockedDamage, prop 4, owner)`. Reflects the **BLOCKED**
  damage (NOT `Amount`, and NOT unpowered/unblocked hits) back to the dealer,
  unpowered/prop-4 (no thorns/powered re-trigger). AfterSideTurnStart outer
  0x251238 → d__5 **0x388bf8**: on the owner's own side start,
  `PowerCmd::Decrement` (Reflect is a stacking duration counter — `Amount` =
  turns of reflect, independent of the reflected magnitude). Awaits: a
  `reflect` int + a handler at the flame_barrier site keyed on `BlockedDamage`
  (not Amount) + a begin_player_turn decrement. Distinct from flame_barrier,
  which deals `Amount` and fires on fully-blocked hits too.
- **CARD.THE_GAMBIT** (skill 0; `TheGambitPower`, get_Type 0x2546af=2 /
  StackType 0x2546b2=2 Duration). AfterDamageReceived outer 0x2546b8 →
  `<AfterDamageReceived>d__4::MoveNext` **0x38fbe0**: gates `target == owner`,
  `props.IsPoweredAttack`, `result.UnblockedDamage > 0` → `PowerCmd::Remove`,
  `Flash`, `Kill(owner, 0)`. **Combat-ENDING**: taking ANY unblocked
  powered-attack damage while The Gambit is active KILLS the player. Awaits: a
  `the_gambit` flag + a lethal check at the flame_barrier site (I3 — this
  lowers the alpha/survival bound to "must fully block every powered attack
  this turn"; the sim's win/over path already exists, but the trigger does
  not). Duration StackType → it self-expires after `Amount` side turns.

### AfterCardExhausted family (now shared `_card_exhausted` site)

- **CARD.DARK_EMBRACE** (power 2; `DarkEmbracePower`, get_Type 0x24bdaf=1 /
  StackType 0x24bdb2=1; nested `Data.etherealCount`). AfterCardExhausted outer
  0x24bdcc → `<AfterCardExhausted>d__8::MoveNext` **0x37f03c**: gate
  `card.Owner.Creature == owner`; if `causedByEthereal` → `data.etherealCount
  += 1` (deferred — an ethereal card exhausted in the turn-end flush is TALLIED,
  not drawn mid-flush); else → `Draw(Amount, player, 0)` immediately.
  AfterSideTurnEnd outer 0x24be28 → d__9 **0x37f158**: on the owner's own side
  end, `Draw(Amount × data.etherealCount, player, 0)` then reset
  `etherealCount = 0`. Net: draw `Amount` per non-ethereal exhaust immediately,
  and `Amount` per ethereal exhaust batched at your side end. Awaits: a
  `dark_embrace` int + a `Draw` at the `_card_exhausted` call sites (which
  distinguish played-power removal from card exhaust — the exact FeelNoPain
  gate) + an `etherealCount` tally drained in `end_player_turn`. Card DRAW is
  the real blocker (RNG/shuffle + hand mutation), not the exhaust dispatch.

### AfterSideTurnStart family (existing `begin_player_turn` tick site)

All fire on the **owner's OWN side start** (`participants.Contains(owner)` gate;
same shape as the modeled `plating` AfterSideTurnStart). The applied inner
powers are individually modeled today, but their per-turn RE-application is not.

- **CARD.DEMON_FORM** (power 3; `DemonFormPower`, 0x24c03f=1 / 0x24c042=1).
  `<AfterSideTurnStart>d__6::MoveNext` **0x37f458**: `Flash`,
  `Apply<StrengthPower>(owner, Amount, owner)` — gain `Amount` Strength every
  turn. Awaits: a `demon_form` int + `s.strength += demon_form` in
  begin_player_turn (StrengthPower is the modeled `strength` step).
- **CARD.NOXIOUS_FUMES** (power 1; `NoxiousFumesPower`, 0x24f9dc=1 /
  0x24f9df=1). `<AfterSideTurnStart>d__6::MoveNext` **0x3858d0**: per-enemy VFX,
  then `Apply<PoisonPower>(HittableEnemies, Amount, owner)` — apply `Amount`
  Poison to ALL enemies every turn. Awaits: a `noxious_fumes` int + a
  poison-all in begin_player_turn (PoisonPower is the modeled `poison` step).
- **CARD.PREP_TIME** (power 1; `PrepTimePower`, 0x250a53=1 / 0x250a56=1).
  `<AfterSideTurnStart>d__4::MoveNext` **0x387a14**: `Apply<VigorPower>(owner,
  Amount, owner)` — gain `Amount` Vigor every turn (VigorPower is the modeled
  `vigor` step; note Vigor is consumed by the next attack, so the per-turn
  refresh interacts with the existing single-shot vigor field).
- **CARD.BLUR** (skill 1; `BlurPower`, 0x24a823=1 / 0x24a826=1). Two sync hooks
  + one async: `ShouldClearBlock` **0x24a83b** returns false for the owner
  (block is NOT cleared at turn start — the exact BarricadePower mechanism, the
  modeled `barricade` flag); `AfterPreventingBlockClear` 0x24a849 is `Flash`
  only; `<AfterSideTurnStart>d__8::MoveNext` **0x37c6a4** `PowerCmd::Decrement`
  on the owner's side start (Blur is TEMPORARY barricade — `Amount` = turns of
  retention). Awaits: a `blur` int gating the begin_player_turn block-clear
  (barricade precedent) + a decrement.
- **CARD.FURNACE** (power 1; `FurnacePower`, 0x24d579=1 / 0x24d57c=1).
  `<AfterSideTurnStart>d__6::MoveNext` **0x3817b4**: `Forge(Amount, player)` —
  upgrade `Amount` cards each turn (the Forge/in-place card-upgrade primitive).
  Awaits: a `furnace` int + a Forge/hand-upgrade primitive (the same
  card-instance upgrade the modeled AggressionPow­er pull uses, but applied to a
  Forge target-selection each turn — the selection/targeting is the blocker).
- **CARD.WRAITH_FORM** (power 3; `WraithFormPower`, get_Type 0x255887=2 /
  StackType 0x25588a=1). `<AfterSideTurnStart>d__6::MoveNext` **0x3918c4**:
  `Apply<DexterityPower>(owner, -Amount, owner)` — LOSE `Amount` Dexterity every
  turn (note the `neg`). Awaits: a `wraith_form` int + `s.dexterity -=
  wraith_form` in begin_player_turn (DexterityPower is the modeled `dexterity`
  step). **The card ALSO applies `IntangiblePower`** (the OnPlay applies both) —
  whose player side is the same primitive CW2's Apparition awaits (**#251**); CW3
  reads only the distinct WraithFormPower dexterity-loss half, so WRAITH_FORM
  needs BOTH `wraith_form` AND #251 before it is admissible.
- **CARD.FERAL** (power 2; `FeralPower`, 0x24ccbb=1 / 0x24ccbe=1; nested
  `Data.zeroCostAttacksPlayed`). A MULTI-hook power — the AfterSideTurnStart
  tick (0x24cdc1) is one of four: `AfterApplied` 0x24cce2 counts prior
  `CardPlayStartedEntry`s via history (`SetZeroCostAttacksPlayed`);
  `ModifyCardPlayResultPileTypeAndPosition` 0x24cd14 sends the owner's played
  **Attacks** (Type 1) with `EnergyValue <= 0` to a different result pile
  (exhaust), tracking `zeroCostAttacksPlayed`; `get_DisplayAmount` 0x24ccc1 =
  `max(0, Amount − zeroCostAttacksPlayed)`. Awaits: a `feral` State field + the
  `ModifyCardPlayResultPileTypeAndPosition` hook (new play-result-pile pipeline
  stage) + a per-play zero-cost-attack counter + the AfterApplied history scan.
  Included as an AfterSideTurnStart-family read, but flagged as the richest
  refusal (its primary hook is the play-result-pile modifier, not the turn-start
  tick) — a natural head for a future play-result-pile wave.

### Slimes — SLIMES_WEAK / SLIMES_NORMAL — REFUSED (#285)

The move primitives already exist (#165 `insert_draw` Slimed-to-draw-random,
`attack`); the blocker is `RANDOM_AI` **kind registration** in `combat_sim.py`
(a content-only wave cannot add it). All 4 machines read:

  random_branches 1, card_effects [Slimed]`): `TACKLE_MOVE` (SingleAttack
  `get_TackleDamage` 0x262b5f `(9,4,3)` -> A9+ 4/3) + `GOOP_MOVE`
  (`GoopMove` d__11: `AddToCombatAndPreview<Slimed>` 1) + `RAND`. `TACKLE.follow
  = RAND`, `GOOP.follow = RAND`; `RAND.AddBranch(TACKLE, 2)` and
  `AddBranch(GOOP, 2)` where **2 = `MoveRepeatType.CannotRepeat`** (default
  weight 1.0 — the SludgeSpinner/SoulNexus shape). **Initial state = RAND** ->

  A9+ 12/11) + `STICKY_SHOT_MOVE` (`Slimed` 1) + `RAND`; both -> RAND;
  `AddBranch(state, 2=CannotRepeat)`. **Initial = STICKY_SHOT** (a MoveState,

  from turn 2, but every RAND traversal still consumes one MonsterAi draw ->

- **LeafSlimeM** (0x262a28; `random_branches 0`): DETERMINISTIC alternation

  (`get_ClumpDamage` 0x262a17 `(9,9,8)` -> A9+ 9/8), `set_FollowUpState` both
  ways, initial STICKY_SHOT. No RAND -> no MonsterAi draw. HP `(8,33,32)` /

- **TwigSlimeS** (0x26e1bc; `move_states 1, random_branches 0, card_effects
  []`): single `TACKLE_MOVE` self-loop, SingleAttack `get_TackleDamage`

## CW fan-in bundle A (2026-07-16)

First fan-in that turns CW1 refusal specs (2026-07-16 wave) into MODELED cards
on the existing #173 AfterCardPlayed player-power trigger layer (E-TL base):
**SUBROUTINE** and **PANACHE** (issue #138). Companion walk:
`invariant-walks/2026-07-16-27-cwa-subroutine-panache.md` (full invariant walk +
the commutation-audit rows). All RVAs sts2.dll (census build). The reviewing
Fable session **re-dumped both power types in full** during review, so every
cite below is reviewer-verified IL; the review resolved the bundle's two
initially flagged uncertainties (Subroutine StackType — in the original
modeling's favor; Panache applying-play counting — against, fixed in review,
see the walk's I5).

What moved from refused-spec to modeled:

- **CARD.SUBROUTINE** (`SubroutinePower`, get_Type 0x25312b=1 / get_StackType
  0x25312e=**1 Intensity** — CW1's "0x25312e=2 Duration" annotation corrected
  by re-dump: `ldc.i4.1` = 1 Intensity; do not propagate the CW1 value). The
  type has NO turn hooks (re-dumped methods: ctor, InitInternalData,
  Before/AfterCardPlayed only). BeforeCardPlayed 0x253138: owner=player +
  `Card.Type==3` (Power) gate → `amountsForPlayedCards.Add(card, get_Amount)`
  (Storm-shaped latch, taken only on Power plays). AfterCardPlayed →

### #266 — player-relic AfterCardPlayed block fires BEFORE enemy powers

**IL (re-verified from the DLL this session, not just the E-TL read).**
`CombatState::IterateHookListeners` RVA **0x2dffd1** confirmed by name-dump;
the listener order lives in the nested iterator `<IterateHookListeners>d__69::
MoveNext`. Reading its MoveNext: it builds one listener list per creature with
players+allies BEFORE enemies (`get_Players` then `_allies`, only later
`_enemies`), and per creature appends **Powers** (`Creature::get_Powers`
AddRange) → **model** (`get_Monster` Add) → then, gated by `Player::
get_IsActiveForHooks`, the **player-only** tail: **Relics** (`get_Relics`,
skipping `RelicModel::get_IsMelted`) → **PotionSlots** → **Orbs**
(`OrbQueue::get_Orbs`) → **card piles** (`get_AllPiles` → `CardPile::
get_Cards`, then Affliction/Enchantment). Only after the whole player block does
the loop reach `_enemies`. So **every player relic fires before every enemy
power** at a shared event.

**Bug (pre-existing, flagged by the E-TL wave as out-of-scope, not introduced
by #173).** The Permafrost (first Power play → 7 block) and OrnamentalFan (3rd
attack → 4 block) AfterCardPlayed grants sat in `_after_card_played_body` AFTER
the enemy-power loop. Co-occurring with GlobeHead **GalvanicPower** (enemy
AfterCardPlayed, 6 blockable damage on power plays — the one modeled enemy
damage handler at this event) the relic block landed AFTER Galvanic, so a
GlobeHead power play with armed Permafrost took 6 to HP instead of absorbing it.
Reachable (player holding Permafrost in a GlobeHead fight); no fight_states
capture pinned it, and the full suite passes unchanged, proving no pinned fight
had this co-occurrence.

**Fix.** Moved the Permafrost and OrnamentalFan block grants to the TOP of
`_after_card_played_body`, ahead of the enemy loop (after the player-power
trigger-layer pass `_powers_after_card_played` — powers before relics within
the player side, per 0x2dffd1). Order is now player powers → player relics
(Lamp, Permafrost, Fan) → enemy powers → remaining player relics. Pinned by
`test_permafrost_relic_block_absorbs_globe_head_galvanic` (block 7 grants first,
then absorbs Galvanic before HP; the v0.110.1 amount 6 left 1 Block, while the
current v0.111.0 amount 8 consumes the Block and loses 1 HP; contrast: spent
Permafrost sends the full Galvanic amount to HP). No RNG shift (I6): both
grants are flat block adds drawing no stream.

**Ordering audit vs GlobeHead Galvanic (the AfterCardPlayed non-commuting
pair).** Extends the E-TL / CWA per-pair audits (walks 18/27/28):

| moved grant | vs Galvanic (enemy dmg) | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Permafrost (power plays, 7 block) | co-occurs on a POWER play | **non-commuting, now fixed order**: relic block precedes enemy power → absorbs (0x2dffd1). Pinned. |
| OrnamentalFan (3rd attack, 4 block) | Fan is attack-only, Galvanic power-only | **disjoint by card type** — never co-occurs. Move is IL-order fidelity, behavior-preserving; commutes with Effigy Slow (its only co-occurring enemy power: player-block vs monster-slow). Pinned disjoint. |

**Kusarigama placement question (audited, LEFT in place — observationally
equivalent, no fix needed).** Kusarigama (3rd attack → 6 damage to a rolled
monster) is also a player relic that per 0x2dffd1 precedes enemy powers, but it
stays after the enemy loop because: on an attack play the only co-occurring
enemy power is Effigy **Slow** (`monster.slow` on itself — no player damage, no
lethal-to-player path; Galvanic and Prism Tainted need power/skill cards and
never co-occur with a 3rd-attack). If a Kusarigama kill ever raced Effigy Slow,
IL kills first and the dead monster's Slow is skipped, but a dead monster's slow
is never read → same observable outcome. Its `_roll_target` is the only RNG here
and stays fixed relative to every other stream (the enemy loop draws none), so
leaving it after the loop shifts no RNG (I6). The same reasoning covers
Nunchaku/Kunai/Shuriken (player-side energy/dex/str that no enemy power reads).

### #254 — simultaneous double-lethal is a LOSS (cites, no behavior change)

Two-body IL read (fable batch-6 coordinator, DLL-equipped; recorded here for
future multi-creature commands). **`CreatureCmd/<Damage>d__12::MoveNext` RVA
0x42ef38** — the multi-target damage core: the target list is snapshotted and
enumerated; the ONLY per-target skip is `originalTarget.IsDead` (IL_016d); there
is NO combat-over/ending early-exit inside the loop (the lone `IsEnding` at
IL_073d is a history/VFX sub-phase). Each target takes its damage
(`DamageBlockInternal` IL_02f3), fires `Hook::AfterDamageReceived` (IL_0d7a),
and targets reaching 0 are ACCUMULATED into `killedCreatures` (IL_0d30) — no
inline kill; after the loop ONE batched `CreatureCmd::Kill(killedCreatures, 0)`
(IL_0ea1). **So a multi-target command damages ALL targets, then batches the
kills** — the general rule any future AoE/multi-creature command references.
**`CreatureCmd/<Kill>d__14::MoveNext` RVA 0x431314** — per creature
`KillWithoutCheckingWinCondition` (monster deaths process with NO victory
eval), THEN if the batch contains a player and `runState.Players.All(p =>
p.Creature.IsDead)` (`<Kill>b__14_1` RVA 0x42e7ca) and combat in progress →
`CombatManager::LoseCombat` (IL_0195). Player-death → LOSS is evaluated FIRST; a
simultaneous last-enemy death in the same batch cannot flip it to a win.

**Sim already correct.** FOUL_POTION applies its 12 to all enemies then to the
player (`_galvanic_damage`, which sets `s.over` on hp≤0). `solve_fight.outcome`
checks `if s.hp <= 0: return LOSS` BEFORE `if not s.alive(): win`, so a terminal
state with the player dead is a LOSS regardless of the enemies also being dead —
exactly the IL. Pinned by `test_foul_potion_simultaneous_double_lethal_is_a_loss`
(one enemy ≤12 HP, player at 12/no block → both die, `solve()[0] == LOSS`).

### #248 — enemy ShrinkPower routes through the ArtifactPower gate (cites)

Three-method IL read (fable batch-6 coordinator, DLL) confirming F1's routing
(PR #247): a positive Shrink application onto an Artifact-holding monster is
eaten like Weak/Vuln/Poison. (1) **`ArtifactPower::TryModifyPowerAmountReceived`
RVA 0x24a254** gates, in order: receiving creature == owner; `GetTypeForAmount
== 2` (debuff); `get_IsVisible` true → the amount is zeroed and the apply
consumed (one stack spent). (2) **`PowerModel::GetTypeForAmount` RVA 0x22e774**
with ShrinkPower's overrides (get_Type 0x251e63 = 2, get_StackType 0x251e66 = 1
Intensity, get_AllowNegative 0x251e73 = 1): for a POSITIVE amount (Beetle Juice
+4) the AllowNegative branch falls through to `return get_Type()` = **2
(debuff)** → gate passes. (The amount<0 branch forcing 2 is a bonus cite for
#222: negative Strength/Dexterity applications are always Artifact-blockable.)
(3) **ShrinkPower overrides NEITHER `IsVisible` NOR `IsVisibleInternal`**; base
`get_IsVisibleInternal` RVA 0x22e460 = `ldc.i4.1; ret` for an enemy target
(unconditionally true; the only false path is a remote multiplayer player,
unreachable) → gate passes. **No sim change**: `apply_monster_debuff` already
routes `shrink` through the `m.artifact` gate. Strengthening note to the F1
entry: pinned by `test_beetle_juice_shrink_blocked_by_monster_artifact`
(Artifact 1 eats the +4; depleted Artifact then takes the full Shrink).

### NecroMastery (#263) — REFUSED, hard-gated on SUM1 (#229)

`NecroMasteryPower` (Type=1 Buff / StackType=1 Intensity, 0x24f50b/0x24f50e),
applied by CARD.NECRO_MASTERY. `AfterCurrentHpChanged(creature, delta)` —
sync 0x24f514, async `<AfterCurrentHpChanged>d__4::MoveNext` **0x3850b4**:

- `if delta >= 0: return` (IL_0020-0032) — fires only on HP **loss**.
- `if !(creature.Monster isinst Osty): return` (IL_0037-0047).
- `if creature.PetOwner != owner.Player: return` (IL_004e-0064).
- effect: `CreatureCmd::Damage(HittableEnemies, -delta * Amount, type=6,
  source=owner)` (IL_006b-00a2; `-delta` `op_UnaryNegation` × `PowerModel::Amount`
  `op_Implicit`→Decimal, damage-type literal `ldc.i4.6`, target set =
  `CombatState.HittableEnemies`).

The trigger is an `AfterCurrentHpChanged` on an **Osty pet** — a combatant kind
the sim does not have (State = player scalars + `monsters` tuple only). The
hook is unreachable until the player-side ally / pet-HP primitive **SUM1
(#229)** lands; NecroMastery is exactly the SUM2 first-consumer named in the
#229 design. No sub-part is modelable independently — an "inert" stub would be
a latent wrong answer the moment SUM1 lands (I5). #263 stays OPEN pending SUM1.
Forward: the SUM2 consumer needs an I3 `damage_potential` audit row (pet HP-loss
becomes enemy damage).

### Orbit (#264) — REFUSED, gated on a NEW energy-spent primitive (not SUM1)

`OrbitPower` (Type=1/StackType=1, 0x24fccb/0x24fcce). Nested `OrbitPower/Data`:
int `energySpent`, int `triggerCount`. `CanonicalVars = EnergyVar(4)` (0x24fcf9
— the "every 4"); `DisplayAmount = 4 - (energySpent % 4)` (0x24fcd1);
`InitInternalData` news Data (0x24fcef). `AfterEnergySpent(card, amount)` —
sync 0x24fd08, async `<AfterEnergySpent>d__15::MoveNext` **0x385e7c**:

- `if card.Owner.Creature != power.Owner: return` (IL_0020-0038).
- `if amount <= 0: return` (IL_003d-0046).
- `data.energySpent += amount` (IL_0057-006a).
- `triggers = (energySpent / 4) - triggerCount` (integer div, IL_006f-0089).
- `if triggers <= 0:` no gain (IL_008e-0095).
- else `Flash()`; `GainEnergy(Amount * triggers)` (IL_009a-00bd,
  `PlayerCmd::GainEnergy`); `triggerCount += triggers` (IL_0114-0127).

A cumulative energy-spent **ratchet**: every new multiple of 4 total energy
spent → gain `Amount` energy (`Amount * triggers` covers crossing several at
once, e.g. an X-cost spending 8 → +2 triggers).

Trigger surface (I6): `Hook::AfterEnergySpent` fires from `CardModel::SpendEnergy`
(`<SpendEnergy>d__337::MoveNext` **0x363430**), only inside its `amount > 0`
guard (IL_003f-0045); `SpendEnergy` ← `SpendResources` during card play,
`amount` = energy actually paid (X-cost = all current energy via
`GetAmountToSpend`/`CapturedXValue`). The sim deducts energy silently at
`combat_sim.py:5078` and the X-cost path 5072-5073 with **no hook**. Modeling
Orbit needs new engine machinery — an `AfterEnergySpent` emission at both
sites (amount>0 only), two memo-key counter fields (I2), and
`GainEnergy(Amount*triggers)` routed through the `ModifyEnergyGain` /
NoEnergyGain gate (#233) — so it is refused here and filed as a separate
`area:engine-core`/`fable` primitive (blocked-by #138), mirroring
#267/#268/#269. The read itself is complete; #264 stays OPEN only pending that
primitive.

do, via the `refused` blocks in `card_templates.json` / `relic_templates.json`),
a prose refusal never changes the coverage matrix, so the whole slice cycled
back to this wave as `untouched`. This section is a **consolidated,
independently re-verified refusal ledger**: every `<OnUse>d__N::MoveNext`
body below was re-dumped from `sts2.dll` (macOS arm64, the census build) with
`tools/dump_il.py` this session, corroborating P1/P2 and adding the precise
RVAs P1/P2 left imprecise (COLORLESS/CUNNING/DROPLET/ENTROPIC). No engine or
matrix change — every item needs a NEW engine primitive, none of which has
landed, so none is a simple `apply_action` dispatch addition. The structural
fix (a `potion_refusals.json` registry so these stop re-cycling) is filed as a
follow-up (area:solver-tools, blocked-by #138); see the P5 walk file.

| id | required primitive (all absent) | RVA (MoveNext) |
|---|---|---|
| POTION.ATTACK_POTION | card generation on the `CombatCardGeneration` RNG stream (untracked, I6) + mid-fight add-to-hand | 0x3922a8 |
| POTION.COLORLESS_POTION | same card-gen shape over `ColorlessCardPool` | 0x392c6c |
| POTION.COSMIC_CONCOCTION | card-gen (`GetDistinctForCombat`, `CombatCardGeneration`) + per-card `Upgrade` + add-to-hand | 0x392e18 |
| POTION.CUNNING_POTION | `Shiv::CreateInHand(3)` + `Upgrade` — SHIV is an unmodeled card, plus the add-to-hand-with-overflow primitive | 0x392fbc |
| POTION.BONE_BREW | `OstyCmd::Summon(15)` — a player-side ally/minion creature (no summon system) | 0x3927a8 |
| POTION.BOTTLED_POTENTIAL | full-deck `CardPileCmd::Add`→`Shuffle`→`Draw(5)` — Shuffle variant/stream unpinned, no live capture (I6/I9) | 0x3928ac |
| POTION.DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION | player-choice `CardSelectCmd::FromCombatPile(DrawPile,1)`→`Add` to hand — WHICH instance is pulled makes identical draw-pile copies distinguishable, unsound outside `exact_piles`, no capture pin (I9) | 0x393488 |
| POTION.ENTROPIC_BREW | `PotionFactory::CreateRandomPotionOutOfCombat(CombatPotionGeneration)`→`TryToProcure` — untracked potion-gen RNG stream that mutates the belt; an unmodeled generated potion in the belt makes any optimality claim unsound (I8) | 0x3937dc |

Detail (each cross-references the P1/P2 sections above; only the deltas noted):

- **POTION.ATTACK_POTION / POTION.COLORLESS_POTION** — `<OnUse>d__6`.
  Body: `CardPoolModel::GetUnlockedCards` (Attack filter via `<>c::b__6_0`
  for Attack; `CardPool<ColorlessCardPool>` for Colorless) →
  `CardFactory::GetDistinctForCombat(3, RunRngSet::CombatCardGeneration)` →
  `CardSelectCmd::FromChooseACardScreen(1)` → `CardModel::SetToFreeThisTurn`
  → `CardPileCmd::AddGeneratedCardToCombat`. Colorless RVA now pinned at
  0x392c6c (P1 left it as "d__? at the ColorlessPotion body").
- **POTION.COSMIC_CONCOCTION** — `<OnUse>d__8` 0x392e18:
  `GetUnlockedCards` (Colorless) → `GetDistinctForCombat(Cards=3,
  CombatCardGeneration)` → enumerate, `CardCmd::Upgrade(1)` each →
  `AddGeneratedCardToCombat`. Card-gen on the untracked stream; the fixed
  `Cards=3` and the per-card upgrade are not the blocker — the RNG-drawn
  identities are.
- **POTION.CUNNING_POTION — modeled by #138 Batch 35.** See the exact L0
  entry → returned-instance upgrade lifecycle above (`0x395ecc`).
- **POTION.BONE_BREW** — `<OnUse>d__10` 0x3927a8:
  `OstyCmd::Summon(DynamicVars.Summon=15)`. A player-ally creature; the sim
  has no player-side minion / ally-summon system.
- **POTION.BOTTLED_POTENTIAL** — `<OnUse>d__8` 0x3928ac:
  `CardPileCmd::Add` moves all cards into the DrawPile (pile type 2), then
  `CardPileCmd::Shuffle` on the player, then `Draw(Cards=5)`. Full-deck
  reshuffle whose resulting order is RNG-driven; the Shuffle variant/stream
  is not pinned against a live capture (I6/I9).
- **POTION.DROPLET_OF_PRECOGNITION** — `<OnUse>d__6` 0x393488:
  `CardSelectCmd::FromCombatPile(DrawPile, prefs count 1)` →
  `FirstOrDefault<CardModel>` → `CardPileCmd::Add(pile 2 Hand)`. A player
  pulls one specific draw-pile card to hand; the residual draw order then
  depends on WHICH instance left, so identical copies stop being
  interchangeable — unsound outside `exact_piles`, and there is no live
  capture pinning the choice (I9).
- **POTION.ENTROPIC_BREW** — `<OnUse>d__6` 0x3937dc:
  `PotionFactory::CreateRandomPotionOutOfCombat(RunRngSet::CombatPotionGeneration)`
  → `ToMutable` → `PotionCmd::TryToProcure`, looping while
  `Player::get_HasOpenPotionSlots`. Fills empty belt slots off the untracked
  `CombatPotionGeneration` stream; the generated potions themselves may be
  unmodeled, so the resulting belt violates I8's "no unmodeled potion in the
  belt" precondition.

Encounter reads over Spiny Toad / Vine Shambler / Slimed Berserker / The
Obscura / Mecha Knight (#138), plus two extra untouched picks (Overgrowth
Crawlers, Scrolls of Biting normal). Branched from origin/main e5d4e75.
RVAs re-read from sts2.dll (macOS arm64) this session. **2 modeled, 5
refused** (I5). Filed #294 (TangledPower), #295 (SlimedBerserker composite),
#296 (Burn pile-inject), #297 (TheObscura summon); Scrolls cites existing
#180. All four filed issues carry a `blocked_by` edge on #138.

| encounter | status | reason / blocker |
|---|---|---|
| SPINY_TOAD_NORMAL | **modeled** | Toadpole thorns family reused (`buff_thorns`/`spit_attack`/`attack`) |
| OVERGROWTH_CRAWLERS | **modeled** | ShrinkerBeetle + FuzzyWurmCrawler machines reused unchanged |
| VINE_SHAMBLER_NORMAL | refused | `TangledPower` / `Entangled` card-affliction (#294) |
| SLIMED_BERSERKER_NORMAL | refused | LEECHING_HUG Weak+Strength composite + VOMIT Slimed pile-inject (#295) |

| SCROLLS_OF_BITING_NORMAL | **modeled** | W97/#180: exact 4-Scroll roster, RNG, PaperCuts and LoseMaxHp |

### Modeled

- **SPINY_TOAD_NORMAL** — one `SpinyToad`. `GenerateMoveStateMachine`
  0x269ca0: deterministic 3-cycle (0 `RandomBranchState`), initial
  `PROTRUDING_SPIKES_MOVE` -> `SPIKE_EXPLOSION_MOVE` -> `TONGUE_LASH_MOVE`
  -> SPIKES (`set_FollowUpState` triple). Move bodies (nested
  `<…>d__23/24/25::MoveNext`): `SpikesMove` = `set_IsSpiny(true)` +
  `Apply<ThornsPower>(5)` self (= `buff_thorns`, the Toadpole SPIKEN kind);
  `ExplosionMove` = `set_IsSpiny(false)`, SingleAttack `get_ExplosionDamage`
  0x269c68 [9,25,23] -> A9+ 25, then `Apply<ThornsPower>(-5)` self (=
  `spit_attack`; remove-thorns-then-attack — ordering vs the outgoing attack
  is irrelevant, a monster attacking the player never triggers its own
  Thorns); `LashMove` = SingleAttack `get_LashDamage` 0x269c5b [9,19,17] ->
  A9+ 19. `IsSpiny` is animator-only (`GenerateAnimator` predicates
  b__26_0..3); the ThornsPower stacks carry the retaliation — 0 while
  unspiked, 5 in the SPIKES->EXPLOSION window (SPIKES(+5) precedes every
  EXPLOSION(-5), so thorns is 5 or 0, never negative). No `AfterAddedToRoom`
  override -> Thorns starts 0 (not spiky turn 1). HP `get_MinInitialHp`
  0x269c43 [8,121,116] / `get_MaxInitialHp` 0x269c4f [8,124,119] -> A8+
  (121,124). Reuses the existing thorns kinds + thorns-retaliation pipeline
  (combat_sim.py:2509) unchanged; the only combat_sim edit is the
  `SPINY_TOAD` monster-kind name constant (no new dispatch). Pinned by
  `test_spiny_toad_thorns_cycle_and_retaliation`.
- **OVERGROWTH_CRAWLERS** — `ShrinkerBeetle` (slot 0) + `FuzzyWurmCrawler`
  (slot 1). `OvergrowthCrawlers::GenerateMonsters` 0x27e8b9 is **fully
  deterministic** (no `Rng` call): a 2-element array, ShrinkerBeetle created
  first, FuzzyWurmCrawler second — creation order = slot order = Niche
  HP-roll order (the CULTISTS pattern; disjoint HP ranges -> independent
  uniqueness sets). Both monster machines are already modeled and verified
  (`SHRINKER_BEETLE_WEAK` #174 — `shrink` + attacks; `FUZZY_WURM_CRAWLER_WEAK`
  W1 — attack + `buff_strength`, `_isPuffed` cosmetic), reused unchanged
  (the W3 normal-reuse precedent). Census both `random_branches 0`, no
  summons. HP from `SHRINKER_HP` (40,42)/`FUZZY_HP` (58,59) A8+. No new
  engine dispatch; no new constant (both kinds pre-exist). Pinned by
  `test_overgrowth_crawlers_composition_and_reused_machines`.
